Drizzle pork with sauce. Sprinkle with onion. Serve with Asian coleslaw (see related recipe).

ingredients.description: green onion, thinly sliced to serve

recipes.name: Asian pork salad
recipes.description: Tender roast pork is teamed with fresh Asian ingredients in this delicious salad main.
instructions: Combine soy sauce, garlic and Chinese five-spice in a shallow ceramic dish. Add pork and turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

Preheat oven to 200°C. Drain pork, reserving marinade. Place pork in a shallow roasting pan and roast for 15 to 20 minutes or until just cooked through. Transfer to a plate. Cover. Set aside to rest for 5 minutes.

Place reserved marinade in a small saucepan. Add a bit of water. Bring to the boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and whisk in oil. Set aside to cool.
Thinly slice pork across the grain. Combine Asian greens, pepper, mushroom, pear, coriander and mint in a large bowl. Add pork and dressing. Toss to combine. Serve.

ingredients.description: red bell pepper, deseeded, cut into thin strips

recipes.name: Apple pork with cashews
recipes.description: Liven up rich apple sauce with soy, ginger and nutty cashews to serve with tender pork.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Place seasoned flour into a plastic bag. Add cutlets, a few at a time, and toss until coated in flour. Shake off excess flour.
Heat oil and butter in a heavy-based flameproof casserole dish over high heat. Cook cutlets, in batches, for 3 minutes on each side or until golden. Remove to a plate.
Add juice, soy, sugar, ginger, salt and pepper to the dish. Bring to the boil, then remove from heat. Place cutlets into dish. Top casserole with apples and sprinkle with cashews.
Cover. Bake for 35 minutes. Remove lid and cook for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Satay pork melts
recipes.description: These satay pork melts make a great tasting light meal and are easy to prepare.
instructions: Place pork in a glass or ceramic dish. Pour over marinade. Marinate in fridge for at least 20 mins.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Spray with oil. Cook pork for 3-4 mins each side, depending on thickness, or until tender. Slice.
Preheat grill on high. Top muffins with spinach, pork and cheddar. Cook under grill for 1-2 mins or until golden. Serve with salad leaves and cucumber.

recipes.name: Hawaiian pork chops
recipes.description: Serve these sweet and cheesy pork chops with a green salad for a complete weeknight meal.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Place chops into a large ovenproof baking dish.
Mix together pineapple, ham, oregano, tomatoes, and salt and pepper. Spoon mixture onto chops. Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake chops for 25 to 30 minutes or until cooked through.

recipes.name: Apricot, cranberry and pistachio quinoa porridge
recipes.description: Roll up, roll up, for a hearty porridge breakfast with a brand new look!
instructions: Combine quinoa and cold water in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to medium-low. Cook, covered, for 10 minutes.
Stir in milk, apricot and cranberries. Cook, covered, for 10 minutes or until quinoa is tender. Stir in sugar.
Spoon porridge into bowls. Sprinkle with pistachios. Drizzle with honey. Serve.

recipes.name: Leek, spinach and feta omelettes
recipes.description: Shake up your weeknight meal routine with this vegetarian leek, spinach and feta omelette!
instructions: Melt butter in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add leeks, garlic and tarragon, and cook, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes or until leeks are soft. Add spinach and stir to combine. Cook for a further 30 seconds or until spinach is wilted. Season with salt and pepper.

Whisk egg, parsley and 0.5 tablespoon cold water in a large bowl. Heat half of the oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium–high heat. Add half the egg mixture, swirling pan to coat base. Cook for 2 minutes or until top is almost set and base is golden.

Spoon half the leek mixture over half the omelette. Fold omelette over to enclose. Slide onto a plate and scatter with half each of the feta and extra spinach. Repeat with remaining oil, egg mixture, leek mixture, feta and spinach.
Drizzle with extra oil and scatter with pine nuts, if using, to serve.

ingredients.description: leek, trimmed, halved lengthwise, thinly sliced
baby spinach, plus extra, to serve
olive oil, plus extra, to drizzle

recipes.name: Omelette
recipes.description: Make the perfect omelette for breakfast with our fabulous recipe and 'eggspert' tips!
instructions: Whisk eggs and a bit of cold water together in a bowl until combined. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat a small frying pan over medium-high heat until just warm. Add butter. Tilt pan back and forth until sizzles.
Whisk eggs again. Pour mixture into pan. Tilt pan to cover base in mixture. Using a wooden spoon, drag set egg from outer edge into centre. Tilt pan so uncooked egg comes in contact with base.
Cook for 1 minute or until top is almost set. Sprinkle with spinach. Fold over to enclose spinach. Transfer to a plate.

recipes.name: Ham and pea fritters
recipes.description: The kids will love helping to make these tasty fritters.
instructions: Sift flour into a large bowl and make a well in the centre. Whisk together the milk and egg in a jug. Use a balloon whisk to gradually stir milk mixture into flour. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook peas in a medium saucepan of salted boiling water for 5 minutes or until bright green and tender. Drain. Refresh under cold running water.
Add ham, onion and half the peas to the fritter batter. Use a fork to mash the remaining peas in a small bowl and add to the batter. Stir until just combined.

Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the fritter batter into the pan. Repeat to fritters, spaced about 5cm apart. Cook for 3 minutes or until golden underneath and bubbles appear on the surface. Turn and cook for a further 3 minutes or until cooked through. Transfer to a warm plate and cover with foil to keep warm.

recipes.name: Turkish toast with poached egg
recipes.description: Start your day with a delicious and healthy breakfast - just like this easy vegetarian recipe!
instructions: Combine tomatoes, onion, coriander and red wine vinegar in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to allow flavours to develop, if time permits.

Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil over high heat. Add white vinegar and a pinch of salt. Reduce heat to low and gently simmer. Crack egg onto a saucer (to check egg yolk is intact). Using a large spoon, stir simmering water to create a whirlpool. Tip egg into centre of whirlpool. Poach egg for 3 to 4 minutes or until just set. Use a slotted spoon to transfer egg to a plate. Cover to keep warm.
Place bread bases on plates. Top with tomato mixture and egg. Sprinkle with sumac. Cover with bread tops. Serve.

recipes.name: Baked egg in tomato
recipes.description: Make a brunch to remember with these colourful baked eggs in tomatoes.
instructions: Cut tops off tomatoes. Scoop out the centres and discard. Sprinkle with a little salt and place, cut-side down, on paper towel for 15 minutes to drain.
Preheat oven to 180°C.

Pack rice into tomatoes and top with the pesto. Use crumpled foil to make a nest for each tomato and place on a baking tray. Break an egg into each tomato, and bake with the tops for about 20 minutes or until cooked.
Serve immediately seasoned with pepper.

recipes.name: Baked egg with chives and feta
recipes.description: Forget heavy breakfasts! Start the day with a low fat dish of baked eggs, chives and feta.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Brush a 125ml (1/2-cup) capacity ovenproof dishe with oil to lightly grease. Crack an egg into it. Pour the cream, sprinkle with feta, shallot and chives. Season with salt and pepper.
Place dish on a baking tray. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes or until egg are cooked to your liking. Serve immediately with toast fingers.

ingredients.description: green onion, ends trimmed, thinly sliced
whole-wheat bread, toasted, cut into fingers, to serve

recipes.name: Banana and cinnamon porridge
recipes.description: Roll up, roll up, for this hearty porridge breakfast with banana and cinnamon!
instructions: Bring the milk to a simmer in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir in the oats and salt. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to medium. Cook, stirring with a wooden spoon, for 5 minutes or until the porridge thickens (the porridge will coat the spoon when ready).
Remove from heat. Cover and stand for 5 minutes (the porridge will cool and thicken slightly on standing). Stir in the sugar.
Spoon into bowls. Top with banana and cinnamon. Serve.

recipes.name: Breakfast bruschetta
recipes.description: Bring a gourmet touch to your family breakfast table with these tasty bruschetta topped with spinach, pancetta, mushrooms and tomato.
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°C. Place the tomatoe and mushroom in a roasting pan. Drizzle with 1/2 of the oil and season with salt and pepper. Bake in oven for 20 minutes or until tomatoe begins to collapse. Remove from oven and set aside.

Meanwhile, heat a large frying pan over high heat. Add the pancetta and cook, turning occasionally, for 5 minutes or until crisp. Transfer to a plate. Reserve and set aside one-quarter of the pancetta. Heat half the remaining oil in the pan and add the spinach. Cook, stirring, for 2-3 minutes or until spinach just wilts. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat.
Brush the bread slice with remaining oil. Preheat a char-grill or barbecue. Cook the bread slice for 1 minute each side or until toasted.
Spread the ricotta over bread slice. Top with spinach, pancetta, mushrooms and tomatoe. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Asian-marinated baked salmon
recipes.description: Salty soy and sweet honey are the perfect balance for this tender salmon fillet.
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, bash the lemongrass until fragrant. Stir in the soy sauce, coriander stalks, ginger and garlic. Place the fish in a glass dish, then spread all over with the marinade. Cover and marinate in the fridge for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Place the salmon on the tray, then brush with the honey. Bake in the oven for 10 minutes or until the fish is just cooked but still a little pink in the centre.
Carefully transfer the fish to a board or serving platter, sprinkle with spring onion and coriander leaves, then serve warm or at room temperature with lime to squeeze, and salad.

ingredients.description: fresh coriander, leaves thinly sliced, stalks finely chopped

recipes.name: Baked maple-glazed salmon with wilted spinach
recipes.description: Making a tasty meal with just a few ingredients is easier than you think - the proof is in our baked salmon with a side of wilted spinach.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Line a baking tray with baking paper.
Put the orange juice, syrup, ginger and garlic in a small pan over medium heat, and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 8 minutes or until slightly reduced and syrupy.

Place the salmon on the prepared baking tray. Reserve half the maple glaze. Use the remaining glaze to brush over the salmon fillets. Bake for 8-10 minutes, until cooked to your liking, brushing the salmon with the reserved glaze halfway through cooking.

Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over high heat. Add the baby spinach leaves and cook, stirring, for 2-3 minutes, until just wilted. Season to taste with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper.
To serve, divide the wilted spinach and salmon fillets in serving plates, and drizzle the salmon fillets with any remaining reserved glaze.

recipes.name: Baked salmon
recipes.description: Beautiful crumbed salmon steaks are delicious with golden potatoes and a fresh green salad.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Lightly grease an oven tray. Grease a baking dish with oil.

Place potatoes in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil over high heat. Cook for 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Drain. Place on prepared tray. Using a potato masher, partially squash potatoes. Spray with oil.

Meanwhile, place bread in a food processor and process until roughly chopped. Add basil and parmesan. Process to a fine breadcrumb mixture. With motor still running, add oil and process until combined.
Place salmon, skin side down, in prepared dish. Sprinkle crumb mixture over top.
Place potatoes in oven on top shelf and fish on the shelf below. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes (depending on thickness of fish) or until potatoes are golden and fish is cooked through.

recipes.name: Blackened cajun salmon
recipes.description: We have the chef's secrets on chargrilling fish. With our clever tips you won't have to go out for dinner!
instructions: Combine cayenne pepper, onion powder, salt, pepper, thyme and oregano in a bowl.
Brush salmon with butter. Rub all over with spice mixture.
Heat a chargrill over medium-high heat. Cook salmon, skin side down, for 4 to 5 minutes or until skin is crisp. Turn. Cook, covered, for 4 to 5 minutes for medium or until cooked to your liking.

recipes.name: Caribbean-spiced salmon with pineapple salsa
recipes.description: A not-too-spicy Caribbean seasoning turns barbecue salmon fillets into something truly special.
instructions: Process shallot, chili, allspice, sugar and dried thyme in a food processor until smooth. Place salmon in a glass or ceramic bowl. Spoon over the spice mixture to coat. Cover and place in the fridge for 15 minutes to marinate.
Meanwhile, combine pineapple, chopped coriander and lime juice in a bowl.

Preheat a barbecue grill or chargrill on high. Cook salmon for 3 minutes each side for medium or until cooked to your liking. Top salmon with pineapple salsa and coriander leaves. Serve with salad leaves.

recipes.name: Chargrilled salmon with avocado salsa
recipes.description: Here's a healthy spin on convenience food — add four ingredients to your shopping basket, then head home to create a delicious family meal in a matter of minutes.
instructions: Preheat a barbecue grill and a flat plate on medium-high. Brush the salmon and asparagus with the oil. Season both sides of the salmon with salt and pepper.
Reduce heat to medium. Cook the salmon on the grill for 4 minutes each side or until the fish flakes when tested with a fork. Transfer to a plate.
Meanwhile, cook the asparagus on the flat plate, turning, for 2-3 minutes or until bright green and tender crisp. Transfer to a plate.
Combine the avocado and tomato in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Divide the asparagus among serving plates. Top with the salmon and the avocado salsa.

ingredients.description: avocado, stone removed, peeled, finely chopped

recipes.name: Coconut-poached salmon with Asian greens
recipes.description: Gently poached in a tangy Asian coconut broth, friends and family will love the lip-smacking flavour and tender salmon.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Place the coconut cream, lemongrass, ginger, lime zest and juice, fish sauce, caster sugar and spring onion in a saucepan over medium heat and bring to a simmer.

Meanwhile, place the fish in a baking dish and pour over the hot coconut mixture. Cover with a piece of foil and bake for 10-12 minutes until the fish is just cooked but still a  little rare in the centre. Sprinkle over the sesame seeds and serve with the steamed greens.

ingredients.description: lemon grass, (inner core only), finely grated
lime, finely grated zest and juice

recipes.name: Crispy-skinned salmon
recipes.description: We have the chef's secrets on crispy-skinned salmon. With our clever tips you won't have to go out for dinner!
instructions: Place salmon, skin side up, on a plate. Drizzle with oil. Rub salt into skin.

Heat a large, non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Add salmon, skin side down. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until skin is crisp. Turn. Cook, covered for 4 to 5 minutes for medium or until cooked to your liking.

recipes.name: Herb-crusted salmon
recipes.description: Turn weeknights into a special occasion with this succulent salmon fillet.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Line a baking tray with baking paper.
Combine the breadcrumbs, parsley and chives in a bowl. Season both sides of the salmon fillets. Press the breadcrumb mixture onto the flesh sides of the salmon.
Place the salmon, skin-side down, onto the prepared baking tray. Spray with oil. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden and cooked through. Serve with the mayonnaise and lemon wedges

recipes.name: Lemon, garlic & butter baked salmon
recipes.description: Impress someone special with this delicious lemon, garlic & butter baked salmon dish.
instructions: Slice the lemon, crush the garlic, line a baking tray with foil and pre-heat the oven to 200C.

Place the asparagus in the tray, top with the salmon portions, sliced lemons, butter, crushed garlic and season with sea salt and scrunch the foil ends together. Create a dome that doesn't directly touch the fish.
Bake in the oven for 25 mins, tear open the foil and plate individual serves, finally garnish with dill.

recipes.name: Seafood in garlic butter
recipes.description: Simple equals special with help-yourself-seafood for the festive season.
instructions: Melt spread in a large deep saucepan over high heat. Add the mussels, prawns and wine or stock. Cover and cook, shaking the pan, for 8-10 minutes or until mussels are open and prawns are tender. Discard unopened mussels.
Use tongs to transfer the mussels and prawns to a deep serving dish. Stir the herb blend into the juices in the pan. Season with pepper. Pour over the seafood.

ingredients.description: prawns, peeled leaving tails intact, deveined

recipes.name: Seafood platter with aioli
recipes.description: Make the most of your barbecue this summer with a sizzling seafood platter.
instructions: Whisk oil, lemon rind, lemon juice and chives in a jug. Score inside flesh of calamari hoods in a criss-cross pattern. Cut into 3cm-wide pieces. Place calamari and prawns in a glass bowl. Place white fish and trout in another glass bowl. Pour half the oil mixture over calamari mixture. Toss to coat. Pour remaining oil mixture over fish mixture. Toss to coat. Cover bowls. Refrigerate for 15 minutes.

Preheat a lightly greased barbecue plate on medium-high. Cook calamari mixture, in batches, tossing, for 3 to 4 minutes or until just cooked through. Transfer to a bowl. Cover to keep warm. Add fish mixture to barbecue plate. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes each side or until cooked through.
Place seafood on a platter. Season with salt and pepper. Top with parsley. Serve with lemon wedges and Aioli.

ingredients.description: king prawns, peeled, tails intact, deveined

recipes.name: Avocado, prawn and scallop salad
recipes.description: Gather fresh shellfish for this impressive prawn and scallop salad with avocado.
instructions: Place the sesame seeds in a large frying pan over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, for about 2 minutes or until golden. Remove and set aside.
Divide the watercress, prawn, mango and avocado among serving dishes.

Heat the olive oil in the frying pan over high heat. Cook the scallop for about 1 minute each side or until golden and cooked through. Remove from the pan. Season the scallop with salt and pepper. Divide among the salads and drizzle with the lime juice and scatter over the sesame seeds.

ingredients.description: avocado, halved, stone removed, peeled, chopped

recipes.name: Fish and prawn tagine with apricots
recipes.description: A delightful blend of middle eastern flavours and seafood; cinnamon, dried fruits, cumin, tumeric and tomato. Serve with couscous, flat-leaf parsley and lemon wedges and you have a hearty, winter meal.
instructions: Place the apricot in a small bowl, cover with boiling water, then stand for 30 minutes to soak.

Place the tomatoe in a pan over medium heat. Add the cumin, turmeric, paprika and cinnamon. Season well. Add the apricot and its soaking liquid, stir to combine, then bring to the boil over medium-high heat.
Add the fish and prawn, then simmer gently over medium heat for 5-10 minutes until the broth is soupy and the fish and prawn are cooked through.
Meanwhile, place the couscous in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Cover with a plastic wrap and stand for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Divide the seafood and soup among bowls, scatter with the couscous and parsley, then serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Coconut, lime and chili barbecued prawns
recipes.description: Shell out less at the prawn broker for this handy, versatile meal solution.
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler, cut long strips of rind from lime. Combine coconut milk, coriander, garlic, chili, fish sauce, soy sauce and lime rind in a shallow dish. Reserve some of the mixture. Add prawns to remaining mixture. Toss to coat. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 3 to 4 hours, if time permits.

Preheat a barbecue plate or chargrill on medium-high heat. Add lime juice to prawn mixture. Toss to coat. Remove and discard lime rind from prawn mixture and reserved coconut milk mixture. Thread prawns onto skewers. Cook, brushing with reserved coconut milk mixture, for 2 to 3 minutes each side or until pink and lightly charred.
Serve skewers with lime wedges, coriander and rice.

ingredients.description: king prawns, peeled, tails intact, deveined

recipes.name: Mussels with saffron sauce
recipes.description: Bouillabaisse beware, this creamy mussel and saffron dish is a delicious shortcut to traditional seafood soups.
instructions: Soak the saffron in hot water in a small bowl. Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the shallots and the garlic and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes or until soft. Add the wine and bring to the boil. Increase heat to high. Add the mussels and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until the mussels open. Transfer the mussels to a heatproof bowl as they open to prevent overcooking. Set aside. Discard any unopened mussels.

Bring the liquid to the boil and cook for 15 minutes. Strain into a large saucepan. Return half the strained shallots to the saucepan and discard the remainder. Add the saffron and the cream and bring to the boil. Stir through the mussels to reheat.
Divide the mussels among shallow serving bowls. Pour over sauce and sprinkle with chopped parsley. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Prawn & kingfish choo-chee
recipes.description: This Thai seafood curry is traditionally served with a plate of raw vegetables to add texture and cool the palate.
instructions: Place the coconut cream in a heavy-based saucepan over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until it looks oily. Add the curry paste and cook, stirring occasionally, for 3 minutes, then stir in the fish sauce, the palm sugar and the water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk, bring to a simmer, then add the seafood. Reduce heat to low and cook for 10 minutes or until the seafood is almost cooked.
Stir in the basil, then divide among bowls and scatter with kaffir lime leaves. Serve curry with rice and raw vegetables on the side.

ingredients.description: king prawns, peeled with tails intact, cleaned

recipes.name: Low-fat barbecued prawns with lime, chili & coriander
recipes.description: A few of these prawns will spice up your average Sunday barbie, without adding to your waistline!
instructions: Combine the lemon juice, fish sauce, oil, lime leaves, garlic and chilies in a large ceramic or glass bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the prawns and toss gently until the prawns are coated in the marinade. Cover and place in the fridge for 30 minutes to marinate.

Heat a barbecue grill or chargrill on high. Cook the prawns in batches of 3-4 on preheated grill (depending on available space), brushing with the marinade, for 2-3 minutes each side or until they change colour, curl and shells are browned. Place the cooked prawns on a plate and cover loosely with foil to keep warm while cooking the remaining prawns.
Place the prawns on serving plates, sprinkle with the coriander and serve immediately with the lemon wedges if desired.

ingredients.description: kaffir lime leaves, deveined, finely shredded crossways
king prawns, peeled leaving head and tail intact, deveined

recipes.name: Singapore chili prawns
recipes.description: Cooking the sauces and ginger first releases the flavours for this 20 minute stir-fry.
instructions: Heat a wok over medium-high heat. Add oil. Swirl to coat. Add ginger, tomato, sweet chili sauce and fish sauce. Stir-fry for 2 minutes or until sauce boils and thickens slightly.
Add prawns. Stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until prawns are pink and cooked through.

recipes.name: Mussels steamed in cider & herbs
recipes.description: Have plenty of crusty bread on hand for soaking up the rich, aromatic broth in this super-healthy one-pot seafood dish.
instructions: Scrub and debeard the mussels.
Melt the dairy spread in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the leek and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes or until soft.

Add the mussels, cider and fennel leaves to the pan. Cover and cook, shaking the pan occasionally, for 3 minutes. Use tongs to transfer any opened mussels to a large serving bowl. Cook the remaining mussels, covered, for a further 3 minutes. Transfer the opened mussels to the bowl. Discard any unopened mussels. Pour any liquid from the pan over the mussels and sprinkle with chives. Serve immediately.

ingredients.description: leek, pale section only, halved lengthways, thinly sliced

recipes.name: Baby corn and toasted almond salad with wasabi dressing
recipes.description: Combine spicy Asian flavours and baby corn for a refreshing salad.
instructions: Heat a medium frying pan over medium heat. Add the almonds and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until toasted. Remove from heat and set aside for 10 minutes to cool. Coarsely chop.

Preheat a barbecue grill or chargrill on medium-high. Place the baby corn in a large bowl. Add 1 tablespoon of the oil and toss to combine. Cook one-third of the corn on preheated grill, turning occasionally, for 7 minutes or until tender. Transfer to a bowl and cover loosely with foil to keep warm. Repeat with remaining corn in 2 more batches.

Combine the almonds and corn in a large serving bowl. Combine the remaining oil, ginger, vinegar and wasabi paste in a jug. Drizzle the corn mixture with the dressing and toss to combine. Taste and season with salt.

recipes.name: Baked zucchini with lemon and mint
recipes.description: Roast zucchini is a delicious accompaniment to grilled chicken or fish.
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C/200°C fan-forced. Place the zucchini, onion, lemon rind, lemon juice and oil in a baking dish. Season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine. Roast for 18 to 20 minutes or until the zucchini is tender. Top with mint leaves. Serve.

recipes.name: Barbecued garlic and herb mushrooms
recipes.description: Barbecues are not just meant for meats - grill up this fabulous mushroom side with garlic, thyme and rosemary.
instructions: Preheat a barbecue chargrill on medium-high heat. Combine the oil, garlic, thyme and rosemary in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Brush the mushrooms with oil mixture.
Barbecue the mushrooms for 6 to 8 minutes, turning halfway during cooking, or until charred and just tender. Transfer to a plate. Serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Barbecued tofu
recipes.description: Spice up your night with chilli tofu dish.
instructions: Place the tofu, in a single layer, in a large glass or ceramic dish. Whisk the tamari, sugar, mustard powder, onion flakes and garlic powder in a jug and pour the mixture over the tofu. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the fridge for 4 hours or overnight to marinate.

Preheat a barbecue flat plate on medium-high. Brush the barbecue with the oil. cook the tofu for 3 minutes each side or until caramelised. Transfer the tofu to a serving platter and top with shallot. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and dried chili flakes.

recipes.name: Barbequed mushroom and pumpkin salad
recipes.description: This vegan pumpkin salad is full of healthy vegetables and tantalising spices.
instructions: Place 1/2 the pumpkin in a single layer onto a microwave safe plate. Cover and microwave on High for 4 minutes. Repeat with remaining pumpkin. Set aside for 5 minutes.

Place the mushrooms in a shallow dish. Combine 1/2 the olive oil, brown sugar, cumin and salt and pepper in a screw-top jar and shake well to combine. Pour the dressing over the mushrooms, toss well. Cover and set aside for 5 minutes.
Combine the remaining olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper in a screw-top jar, shake well to combine.

Preheat a barbeque plate on a medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms and cook, tossing frequently, for 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Add the pumpkin and cook 2-3 minutes on each side. Arrange the spinach, mushrooms and pumpkin onto serving plate. Drizzle the dressing.

recipes.name: Ginger tofu with mushrooms
recipes.description: A stir-fry like this one meets all your veggie needs and is easy to knock up after work
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the onion and garlic for 2 to 3 minutes or until just soft. Add the ginger and tofu. Stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the mushrooms, soy sauce and stir-fry sauce. Stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add the gai lan. Stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes or until gai lan is just tender. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place the noodles in a heatproof bowl. Cover with boiling water. Set aside for 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through. Using a fork, separate the noodles. Drain. Serve.

ingredients.description: ginger, peeled, cut into thin matchsticks

recipes.name: Grilled pepper salad
recipes.description: This colourful salad makes the dining table look festive.
instructions: Preheat a grill on high heat. Cut the pepper into quarters. Remove seeds. Arrange the pepper, in a single layer, skin side up, on grill tray. Grill for 10 minutes or until the skin is black and blistered.
Transfer the hot pepper to a plastic bag and twist top to seal. Stand for 10 minutes. Peel and discard the skin. Cut the flesh into long, thick strips. Place in a bowl.
Add the olives, capers, thyme, oil, vinegar and salt and pepper to the pepper. Stir gently to combine. Stand for at least 1 hour for flavours to develop. Serve.

ingredients.description: yellow bell pepper, or mix colors (i.e red, yellow or orange)

recipes.name: Grilled asparagus and tomato salad with preserved lemon
recipes.description: This delicious salad is ideal in summer when tomatoes are at their peak. The combo of herbs with the preserved lemon dressing is the secret to this salad, adding loads of flavour, without extra fat.
instructions: Preheat a chargrill or barbecue grill plate on high. Brush the bread slices and asparagus with 1 tbsp of the olive oil.

Grill the bread for 2 minutes each side or until lightly charred. Grill the asparagus for 1-2 minutes each side or until just tender. Transfer the bread and asparagus to a plate. Rub the bread with the cut side of the garlic clove and set aside to cool slightly.
Tear the bread into bite-size pieces. Combine the bread, asparagus, tomato, basil, parsley and caper in a large bowl. Season.
Whisk together the remaining olive oil, balsamic and preserved lemon. Add to the salad and gently toss to combine.

ingredients.description: lemon, quartered, pith removed, rinsed, finely chopped

recipes.name: Roast brussels sprouts with apples and red onion
recipes.description: Roasting brussels sprouts gives amazing caramelisation and flavour.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Line a large baking tray with foil. Place brussels sprout, apple and onion on the prepared tray. Drizzle with the oil and season well. Toss to combine.
Roast for 25 minutes, stirring once, or until brussels sprout is golden. Sprinkle with almond.

ingredients.description: red apple, cut into thick wedges
red onion, cut into thick wedges

recipes.name: Fusilli
recipes.description: Pasta side
instructions: Heat the water in a suitable sized pot. When the water is boiling add the salt, the olive oil and the pasta. Cook it for 6-10 minutes depending how you like it.

recipes.name: Spaghetti
recipes.description: Pasta side
instructions: Heat the water in a suitable sized pot. When the water is boiling add the salt, the olive oil and the pasta. Cook it for 6-10 minutes depending how you like it.

recipes.name: Tagliatelle
recipes.description: Pasta side
instructions: Heat the water in a suitable sized pot. When the water is boiling add the salt, the olive oil and the pasta. Cook it for 6-10 minutes depending how you like it.

recipes.name: Penne
recipes.description: Pasta side
instructions: Heat the water in a suitable sized pot. When the water is boiling add the salt, the olive oil and the pasta. Cook it for 6-10 minutes depending how you like it.

recipes.name: Conchiglie
recipes.description: Pasta side
instructions: Heat the water in a suitable sized pot. When the water is boiling add the salt, the olive oil and the pasta. Cook it for 6-10 minutes depending how you like it.

recipes.name: Long Grain Rice
recipes.description: This rice has milled grains that are at least three to four times as long as they are wide. Due to its starch composition, it is separate, light and fluffy when cooked.
instructions: Heat the water in a suitably sized pot. When the water is boiling add the rice. Cook it for 6-10 minutes depending how you like it. Alternatively use a rice cooker.

recipes.name: Brown Rice
recipes.description: This healthy rice sheds its outer husk and retains its bran and germ layers that give it a characteristic tan color. Though brown rice takes a little longer to cook than white rice, the nutrient-dense layers are rich in vitamins and minerals.
instructions: Heat the water in a suitably sized pot. When the water is boiling add the rice. Cook it for 6-10 minutes depending how you like it. Alternatively use a rice cooker.

recipes.name: Basmati Rice
recipes.description: A type of long-grain rice that is popular among Indian cuisine and other ethnic dishes. Cooked basmati rice imparts a subtle nutty or popcorn-like flavor and aroma.
instructions: Heat the water in a suitably sized pot. When the water is boiling add the rice. Cook it for 6-10 minutes depending how you like it. Alternatively use a rice cooker.

recipes.name: Jasmine Rice
recipes.description: Sometimes known as Thai fragrant rice, this is a type of long grain rice with a long kernel and slightly sticky texture when cooked. Use it to infuse a subtle jasmine flavor and aroma into your dishes.
instructions: Heat the water in a suitably sized pot. When the water is boiling add the rice. Cook it for 6-10 minutes depending how you like it. Alternatively use a rice cooker.

recipes.name: Medium Grain Rice
recipes.description: Shorter, wider kernel. Since the cooked grains are more moist and tender than long grain rice, the rice has a greater tendency to stick together
instructions: Heat the water in a suitably sized pot. When the water is boiling add the rice. Cook it for 6-10 minutes depending how you like it. Alternatively use a rice cooker.

recipes.name: Potatoes with Parsley
recipes.description: Boiled Potatoes with Parsley
instructions: Place the potato in a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain. Sprinkle on parsley and serve hot.

recipes.name: Honey Roasted Red Potatoes
recipes.description: These slightly sweet potatoes are perfect with most entrees.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly coat a baking dish with non-stick cooking spray.
Place potatoes in a single layer in the prepared dish, and top with onion. In a small bowl, combine the melted butter, honey, mustard, salt and pepper; drizzle over potatoes and onion.
Bake in the preheated 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) oven for 35 minutes or until tender, stirring halfway through the cooking time.

recipes.name: Garlic Red Potatoes
recipes.description: Simple, savory, and very flavorful variation on new red potatoes. Excellent side dish!
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Place potato in a baking dish.
In a small bowl combine the melted butter, garlic, salt and lemon juice; pour over the potatoes and stir to coat. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the potatoes.
Bake, covered, in a preheated oven for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake until golden brown and tender when pierced with a fork, about 10 minutes more.

recipes.name: Garlic Home Fries
recipes.description: Home fries with lots of flavor - a big hit every time
instructions: Melt the butter or margarine in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the potato and spread out in an even layer. Cover and cook for about 5 minutes. Season with garlic, paprika, salt and pepper; stir to coat potatoes evenly.

Cover and cook for another 15 minutes, turning potatoes occasionally. Remove cover, and mix in chives. Increase heat to medium-high and cook for another 10 minutes, stirring frequently, or until potatoes are tender.

recipes.name: Herby Roasted Potato Wedges
recipes.description: This recipe is an easy alternative to mashed potatoes or boiled potatoes. It is easy and good
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).
In a large bowl, toss the potato wedges with the oil. Arrange in a single layer in a roasting pan.
Bake in preheated oven for 50 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley, thyme, oregano, salt and pepper. Bake for 10 minutes, or until golden brown.

ingredients.description: potato, peeled and cut into wedges

recipes.name: Parsley and quinoa salad
recipes.description: Serve a side of this allergy-friendly quinoa salad to please everyone at the table.
instructions: Place quinoa and the cold water in a saucepan over high heat. Cover. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to low. Simmer for 10 to 12 minutes or until water has absorbed. Drain. Rinse. Transfer to a large bowl.
Place lemon juice and oil in a screw-top jar. Season with salt and pepper. Secure lid. Shake to combine. Add parsley, cucumber and dressing to quinoa. Toss to combine. Serve.

recipes.name: Quinoa Side Dish
recipes.description: Quinoa is a great alternative to rice - it's lighter, and cooks in about half the time.
instructions: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the quinoa, and toast, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in the broth, and bring to the boil. Reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes, or until the quinoa is tender.
In a bowl, toss the quinoa together with garlic, parsley, thyme, salt, and onion. Sprinkle with lemon juice, and serve.

recipes.name: Savoury Couscous
recipes.description: Simple cous cous perfect for side dish.
instructions: Heat the butter in a sauce pan (which has a lid). Add the chopped onions, stir and allow to cook until soft. Stir in the crushed garlic. Add the couscous and stir. Add the chicken stock, stir and bring to the boil. Remove off the heat, cover and allow to stand for 5 minutes. Stir in the coriander or parsley. Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Company Couscous
recipes.description: Couscous is the best! It is fast and tastes great. This recipe is savory and goes great with chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Stir the couscous into boiling water and return water to the boil. Cover and remove the pot from the heat. Let stand for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

While the couscous is cooking, heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in the garlic, green onions and peppers; saute briefly. Stir in the tomato, basil, cooked couscous, salt and pepper. Mix together and transfer to a casserole dish. Splash some balsamic vinegar on top.
Bake in a preheated 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) oven for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with the Parmesan cheese while still warm.

recipes.name: Easy fried rice
recipes.description: Even kids will love this quick and easy fried rice, perfect for a Tuesday night meal.
instructions: Cook the rice in a large saucepan of boiling water for 12 minutes or until tender. Drain and leave to cool.

Using a whisk, lightly beat the egg in a small bowl. Heat the oil in non-stick wok or large frying pan over medium heat. Add the egg. Swirl over the base to form an omelette. Cook for 2 minutes, turn over and cook for another 2 minutes until set. Transfer to a chopping board. Set aside to cool slightly. Cut into short strips.

Add the bacon to the wok. Cook for 4 minutes until light golden. Add the carrot. Stir fry for 1 minute. Add the shallots, peas and rice. Cook, stirring, for 3-4 minutes. Add the egg and soy sauce. Stir until heated through. Serve immediately, with extra soy.

ingredients.description: soy sauce, plus extra to serve

recipes.name: Kale, sun-dried tomato, pine nut and cranberry salad
recipes.description: This kale salad has amazing flavours and textures thanks to the crunchy pine nuts, sweet cranberries and vibrant sun-dried tomato.
instructions: Bunch the kale and roll before slicing crossways in thin strips.
Toss all ingredients into a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Dress with balsamic vinegar.
Refrigerate for 10 minutes before serving.

ingredients.description: carrot, peeled and shaved into ribbons with vegetable peeler

recipes.name: Mixed leaf Caesar salad
recipes.description: Try this quick and tasty meat-free alternative to the classic Caesar salad tonight.
instructions: Make a quick pickling liquid by combining the vinegar, lime juice and sugar in a small bowl.

Put a small pot of water on to boil. Once boiling, blanch the sliced onion for 30 seconds. Drain immediately and cool under running cold water. Immerse in pickling liquid, chill for 20 minutes and drain.
In a large bowl, toss together the mixed leaves, croutons, cranberries and Praise Deli Style Caesar dressing. Top with the pickled Spanish onions and fresh shaved parmesan cheese.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar pasta salad
recipes.description: Seize the day with this new take on the traditional Caesar salad.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees C.

Toss the chicken thighs in the olive oil and place in a baking tray. Season with salt and pepper and a pinch of smoked paprika on each. Roast for 20 minutes, drain on kitchen paper and chop into bite-sized pieces.

In a large bowl, toss the cos lettuce with half of the Caesar dressing. Add the onion, croutons, chicken and pasta and toss again. Drizzle remaining Caesar dressing on top and shave fresh parmesan on top. Garnish with flat leaf parsley and serve.

recipes.name: Egg hearts on toast with avocado & tomato salsa
recipes.description: Get cracking with this Mother's Day brekkie!
instructions: To make the salsa, combine the tomato, avocado, lemon juice and chives in a bowl.

Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Spray with oil. Spray a 6cm heart-shaped cutter(s) with oil. Place the cutter in the prepared pan. Carefully break an egg into the cutter. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until set
Meanwhile, toast the bread until golden. Spread with a little butter, if desired, and place on serving plates.
Use tongs to carefully lift the cutters away from the eggs. Top toast with an egg. Spoon over the salsa and sprinkle with parmesan.

ingredients.description: butter, (optional) at room temperature, to spread

recipes.name: Pesto scrambled eggs with spinach & avocado
recipes.description: This recipe combines fragrant pesto scrambled eggs with delicate spinach and delicious avocado.
instructions: Whisk the eggs and milk together in a bowl, season with salt and pepper. Heat a frying pan over a medium heat and spray lightly with olive oil spray.
Add the baby spinach leaves, cook stirring, until just wilted. Remove from pan.

Return pan to a medium heat, spray with a little more oil. Add egg mixture and using a wooden spoon, stir and bring the egg mixture on the edge of the pan to the centre. Continue until the eggs are almost set, add the pesto and baby spinach, and stir until just combined. Season to taste with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper. Serve immediately with toast, chopped avocado and an extra dollop of pesto if desired.

ingredients.description: basil pesto, plus extra to serve
avocado, firm ripe, stone removed, chopped

recipes.name: Poached eggs
recipes.description: Make perfect poached eggs for breakfast with our fabulous recipe and 'eggspert' tips!
instructions: Pour cold water into a saucepan until 8cm deep. Add vinegar. Bring to the boil over medium heat. Reduce heat to low (water should still be simmering around the edge).

Crack half the eggs into a shallow bowl. Using a wooden spoon, stir water to create a whirlpool. Tip egg into water. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes for a soft yolk or 3 to 4 minutes for firm. Using a slotted spoon, remove eggs from water.
Skim foam from water. Poach remaining eggs. Serve eggs on toast.

recipes.name: Porridge with banana topping
recipes.description: You'll go nuts for this porridge which has a banana, honey and macadamia topping. It takes just ten minutes to get this brekky ready.
instructions: Place oats, milk and fruit in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Bring to the boil. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until mixture is thick and creamy.
Make Banana topping: Place honey and nuts in a small, non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until heated through. Add banana. Toss to coat.
Top with banana topping.

recipes.name: Porridge with nuts & dates
recipes.description: This maple syrup nut and date porridge will have you ready to tackle the day head on!
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Spread the almonds and pistachio nuts in a single layer over a baking tray. Cook in preheated oven, tossing once, for 8 minutes or until lightly toasted and aromatic. Transfer to a chopping board and set aside for 10 minutes to cool slightly. Roughly chop and place in a small bowl. Add the dates and stir to combine.

Place the milk, oats and salt in a medium heavy-based saucepan. Stir over high heat until the mixture comes to the boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 10-12 minutes or until the mixture thickens.
Spoon the porridge into serving bowls and sprinkle with the nut and date mixture. Drizzle with maple syrup

recipes.name: Scrambled eggs with smoked salmon
recipes.description: Get the weekend off on the right foot with this tasty breakfast. It will equip you for whatever you've got planned this Saturday.
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, chives and salt and pepper in a jug until small bubbles appear.

Heat a non-stick frying pan over high heat. Reduce heat to low. Spray pan with oil. Beat egg mixture again and pour into pan. As egg begins to set, stir gently with a wooden spoon, tilting pan to allow uncooked egg to come in contact with the base. Cook until eggs form creamy curds. Remove pan from heat immediately.
Meanwhile, toast bread. Top toast with scrambled eggs, salmon and spinach. Season with salt and pepper. Serve.

recipes.name: The perfect herb omelette
recipes.description: Why do we think this is the perfect herb omelette? Try it for breakfast and you will find out.
instructions: Place the eggs in a bowl and lightly whisk to combine. Season with sea salt and some freshly ground black pepper.

Place the butter and oil in an omelette pan or a frying pan over medium-high heat (the oil prevents the butter from burning as the pan needs to be quite hot). When the butter starts to froth, add the egg mixture and, as the base begins to cook, use a fork to draw it aside and allow the uncooked egg to run beneath.
Continue doing this until the omelette is set but still soft.
Scatter the herbs on top, fold over one side of the omelette and carefully ease onto a plate.

recipes.name: Salad nicoise
recipes.description: Easy and fast salad for any meal of the day
instructions: Place the potatoes in a saucepan of cold water, bring to the boil and cook over medium heat for 7-8 minutes or until tender, adding the beans for the last two minutes of cooking time. Drain and refresh in cold water, then drain again.

Thickly slice the potatoes and place in a bowl with the beans, tomatoes, olives and tuna. Whisk together the olive oil and vinegar, season with salt and pepper. Toss the salad with the dressing and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Carrot salad
recipes.description: Create an amazing side dish with this sweet and zesty carrot salad.
instructions: Cook the cumin seeds in a dry frying pan over low heat for 2 mins or until fragrant and lightly toasted. Transfer to a plate to cool.
Place the lemon juice, oil, honey and spices in a small screw-top jar. Shake well to combine, and stand for 10 mins to develop the flavours.
Bring a saucepan of salted water to the boil and add the carrots. Return to the boil and cook for 5 mins or until just tender. Drain.
Toss the carrots in the dressing. Sprinkle with coriander and pistachios.

recipes.name: BLT salad
recipes.description: BLT is re-invented in this tasty salad main.
instructions: Place the mayonnaise, chives and some warm water in a bowl, and mix until well combined. Grill the bacon for 1-2 minutes or until crisp and golden, then tear into large pieces. Set aside and keep warm.
Arrange the lettuce, tomatoes, avocado and bacon on a serving plate. Top with crumbled egg, drizzle with the mayonnaise dressing and serve.

ingredients.description: coral lettuce, trimmed and leaves separated

recipes.name: Do-it-yourself Caesar salad
recipes.description: A simple Ceaser salad for everyone to enjoy
instructions: Preheat oven to 170°C.
Place bread slices on a baking tray, brush with oil. Place the bacon on a separate tray. Bake for 10-15 minutes until bread is golden brown and bacon is crisp.

Remove both trays from the oven and set aside the bacon. While the bread is still warm, rub with a half of the peeled garlic. Place in a serving bowl and set aside. Break the cooled bacon into pieces and place in a serving bowl.

Grate 3/4 of the parmesan and place in a food processor with mayonnaise, sour cream, remaining garlic clove, Dijon mustard and anchovies. Process to form a smooth dressing. Add some warm water if the dressing is too thick. Pour into a serving bowl and set aside.
Use a vegetable peeler to shave small pieces from the remaining parmesan and transfer to a serving bowl. Place the lettuce leaves in a serving bowl.

recipes.name: Beetroot salad
recipes.description: A flavourful beetroot salad salad.
instructions: Steam or boil beetroot until tender (this can take up to an hour). Rub skin gently to peel, then cut into small dice. Place in bowl and add onion and fresh herbs.
In a separate bowl, combine oils and lemon juice, and season. Toss beetroot and walnuts in the dressing; sprinkle with rosewater just before serving.

recipes.name: Couscous salad
recipes.description: This tasty couscous salad is a colourful addition to the dinner table.
instructions: Place the couscous in a bowl. Place the stock and half the olive oil in a saucepan, bring to just boiling point, then pour over the couscous. Cover and set aside for 10 minutes.
Fluff couscous with a fork and season with salt and pepper. When couscous is completely cold, stir in the cucumber, onion, pepper, tomato and parsley.
In a separate bowl, combine the remaining olive oil, the lemon juice and hummus, add to the couscous and stir until well combined

ingredients.description: yellow bell pepper, seeds removed, diced

recipes.name: Mexican salad
recipes.description: Filling, delicious, and full of goodness - what more could you ask of salad?
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C/160°C fan-forced. Lightly spray muffin pan. Gently push tortilla in muffin pan. Lightly spray with oil. Bake for 8 minutes or until golden. Remove from oven. Cool in pan.
Heat a chargrill pan over high heat. Cook corn, turning, for 10 minutes or until cooked through. Cut kernels from cob.
Place corn kernels, beans and avocado in a bowl. Combine sweet chili sauce, lemon juice and oil in a jug. Add to corn mixture. Toss to combine.
Combine tomato, onion and coriander in a bowl. Transfer tortilla to plate. Serve with tomato mixture.

ingredients.description: corn on the cob, husk and silk removed
canned red kidney beans, drained, rinsed

recipes.name: Nicoise salad
recipes.description: Master the classic Nicoise salad complete with buttermilk dressing.
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large saucepan. Cover with cold water. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 12 minutes or until tender. Drain. Set aside to cool. Cut each potato in half crossways.
Cook the beans in a saucepan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes or until bright green and tender crisp. Refresh under cold running water. Drain.
Place the buttermilk, mustard and chives in a bowl. Whisk to combine.
Combine the potato, beans, tuna, tomato and rocket in a large bowl.
Divide the salad among serving bowls and drizzle over the dressing. Serve immediately.

ingredients.description: canned tuna in brine, drained, flaked

recipes.name: Eggplant salad
recipes.description: This spicy salad tastes fantastic with fresh mint and a dollop of yoghurt.
instructions: Cut eggplant into 1 1/2cm cubes. Place in a colander over a sink, sprinkle generously with salt and toss eggplant to coat. Leave for 30 minutes to disgorge.
Preheat the oven to 200°C.

Rinse the eggplant well to remove all the salt, place in a tea towel and squeeze to remove as much water as possible. Lay out on a baking tray and drizzle with half of the oil. Roast for 25 minutes until soft and tinged golden.

Meanwhile, heat remaining oil in a pan over medium heat. Add onion and cook for 2-3 minutes until it starts to soften. Add dry spices and cook for a few seconds to release flavours. Add tomato and garlic and cook over low heat for 6-8 minutes until thick. Season with salt and pepper and stir in coriander. Set aside.
Remove eggplant from oven, then add to tomato mixture. Stir in mint. Serve at room temperature with yoghurt.

recipes.name: Tuna salad
recipes.description: This tried and tested tuna salad is a weekly menu staple.
instructions: Preheat oven to hot, 200C.
Combine  peeled, cubed pumpkin and olive oil in a baking dish. Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden and tender.
In a large bowl, combine washed and dried leaves of a baby cos lettuce, drained can baby beetroot, quartered, a drained and flaked can tuna and  sliced lebanese cucumber.

Toss pumpkin and crumbled feta (or goats cheese) through. In a jug, whisk together the remaining  olive oil, balsamic vinegar, maple syrup and  crushed garlic clove using a fork. Drizzle over salad before serving, tossing well.

ingredients.description: canned tuna in brine, drained and flaked

recipes.name: Monk's salad
recipes.description: Mezze is more than just food, it's a way of life. Learn secrets to the art of grazing with this tasty recipe.
instructions: Using a fork, prick eggplant skins all over, then place each one directly over a medium gas flame. Cook, turning every couple of minutes with tongs, for 12 minutes or until skin is charred and blackened, and flesh is soft when pierced with a skewer. (If you don’t have a gas stove top, cook eggplants over a barbecue grill plate.) Place the eggplants in a bowl and cool.

Peel skin from eggplants, then place flesh in a sieve over a bowl for a few seconds to drain excess moisture. Using your hands, shred eggplant into strips. Place in a single layer in a large bowl with tomatoes, mint and spring onions.
Drizzle the monk’s salad with pomegranate molasses and olive oil, then season with salt to serve.

recipes.name: Burrata salad
recipes.description: This beautiful pumpkin and burrata salad is dressed in a zesty combination of orange juice, balsamic vinegar and garlic.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C or 180C fan. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Place pumpkin on tray. Drizzle with half of the oil and season. Toss to coat and arrange in a single layer. Roast for 35 minutes.
Meanwhile, wrap garlic in foil. Roast along side pumpkin for 20 minutes or until tender.

Combine remaining oil with vinegar and orange juice in a small bowl. Being careful not to burn yourself, open garlic parcel. Squeeze out flesh and discard skin. Add flesh to dressing and season. Whisk with a fork to combine.
Arrange rocket, roasted pumpkin, burrata and red onion on a serving plate. Drizzle over dressing. Top with mint, pistachios and pepitas.

recipes.name: Cobb salad
recipes.description: This traditional cobb salad is a delicious combination of chicken, bacon, avo and soft-boiled eggs.
instructions: Heat a char-grill pan on medium-high. Light brush chicken with oil. Season well, with salt and pepper. Cook chicken on grill for 3-4 minutes each side or until just cooked through. Transfer to a plate and cover with foil. Set aside for 5 minutes to rest.
Meanwhile, cook bacon on the char-grill for 2 minutes each side or until crisp. Remove from heat.
Thinly slice the chicken and tear bacon into pieces. Arrange chicken, bacon, avocado, lettuce, tomato and egg on serving plates. Drizzle with dressing and serve immediately.

ingredients.description: avocado, ripe, halved, stoned, peeled, sliced

recipes.name: Rice salad
recipes.description: Easy rice salad
instructions: Remove husk and silk from corn and brush with half of the oil. Season with salt and pepper, wrap in foil, then cook on barbecue for 10 minutes, turning occasionally. Carefully remove foil, place corn directly on grill plate and cook for a further 5 minutes, turning, just until lightly charred. Remove, allow to cool, then run a knife lengthways down cob to remove kernels. Place the kernels in a bowl and discard cob.

Cook rice in boiling salted water for 10 minutes or until tender. Drain, refresh, then drain again. Place in a bowl with kernels. Stir through spring onions and parsley, add lime juice and remaining olive oil, then season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Beef salad
recipes.description: Sweet and spicy dressing on this grilled steak salad will make your taste-buds sing.
instructions: Combine sauces, juice and sugar in a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until required.
Combine cucumber, tomatoes, avocado, pepper, onion and salt and pepper in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate until required.

Preheat a barbecue or chargrill on high. Season steaks with salt and pepper and cook for 3 to 4 minutes on each side for medium, or to taste. Remove to a plate, cover with foil and rest for 10 minutes.
Thinly slice beef across the grain. Place salad onto serving platter, top with beef and drizzle with dressing. Sprinkle with coriander and serve.

recipes.name: Minestrone salad
recipes.description: Everyone loves a hearty minestrone soup. This recipe takes all the best elements to create a vibrant, healthy pasta salad.
instructions: Cook the macaroni in salted boiling water following packet directions or until al dente. Drain and refresh in cold water, then toss with a dash of the olive oil.

Heat a dash of olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-low heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook, stirring for 1-2 minutes, until softened. Add the carrots and zucchini and cook, stirring, for a further 5 minutes. Add the beans and 60ml (1/4 cup) water and continue cooking until the water has evaporated and the vegetables are tender. Transfer the vegetables to a plastic bowl, add the corn kernels, canned beans and cherry tomatoes.
In a separate bowl, combine the remaining olive oil, red-wine vinegar and pesto. Pour over the salad, add the parmesan and toss well together.

recipes.name: Pasta salad
recipes.description: Try this low fat pasta.
instructions: Cook pasta in a saucepan, following packet directions, until just tender. Drain. Transfer to a bowl.
Bring a saucepan of water to the boil. Add corn and beans. Cook for 1 minute or until beans are bright green. Drain. Rinse under cold running water to refresh. Drain. Pat dry with paper towel.
Add corn, beans, ham, pepper, tomato and parsley to warm pasta. Toss until well combined. Add avocado, dressing and salt and pepper. Toss gently to combine. Serve.

ingredients.description: corn on the cob, kernels removed
snap beans, trimmed, cut into 3cm pieces
red bell pepper, cut into thin strips

recipes.name: Kedgeree salad
recipes.description: Kedgeree is a classic curried rice and fish dish. We've cut back the cooking time for a super-healthy version you can make in minutes.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Add the curry powder and cook, stirring, for 30 seconds or until aromatic.
Add the rice and stock and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed. Add the peas and salmon, and stir until just combined.
Divide the spinach among serving plates. Top with the rice mixture and serve with lemon wedges.

ingredients.description: lemon, cut into quarters, to serve

recipes.name: Three-bean salad
recipes.description: Broad beans, green beans and cannellini beans unite in this fibre-rich side dish.
instructions: Cook the broad beans in a large saucepan of salted boiling water for 4 minutes or until tender. Refresh under cold running water. Drain. Peel and discard the skins.
Cook the green beans in a saucepan of salted boiling water for 2 minutes or until bright green and tender crisp. Refresh under cold running water. Drain and pat dry with paper towel.
Whisk together the oil, pesto and lemon juice in a small bowl. Taste and season with salt and pepper.
Combine the broad beans, green beans, cannellini beans and watercress in a bowl. Drizzle over the dressing and toss to combine. Serve.

recipes.name: Orange and almond salad
recipes.description: This everyday-easy salad recipe is the perfect side dish or light snack.
instructions: Fry bacon until crispy, wait until cool and cut roughly.
Combine all ingredients in a salad bowl. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.name: Fruit smoothie
recipes.description: Healthy delicious Fruit smoothie,  enjoy!
instructions: Blend papaya, banana, yoghurt, psyllium husks and orange juice together until smooth. Pour into chilled glass. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Mango passionfruit smoothie
recipes.description: Classic and healty Mango passionfruit smoothie
instructions: Place mango, frozen yoghurt and milk in a blender. Blend until smooth and thick. Pour into glasses and serve.

recipes.name: Peach and honey smoothie
recipes.description: Here's a healthy delicious drink that is simply meant to be enjoyed!
instructions: Blend peach, yoghurt, honey and milk together until smooth. Pour into a chilled  glass. Serve

ingredients.description: canned peach, slices in juice, drained

recipes.name: Berry thickshake
recipes.description: This nutritious shake is a big hit with the kids.
instructions: Place berries in a blender. Add milk and scoops frozen yoghurt. Blend until smooth.

recipes.name: Blueberry and banana milkshake
recipes.description: Just because you have a dairy intolerance doesn't mean you have to miss out on this berry banana milkshake.
instructions: Blend rice milk, frozen blueberries, banana and honey together until smooth. Pour into a chilled glass. Serve.

recipes.name: Dairy-free berry smoothie
recipes.description: This delicious, health-boosting brekky drink is worth getting out of bed for.
instructions: Blend frozen berries, apple juice and cranberry juice together until smooth. Pour into chilled glasses. Top with thawed berries. Serve.

ingredients.description: frozen mixed berries, thawed, to serve

recipes.name: Smoked salmon and cucumber bagels
recipes.description: Whip up these delicious high tea bagels in super fast time to create an elegant afternoon tea.
instructions: Spread bagel bases with cream cheese.
Top with salmon and cucumber. Season. Top with onion, capers and bagel tops. Serve.

ingredients.description: red onion, cut into thin rings

recipes.name: Bacon, egg and balsamic tomato baguettes
recipes.description: A bacon and egg sandwich with a balsamic twist? The perfect way to enjoy the weekend and cure a hangover!
instructions: Heat oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Add tomatoes. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 3 to 4 minutes or until tender. Add vinegar and cook for 1 minute. Transfer to a bowl. Wipe pan clean.

Heat frying pan over medium heat. Add bacon. Cook, turning occasionally, for 4 to 5 minutes or until crisp. Drain on paper towel. Wipe pan clean with paper towel. Spray pan with oil and heat over medium-high heat. Add egg and cook for 2 minutes or until white set and yolks still soft (or to your liking).
Grill or toast cut side of bread. Place on plates. Top with bacon, egg and tomatoes. Season with pepper.

recipes.name: Brekkie sandwich
recipes.description: Quick and easy, this hearty breakfast sandwich will satisfy even the hungriest among us.
instructions: Heat the oil and halft of the butter in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring often, for 8-10 minutes or until soft and golden. Season well with salt and pepper. Transfer to a bowl. Cover with foil to keep warm.

Heat remaining butter in the frying pan over medium-high heat. Crack eggs into pan and cook for 2-3 minutes or until bases are crisp and golden. Turn over and cook for a further 1 minute, if desired. Remove from the pan and keep warm. Add ham to pan and cook for 1-2 minutes each side or until light golden and warmed through.

Meanwhile, toast bread. Butter one side of each slice of bread. Top halft the slices with the spinach leaves, mushrooms, ham and egg. Serve the remaining slices of toast off to the side. Serve immediately

recipes.name: Classic turkey club sandwich
recipes.description: Shaved turkey breast is an exciting addition to the classic club sandwich.
instructions: Heat a large, non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Add bacon and cook, turning occasionally, for 4 to 5 minutes or until crisp. Drain on paper towel.

Toast bread. Place 2 slices toast on a board. Spread with half the mayonnaise and top with half the lettuce. Top with turkey and another slice of toast. Spread top with mayonnaise. Top with bacon, tomato and remaining lettuce. Spread 1 side of remaining toast with remaining mayonnaise. Place, mayonnaise side-down, on sandwiches. Secure sandwiches with toothpicks. Cut in half and serve

recipes.name: Club sandwich
recipes.description: Looking for an interesting lunch idea? The classic club sandwich never goes out of fashion.
instructions: Preheat a grill tray on medium. Place bread under grill and cook for 1-2 minutes each side or until lightly toasted.
Spray both sides of bacon lightly with oil. Place under grill and cook for 2-3 minutes each side or until slightly crisp. Drain on some paper towel.
Spread a slices of toast with the mayonnaise. Arrange half of the lettuce, turkey and tomatoes over slice. Season with salt and pepper.

Top with a second slice of toast with mayonnaise. Then remaining lettuce, bacon and tomato. Season well with salt and pepper. Top with remaining piece of toast. Use toothpicks to secure. Cut each sandwich in half

recipes.name: Elvis's fried peanut butter and banana sandwiches
recipes.description: With a tasty combination of peanut butter and banana, it's easy to see why this was a favourite treat for the king of rock'n'roll.
instructions: Spread half the butter on a silce of bread.
Spread peanut butter over the other slice of bread, leaving a 1cm-wide border around the edges. Top with banana and the buttered bread, butter-side up.

Heat the remaining butter in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat until foaming. Add sandwich, butter-side up, and cook for 2 minutes or until golden. Turn and cook for 2 minutes or until golden. Transfer to a plate.
Cut the sandwiches in half diagonally and serve.

recipes.name: Ham, semi-dried tomato and mozzarella focaccia
recipes.description: Perfect breakfast
instructions: Preheat sandwich press. Spread cut sides of focaccia with mayonnaise. Top bases with ham, tomatoes, capers and mozzarella. Season with pepper.
Sandwich with focaccia tops and place in hot sandwich press. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until toasted and heated through. Serve.

recipes.name: Macaroni cauliflower cheese
recipes.description: Mac and cheese is a winner with most families - this one contains hidden vegetables as an added healthy bonus.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200C/180C Fan/Gas 6. Lightly grease a 2 litre/3½ pint shallow ovenproof dish with butter.
Half fill a large saucepan with water and bring to the boil. Add the cauliflower florets and boil for 10-12 minutes, or until very soft. Drain and set aside.
Half-fill the same pan with water and return to the boil. Add the macaroni and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until al dente.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a saucepan over a low heat, then whisk in the flour until the mixture forms a smooth paste. Cook, whisking constantly, for 30 seconds.

Gradually whisk in the milk a little at a time, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer and waiting for it to thicken after each addition. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until all of the milk has been incorporated and the sauce has thickened enough to coat the back of a spoon (about 6-8 minutes).
Stir in two-thirds of the cheese, then season with salt and pepper.

Add the cauliflower to the sauce, blend until smooth using a hand-held blender. Warm the mixture through gently, adding a little more seasoning or milk, as required. The finished sauce should have the consistency of pouring custard.

Drain the pasta and transfer to the ovenproof dish. Pour over the sauce and stir to combine. Sprinkle over the remaining cheese. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden-brown and the sauce is bubbling.

ingredients.description: cauliflower, leaves and stalk removed, cut into florets
macaroni, or similar small pasta shapes

recipes.name: Roasted cauliflower and lentil salad with red pepper sauce
recipes.description: This hearty, spiced vegan salad with a rich, tangy dressing is full of goodness and perfect for winter.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200C/180C Fan/Gas 6.

Arrange the cauliflower florets on a baking tray. Rub each with a little coconut oil and sprinkle over the cumin and salt. Roast for 25-30 minutes, turning the florets halfway through cooking, until browned all over and tender when pierced in the centre with a sharp knife.
Meanwhile, for the sauce, arrange the red pepper quarters on a baking tray and sprinkle with salt. Roast in the oven for 12-15 minutes, or until soft with blackened, loosened skins.

Drain the lentils and rinse thoroughly in cold water. Put in a large saucepan and pour over cold water. Add the bay leaf. Bring to the boil, then reduce and simmer for 12-15 minutes, or until tender. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl. Sprinkle over the sea salt and drizzle with olive oil, stirring well to coat the lentils. Set aside.

Transfer the roasted peppers to a food processor. Drain the cashew nuts and rinse thoroughly. Add the cashew nuts and remaining sauce ingredients to the food processor, blending until smooth and thick. Season with salt and pepper. Add a dash of cold water if the sauce is too thick.
Just before serving, stir the roasted cauliflower and parsley into the lentils.
Spoon the salad onto serving plates, drizzle a little of the red-pepper sauce over each portion and serve.

ingredients.description: cauliflower, leaves and stalk removed, cut into florets
red bell pepper, preferably Romano, stalk and seeds removed, cut lengthways into quarters

recipes.name: Braised steak with gravy
recipes.description: Braising steak is slow to cook but quick to prepare in this rich, traditional dish from The Hairy Bikers.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170C/325F/Gas 3.
Trim off any hard fat from the beef and season on both sides with salt and lots of freshly ground black pepper.
Heat a tablespoon of the oil in a large non-stick frying pan.

Fry the steaks, two at a time, over a medium-high heat for a couple of minutes on each side, or until nicely browned, then transfer to a large flameproof casserole dish. Add a little more oil to the pan if necessary.
Return the pan to the hob and reduce the heat. Add the remaining oil and gently fry the onion for five minutes, or until softened and lightly browned, stirring regularly.
Stir in the garlic, cook for one more minute, then transfer the onion and garlic to the casserole dish.
Pour over the stock and add the tomato purée, thyme and bay leaf.
Bring to the boil, then cover the casserole and transfer carefully to the oven. Cook for 1¼-1½ hours, or until the beef is very tender.

Mix the cornflour and mustard powder in a small bowl and stir in a tablespoon of cold water until smooth. Remove the lid from the casserole dish and stir in the cornflour mixture. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Place the casserole over a medium-high heat and simmer for 2-3 minutes, or until the gravy reduces and becomes thickened and glossy, stirring regularly.
Transfer the steaks to four warmed plates and spoon over the gravy.

recipes.name: Viennese gulasch
recipes.description: The people of Vienna love gulasch so much they’ve taken the Hungarian dish and made it their own. The secret is to use lots of onion. If you don't like your food too hot, then reduce the amount of paprika to suit your taste.
instructions: Heat the lard in a large pot and fry the onions until they are deep golden brown. Add the garlic, cook for a minute, then add the tomato purée, paprikas, crushed caraway seeds, sugar, salt, pepper and vinegar and cover with water.

Bring to a boil, then add the beef. Turn down to a gentle simmer and cook for 2½ hours. Check the pan fairly frequently and stir, adding more water to cover the meat if necessary. Check the meat for tenderness, if not tender add a little more water and cook for a little longer. Remove the meat when done and, if needed, continue to cook the liquid to thicken the sauce.
Serve sprinkled with a little chopped parsley with new potatoes, spatzle or dark rye bread.

ingredients.description: caraway seeds, crushed in a pestle and mortar
shin of beef, cut into 3cm/1in pieces

recipes.name: Rich beef and mushroom stew
recipes.description: This is a rich and comforting stew that is smart enough to serve for a dinner party.
instructions: Cut the beef into 2.5cm/1in chunks and trim off any excess fat. Place the flour on a plate or in a plastic bag with plenty of salt and black pepper and toss the meat in it until well coated.

Heat the oil in a large flameproof casserole and add the beef. Fry until browned on all sides - you may need to do this in batches, as you don’t want to over-crowd the pan. It is important to brown the beef and not stew it.
Remove the meat from the pan using a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the shallots, celery and carrots to the pan and fry for five minutes, or until softened a little.
Meanwhile, soak the mushroom in a bowl in boiling water until softened. Drain, reserving the soaking liquid and chop the mushrooms into smaller pieces.

Return the meat to the pan and add the red wine or stout. Bring to the boil for 4-5 minutes, or until the volume of liquid has reduced by about a third. Add the stock,soaked mushrooms and their soaking liquid and the thyme.
Bring to the boil and then cover and simmer on a low heat for about 2½ hours, or until tender. If you prefer you can cook it in a preheated oven at 150C/300F/Gas 3 (130 fan) for the same time.
Add the button mushrooms and the redcurrant jelly and cook for a further 30 minutes

recipes.name: Moroccan-style chicken casserole
recipes.description: Make a double batch of Nigel's tasty chicken casserole - eat some and freeze the rest.
instructions: For the spice paste, crush the garlic cloves and sea salt with a pestle in a mortar. Add the smoked paprika, turmeric and cumin seeds and grind to a paste. Add just enough olive or groundnut oil to make the paste runny enough to pour, but thick enough to coat the chicken.

For the casserole, place the chicken thighs into a bowl, pour the spice paste over them and toss well to coat all of the meat. Cover with cling film and leave to marinate in the fridge for as long as time allows, overnight if possible.

Heat the olive oil in a large shallow pan, then cook the onions until softened. Add the chicken thighs and cook until coloured lightly on both sides. Add the lemon slices and pour in enough water to come halfway up the chicken pieces. Stir in the saffron, then season well, cover with a lid and simmer for about 25 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. Add the olives and fresh coriander and serve.

ingredients.description: chicken thigh, bone in and skin on
lemon, cut in half, thinly sliced

recipes.name: Broad bean and goats’ cheese bruschetta
recipes.description: A Persian take on this classic Italian starter, but still just as fresh and summery.
instructions: Heat a large saucepan filled with boiling water. Blanch the beans very briefly (just to soften, not to cook them through). Drain and set aside to cool.

Roast the chili over a direct flame on the hob until blackened a little, but not completely charred. Alternatively, char them under a hot grill. Slice open and remove the seeds. Cut the flesh into thin ribbons.
Mix the chili, garlic, spring onion, lemon zest and juice together. Add the oregano and broad beans and lightly crush them as you mix. You don’t want a smooth purée, but it needs to hold together.
Heat a large griddle pan and drizzle the sliced sourdough with a little olive oil. Place on the griddle and cook on both sides for 1-2 minutes, or until the bar marks appear.
Remove from the heat and spread with the goats’ cheese. Top with the broad bean mixture and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken kiev
recipes.description: Chicken kiev is a lot easier to make than you may think and tastes so much better than shop-bought, plus your efforts will be rewarded with garlic butter goodness.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190C/370F/Gas 5.

For the chicken, remove the mini-fillet at the back of the chicken breasts and set aside. Using a sharp knife, slice open the breasts so that they can be opened up like a book from the top to the bottom. Gently bash the breasts out with a meat mallet or rolling pin so they are flat.
Repeat the flattening process with the mini-fillets. These little fillets will be used as sticking plasters to stop the butter from oozing during cooking.

For the herb butter, place the parsley, butter, garlic, Dijon mustard and the salt and pepper into a bowl and mix together well. Divide the butter mixture into four thumb-sized pieces and place into the fridge to chill and set.
Turn each flattened chicken breast over and put a roll of herb butter in the centre of each and then roll up like a cigar. Cover any holes with the flattened fillet pieces.
Dredge the breasts in flour and place into the freezer for 2-3 minutes to cool.
Meanwhile beat the egg and milk together in a bowl.
Remove the floured chicken from the freezer and dip in the egg mixture to coat thoroughly.
Roll the breasts in the breadcrumbs, making sure that they are well coated, then place in the fridge for 30 minutes.
