instructions: Place oats, milk and fruit in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Bring to the boil. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until mixture is thick and creamy.
Make Banana topping: Place honey and nuts in a small, non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until heated through. Add banana. Toss to coat.
Top with banana topping.

recipes.name: Porridge with nuts and dates
recipes.description: This maple syrup nut and date porridge will have you ready to tackle the day head on!
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Spread the almonds and pistachio nuts in a single layer over a baking tray. Cook in preheated oven, tossing once, for 8 minutes or until lightly toasted and aromatic. Transfer to a chopping board and set aside for 10 minutes to cool slightly. Roughly chop and place in a small bowl. Add the dates and stir to combine.

Place the milk, oats and salt in a medium heavy-based saucepan. Stir over high heat until the mixture comes to the boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 10-12 minutes or until the mixture thickens.
Spoon the porridge into serving bowls and sprinkle with the nut and date mixture. Drizzle with maple syrup

recipes.name: The perfect herb omelette
recipes.description: Why do we think this is the perfect herb omelette? Try it for breakfast and you will find out.
instructions: Place the eggs in a bowl and lightly whisk to combine. Season with sea salt and some freshly ground black pepper.
Put oil in an omelette pan or a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the egg mixture and, as the base begins to cook, use a fork to draw it aside and allow the uncooked egg to run beneath.
Continue doing this until the omelette is set but still soft.
Scatter the herbs on top, fold over one side of the omelette and carefully ease onto a plate.

recipes.name: Vegan fruit smoothie
recipes.description: Healthy delicious Fruit smoothie,  enjoy!
instructions: Blend papaya, banana, yoghurt, psyllium husks and orange juice together until smooth. Pour into chilled glass. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Vegan mango smoothie
recipes.description: Classic and healty Mango passionfruit smoothie
instructions: Place mango, yoghurt and milk in a blender. Blend until smooth and thick. Pour into glasses and serve.

recipes.name: Vegan peach smoothie
recipes.description: Here's a healthy delicious drink that is simply meant to be enjoyed!
instructions: Blend peach, yoghurt, syrup and milk together until smooth. Pour into a chilled  glass. Serve

ingredients.description: canned peach, slices in juice, drained

recipes.name: Vegan berry thickshake
recipes.description: This nutritious shake is a big hit with the kids.
instructions: Place berries in a blender. Add milk and scoops frozen yoghurt. Blend until smooth.

recipes.name: Vegan blueberry and banana milkshake
recipes.description: Just because you have a dairy intolerance doesn't mean you have to miss out on this berry banana milkshake.
instructions: Blend rice milk, frozen blueberries, banana and honey together until smooth. Pour into a chilled glass. Serve.

recipes.name: Vegan cauliflower soup
recipes.description: This cauliflower soup is a quick, easy, and comforting winter dish
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Add onion and garlic. Cook, stirring, for 3 minutes or until onion has softened. Add cauliflower and potato. Cook, stirring, for 5 minutes.
Add stock. Season with pepper. Cover. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to medium-low. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until potato is tender. Set aside for 5 minutes to cool slightly.
Blend, in batches, until smooth. Return to pan over low heat. Add pure cream. Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes or until heated through. Serve.

recipes.name: Vegan beetroot soup
recipes.description: Get excited for the cooler weather with this vibrant beetroot and fennel soup.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180C. Wrap each beetroot in foil. Place on a baking tray. Bake for 1 hour or until tender. Set aside for 10 mins to cool. Wearing rubber gloves, peel and coarsely chop.

Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add fennel, carrot and celery. Cook, stirring, for 5 mins or until fennel softens. Add garlic. Cook, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant. Add beetroot and stock. Increase heat to high. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to medium. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 25-30 mins or until vegetables are tender.
Carefully use a stick blender to blend the mixture until smooth. Add the orange juice and stir to combine. Taste and season.
Ladle soup evenly among serving bowls. Top with a dollop of sour cream. Sprinkle with reserved fennel fronds and orange zest. Serve immediately.

ingredients.description: baby fennel, fronds reserved, finely chopped

recipes.name: Vegan roasted garlic and tomato soup
recipes.description: Warm up this winter with this delicious roasted garlic & tomato soup.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C or 160°C fan. Place tomato in a small roasting pan. Drizzle over vinegar and the oil. Season. Top with tarragon. Place garlic bulb in 1 corner of pan. Bake for 30 mins or until garlic is soft.

Remove garlic from pan and cool slightly. Transfer tomato and juices to a large saucepan. Squeeze garlic from skins into the saucepan. Add stock. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 mins. Blend with a stick blender until smooth. Season.
Meanwhile, place the baguette on a baking tray. Drizzle over the remaining oil and bake for 5 mins or until lightly toasted. Spread the pesto over the hot toasts and top with the parmesan.
Ladle the soup into bowls. Top with extra oil and tarragon. Season with pepper. Serve with the toasts.

ingredients.description: olive oil, plus extra to serve
tarragon, plus extra leaves to serve (optional)

recipes.name: Vegan  smashing pumpkin soup
recipes.description: Pumpkin season is in full swing so make a big batch of our sweet-flavoured soup, then dress it up with dukkah for a warming dinner that's as easy as 1-2-3.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Cook onion, stirring, for 5 minutes or until golden. Add cumin and cook, stirring for 1 minute or until aromatic.
Simmer the soup: Add pumpkin and stir to coat. Add stock. Simmer for 20 minutes or until the pumpkin is soft. Set aside to cool slightly. Use a stick blender to blend until smooth.

ingredients.description: butternut squash, peeled, seeded, coarsely chopped
extra virgin olive oil, to drizzle on bread

recipes.name: Vegan autumn tomato and vegetable soup
recipes.description: Enjoy robust tomato flavours and the best of autumn produce in this hearty vegetable soup.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Add onion, garlic and celery. Cook, stirring, for 3 to 5 minutes or until onion has softened. Add zucchini and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 4 to 5 minutes or until vegetables start to soften.

Add stock, sauce and cold water. Cover. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to low. Simmer for 10 minutes or until vegetables are just tender. Add pasta and peas. Simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes or until pasta is just tender. Stir in spinach. Serve topped with parmesan.

recipes.name: Vegan broccoflower, leek and fennel soup
recipes.description: Broccoflowers incorporate the best elements of cauliflower and broccoli. Being naturally low-fat means that they are the perfect ingredient for this low kilojoule soup.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan or casserole. Add leek, fennel and garlic. Cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes, or until soft. Add broccoflower, stock and bay leaves. Cover, bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes, or until broccoflower is tender. Remove and discard bay leaves.
Blend or process soup until smooth; season to taste. Divide soup between bowls, spoon a little sour cream into the centre of each and grind over extra black pepper. Serve with crusty bread.

ingredients.description: fennel bulb, trimmed, halved, thinly sliced

recipes.name: Vegan simple miso, tofu and mushroom ramen
recipes.description: Serve the family something different for dinner: a rich miso and mushroom broth with golden tofu and soft-boiled eggs.
instructions: Put the dried mushrooms in a large, heavy-based saucepan and cover with the water. Add the soy sauce, stock cube and miso paste and stir until the stock cube has dissolved. Set aside for 30 minutes to rehydrate and infuse.

Meanwhile, half-fill a saucepan with water and bring to the boil. Add the noodles and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until just tender, stirring occasionally to break up the strands. Drain well, then rinse under running water until cold.
Half-fill the same pan with water and bring to the boil. Add the eggs to the boiling water and cook for 5 minutes.

Heat 2 teaspoons of the oil in a large, non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the tofu pieces and fry carefully for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until pale golden-brown on both sides. Turn off the heat but keep the pan on the hob so that the tofu stays warm.

Stir the noodles into the mushroom broth and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat until the mixture is simmering, add the chestnut mushrooms and pak choi and continue to simmer for a further 2-3 minutes. Stir in the beansprouts and spring onions, remove from the heat.
Drain the eggs then rinse under cold water. Crack and peel off the shells, cut in half.
Top the broth, noodles and vegetables with the tofu and eggs. Sprinkle over the cashew nuts and chili flakes. Season with extra soy sauce.

ingredients.description: dark soy sauce, plus extra to serve
firm tofu, drained, dried, cut into rectangular slices
pak choy, roots trimmed, leaves separated and washed
spring onion, trimmed, very thinly sliced

recipes.name: Vegan ginger tofu with mushrooms
recipes.description: A stir-fry like this one meets all your veggie needs and is easy to knock up after work
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the onion and garlic for 2 to 3 minutes or until just soft. Add the ginger and tofu. Stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the mushrooms, soy sauce and stir-fry sauce. Stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add the gai lan. Stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes or until gai lan is just tender. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place the noodles in a heatproof bowl. Cover with boiling water. Set aside for 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through. Using a fork, separate the noodles. Drain. Serve.

ingredients.description: ginger, peeled, cut into thin matchsticks

recipes.name: Fruit, nut and seed trail mix
recipes.description: Keep this crunchy trail mix at hand to boost your energy levels throughout the day.
instructions: Place pecans, almonds and peanuts in a bowl with pumpkin seeds, dried apricots and dried figs. Drizzle with maple syrup, toss to coat and spread onto a baking tray lined with baking paper. Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes or until golden. Cool, then store in an airtight container for up to one week. Half a cup with some yoghurt makes this a nutritious snack.

recipes.name: Tomato & basil bruschetta
recipes.description: When you finish this tasty Italian-style toast, shout out 'molto buono', which means 'very good' in Italian.
instructions: Cut the tomatoe into 1cm pieces and place in a bowl. Stir in the basil.
Toast the bread until golden.
Cut the garlic clove in half and gently rub the cut side over the toast.

recipes.name: Garlic balsamic mushrooms with Turkish toast
recipes.description: Flat mushrooms have an intense, robust flavour and a dense, meaty texture which makes them the perfect option for a hearty vegetarian lunch.
instructions: Combine garlic and balsamic vinegar. Mix well.
Brush mushroom tops with balsamic mixture. Spray lightly with oil. Place stalk-side up on grill tray.
Preheat grill on high. Grill mushrooms for 4 to 5 minutes or until tender. Transfer to a plate and keep warm. Spray bread with oil. Grill for 2 minutes on each side or until golden.
Arrange mushrooms and bread on serving plates. Sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.name: Hash browns with baby tomatoes and spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Use scissors to remove the tomatoes from the truss, leaving the tops in tact. Place the tomatoes on a baking tray. Spray lightly with the olive oil. Roast for 15-20 minutes or until soft and slightly golden.
Meanwhile, peel and coarsely grate the potatoes. Squeeze handfuls of the grated potato to remove as much liquid as possible. Place the grated potato into a large bowl

Heat half the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Place the grated potato in the pan. Use an egg flip to flatten slightly to form a 10cm round. Repeat if needed. Cook for 2-3 minutes each side or until golden. Transfer to a plate. Cover with foil. Repeat with the remaining potato.

recipes.name: Chamomile, carrot and orange drink with hummus crispbread
recipes.description: This tasty vegetable juice is perfect to drink in the morning to kick start your day.
instructions: Place the teabags in a heatproof jug and add the boiling water. Set aside for 15 minutes to infuse and cool slightly.
Meanwhile, to make the snack, spread the crispbread with the hummus.
Process the carrots and the oranges in a juice extractor and pour the juice into a medium jug. Add the chamomile tea and mix well. Add the ice cubes, if using.
Pour into serving glasses and serve the drink immediately with the hummus crispbread.

ingredients.description: carrot, chilled, cut lengthways into quarters
orange, chilled, peeled, halved, cut into wedges, seeds removed

recipes.name: Cherry yoghurt soy shake
recipes.description: Serve milkshakes topped with a scoop of sorbet.
instructions: Blend milk, yoghurt and cherries together until smooth.
Pour into chilled glasses

recipes.name: Fruit muesli
instructions: Mix and serve

recipes.name: Blueberry breakfast bowl
instructions: Mix and serve

recipes.name: Fruits and nuts breakfast bowl
instructions: Mix and serve

recipes.name: Original bruschetta
instructions: Pour hot water over the tomatoes, peal them, remove the seeds and chop them
Toast bread and rub garlic and olive oil on toast
Put tomatoes, fresh basil and black pepper on toast

recipes.name: Bean pate
instructions: Mash kidney beans. Add margarine, chopped onion, fresh parsley and crushed garlic. Add salt to taste and mix well

ingredients.description: canned red kidney beans, drained, rinsed

recipes.name: Avocado spread
instructions: Cut avocado in half and remove seed. Using a spoon remove the flesh of the avocado. Chop onion, crush garlic and chop tomatoes. Mix all ingredients together. Add salt, black pepper and lemon juice to taste

recipes.name: Chia pudding with raspberries
instructions: Soak chia seeds in the almond milk. Add sweetener and put in in the fridge for 3-4 hours until the consistency is similar to pudding. Serve with raspberries

recipes.name: Black bean, avocado and lettuce wraps
recipes.description: These quick, no-cook tacos are the perfect easy lunch. Did we mention they're vegan, too?
instructions: Combine beans, tomato, cucumber, avocado and coriander in a bowl.
Whisk together the juice, oil and paprika in a small bowl. Add to bean mixture. Season. Stir to combine. Serve in lettuce leaves.

ingredients.description: canned red kidney beans, drained, rinsed

recipes.name: Vegan naan bread
recipes.description: Anjum Anand’s simple naan breads, flavoured with garlic and fresh coriander, are quick and easy to make.
instructions: For the dough, sift the flour, sugar, salt and baking powder into a bowl. In another bowl, mix together the milk and oil.

Make a well in the centre of the flour mixture and pour in the liquid mixture. Slowly mix together the dough by working from the centre and incorporating the flour from the edges of the 'well', to make a smooth, soft dough. Knead well for 8-10 minutes, adding a little flour if the dough is too sticky.
Place the dough into an oiled bowl, cover with a damp tea-towel and leave in a warm place for 10-15 minutes. Form the dough into five balls.
Preheat the grill to medium and place a heavy baking sheet on the upper shelf of the grill to heat.

Roll the dough balls out quite thinly, ideally in a teardrop shape, but really this is just aesthetic. Sprinkle over your chosen topping and press into the surface of the dough. Place the naans onto the hot baking sheet and grill for just 1-2 minutes, or until lightly browned.

ingredients.description: vegetable oil, plus extra for greasing
nigella seeds, poppy seeds or sesame seeds, or chopped garlic and fresh coriander

recipes.name: Mexican pasta salad
instructions: 1. Add pasta to boiling water and cook according to package instructions.
2. Drain the pasta and rinse with cool running water.
3. Whisk together the dressing ingredients in a large bowl.
4. Add the cooked pasta, and the remaining salad ingredients and stir to coat.

ingredients.description: canned black beans, drained and rinsed

recipes.name: Italian pasta salad
instructions: 1. Boil pasta according to package instructions.
2. Whisk dressing ingredients in a large bowl.
3. Add the drained hot pasta to the dressing.
4. Allow the pasta to cool to absorb the dressing.
5. Add the remaining ingredients.
6. Stir to combine.

ingredients.description: roasted red bell pepper, drained and chopped

recipes.name: Panzanella (italian bread salad)
instructions: 1. Cut bread into 1-inch cubes.
2. Spread the bread on a baking sheet and bake until toasted but not hard, about 12 minutes.
3. Meanwhile, dice the tomatoes and vegetables.
4. Whisk the dressing and basil in a large bowl.
5. Add the hot bread and the tomatoes to the dressing and stir to coat. Let sit 10 minutes to allow the bread to absorb the dressing and tomato juices.
6. Add the remaining vegetables and stir to combine.

ingredients.description: crusty bread, cut into bite-sized cubes
tomato, cut into bite sized chunks
red bell pepper, cut into bite sized bell pepper
cucumber, cut into bite sized chunks
mozzarella cheese, cut into bite sized chunks

recipes.name: Vegetarian fettuccine carbonara with mushrooms
instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. When water boils, cook pasta until al dente according to package instructions.
2. Meanwhile, heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add shallots, and cook, stirring often until browned and caramelized 5 to 10 minutes.
3. Add the garlic, mushrooms, red pepper, salt and pepper and cook, stirring often until the mushrooms are soft and browned, about 10 minutes.
4. Whisk egg and ½ cup Parmesan in a small bowl.
5. Add the hot pasta to the mushroom mixture and stir to combine. Stir in the egg mixture as well.

recipes.name: Summer tomato risotto with saffron
instructions: 1. In a large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Add tomatoes (whole) and sear, stirring occasionally, until they burst and soften, about 7 minutes. Turn heat off. Chop if extra-large.

2. At the same time, in a large heavy-bottomed pot or dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the onions. Saute until golden about 10-12 minutes. Add garlic and thyme, saute 2 more minutes until fragrant.

3. Add the rice, saute 1 minute, stirring. Add some stock to cover the rice, saffron and smoked paprika, stir and bring to a simmer. Simmer until most of the liquid is absorbed and then add the tomatoes, all their juices and some of the stock. Stir until all the liquid is absorbed. Continue adding broth in small amounts at a time, letting the rice absorb it slowly, stirring often over med-low heat, until the rice is plumped, slightly al dente, yet creamy, about 20-25 minutes. You may not need all the cups.
4. Stir in the butter and parmesan. Season generously with salt, pepper, and optional chili flakes.

recipes.name: Broccoli quinoa cakes
instructions: 1. Bring quinoa and water to boil in a very small pot, cover, lower heat to low and cook 12-15 minutes or until all the water is gone. Turn off heat, let stand 5 minutes covered.
2. Steam broccoli (at the same time) until just tender and drain well, and pat dry.

3. Place broccoli, scallions, quinoa, egg, salt, pepper, garlic, and cheese into a food processor and pulse until finely ground. Pulse in the flour, mixing in well. The mixture should easily mound on a spoon and just be slightly wet, but easily forming a patty. Form 2 large patties.

4. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Carefully place patties in the skillet, lowering heat to medium-low– don't to move or fiddle with them. Flip when golden, about 5 minutes. Cook the other side until slightly puffed in the center, lowering heat more if need be.
5. Serve on top of the salad.

recipes.name: Peach caprese grilled cheese sandwich
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan.

2. Cut the peach in half and remove the seed. Brush the cut sides with ½ teaspoon of the olive oil. Grill the peach halves over direct medium-high heat until rich grill marks form on the cut surfaces, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board. When cool enough to handle, thinly slice each peach half and sprinkle with the balsamic vinegar and salt.

3. Top two of the bread slices with half of the cheese. Then top with all of the peach slices (draining off excess liquids), basil leaves, and the remaining cheese. Top with the other bread slices to form a sandwich. Lightly brush the sandwiches with the remaining 2 teaspoons olive oil.

4. Grill over direct medium-high heat until rich grill marks form and cheese is slightly melted, about 4 or 5 minutes on first side and 3 minutes on flip side. Cut in half on the diagonal, if desired, and serve.

recipes.name: Grilled halloumi salad with cherries
instructions: 1. Heat a medium sized skillet over medium heat. Add the vegetable oil and place halloumi slices on the skillet. Grill on each side for about 3 minutes each or until slightly browned and crispy. Remove and allow to cool.
2. In a large bowl, add the mixed greens, cherries, balckberries, pickled onions and shaved almonds. Add halloumi cheese once cooled.
3. In a medium bowl, whisk together the olive oil, apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
4. Drizzle on top of the salad and toss. Serve!

recipes.name: Tuscan cherry tomato and white bean salad
instructions: 1. Combine tomatoes, sugar and salt in a bowl. Let stand for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
2. Carefully remove the tomatoes with a slotted spoon into a different bowl, leaving as much liquid behind as possible. Strain the liquid to remove the seeds then transfer to a third small bowl.
3. Add the vinegar, olive oil, garlic, crushed red pepper flakes and salt and black pepper to taste.
4. Add the beans to the tomatoes, toss with dressing, add basil and Parmesan cheese and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Indian cauliflower and chickpea curry
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large skillet or saute pan over medium-high heat.
2. Add the onion, reduce heat to medium and cook 4-5 minutes or until beginning to soften.
3. Add the red bell pepper and cook 1-2 minutes or until beginning to soften.
4. Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder. Cook 10-15 seconds or until fragrant.
5. Add the cauliflower, vegetable broth, chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk.
6. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer 10-15 minutes or until cauliflower is cooked, not crunchy, but still has some texture.
7. Season to taste with salt and black pepper. Stir in cilantro.
8. Serve with basmati rice.

recipes.name: Shakshuka with red lentils and feta cheese
instructions: 1. Heat oil over medium-high heat in a heavy skillet such as cast iron.
2. Add the onion, reduce heat to medium-low and cook 5-6 minutes or until soft. Add the roasted red bell pepper and garlic. Cook 30 seconds or until garlic is fragrant.
3. Add tomatoes, cumin, paprika, cayenne and lentils.
4. Bring up to a good simmer over medium heat, reduce heat to low, cover and cook 10-20 minutes or until lentils are tender.
5. Season to taste with salt and black pepper.
6. With the back of spoon, press to create 1 well in the tomato-lentil mixture.
7. Carefully crack an egg into the well. Cover the skillet and cook 7-8 minutes or until the egg is just set.
8. Sprinkle with parsley and feta cheese. Serve immediately with fresh bread.

ingredients.description: roasted red bell pepper, from a jar

recipes.name: Southern-style potato salad
instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of water and 1 teaspoon of salt to a rolling boil. Boil potatoes until soft and a knife can easily poke through, but not overcooked and water logged (about 20 minutes). Remove from heat, drain water, and allow potatoes to cool (30 minutes). Once cool, cut potatoes into bite-size quarters.
2. Meanwhile boil the eggs for 10 minutes. Let them cool, remove the shell, and cut them into bite sized pieces. .

3. In a large bowl, add cut potatoes, sliced celery, diced carrots, sliced green onions, mayonnaise, dijon mustard, apple cider vinegar, chopped dill, the remaining salt and a pinch of black pepper. Toss to coat thoroughly mix until all ingredients are covered in mayonnaise.
4. For best results refrigerate for a minimum of 30-60 minutes to chill salad and let the ingredients release their flavors.

recipes.name: Veggie loaded flatbread
instructions: 1. Heat the grill to its highest setting. Spread the onion wedges out on a baking tray and drizzle with 1 tbsp of the oil. Grill for 3-5 mins turning halfway through, then add the tomatoes to the tray, season and grill for a further 5 mins or until juicy and popping.

2. Put the chickpeas in a pan with the garlic and remaining 1 tbsp oil, then heat for 5 mins before crushing the chickpeas using a potato masher. Stir through the tahini, the lemon zest and juice along with 2 tbsp water. Season.
3. Warm your flatbread under the grill for a couple of minutes. Top with the crushed chickpeas, then the tomato and onion mixture. Finish with the olives, feta and basil, and a drizzle of olive oil.

ingredients.description: red onion, sliced into thin wedges
olive oil, plus extra to serve

recipes.name: Beetroot hummus toasts with olives and mint
instructions: 1. Toast the bread – if the slices are quite long, halve them first.

2. Meanwhile, tip the chickpeas into a bowl with half the beetroot, the lemon juice, garlic and oil, and blitz with a stick blender to make hummus. Spread on the toast, top with the remaining beetroot and scatter with feta, olives and mint.

recipes.name: Halloumi flatbread
instructions: 1. Toast the pumpkin seeds with the cumin seeds in a large frying pan until they begin to pop and smell fragrant, then transfer to a large bowl. Add the cabbage, peppers and vinegar, and season well. Mix thoroughly and set aside.

2. Heat oven to low and put the bread in to warm through. Using the pan you used to toast the seeds, fry the halloumi with the olive oil for 3 mins each side until crispy and golden. Transfer to the oven to keep warm.
3. Spread a layer of hummus on the flatbread and top with a handful of slaw, halloumi and rocket to serve.

ingredients.description: red bell pepper, cut into strips

recipes.name: Easy chickpea sandwich
instructions: 1. Thinly slice the celery (if it’s a large rib, cut in half lengthwise first). Thinly slice the green onions.
2.  In a medium bowl, smash the chickpeas with a fork.

3. Combine the chickpeas with the chopped celery and green onions, mayonnaise and lemon juice. Add about 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt, depending on your chickpea brand and taste preferences, and fresh ground pepper to taste.
4. Assemble the chickpea salad sandwich: spread the bread with hummus. Top the sandwich with lettuce or greens and chickpea spread.

recipes.name: Spinach ricotta chicken
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F.
2. In a bowl, mix together the ricotta, parmesan, spinach, garlic clove and the Italian seasoning until fully combined.

3. Spray the bottom of a 9×13 pan, or large baking dish with oil. Line the chicken breast in the pan and evenly season with salt and pepper. Spread the ricotta and spinach mixture over the top of the chicken breasts evenly. Cover the chicken completely with the marinara.
4. Bake for about 15-20 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. In the last several minutes, add shredded parmesan on top of the chicken and continue baking to melt.
5. Allow chicken to rest about 5 minutes before serving. Store leftovers in a sealed container in the refrigerator.

recipes.name: Honey lime sheet pan chicken fajitas
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk together olive oil, honey, lime juice and spices.
3. Cut chicken into thin strips. Slice onion and pepper into thin strips as well. Place chicken into bowl that contains whisked marinade. Stir to coat well and evenly.
4. Add pepper and onion and continue to mix so that they are coated as well. Spread evenly over sheet pan. (If meal prepping or marinading, place in fridge until ready to cook.)
5. Bake for about 15 minutes or until chicken is 165°F internal temperature.

recipes.name: Baked orange chicken in sheet pan
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F.

2. In a small bowl, whisk together honey, orange juice, orange zest, 1 T olive oil, ginger, garlic clove, red pepper and sea salt (to taste) and pepper. Place chicken in a medium bowl. Season with salt, pepper and garlic powder as desired. Pour marinade over top and toss to evenly coat.

3. Toss 2 tablespoons olive oil on the broccoli florets, dash of sea salt, the garlic powder and cracked pepper together so that broccoli is coated. Spread the broccoli out to the edges of the pan. Add the chicken to the center of the pan and pour remaining marinade over top.

4. Place in oven and bake for about 20 minutes or until chicken reaches 165°F internal temperature. When you pull out the pan, some extra liquid may be on it. Blot it with a paper towel or pour it gently off the side.

recipes.name: Baked honey soy chicken thighs
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 400° F and line a rimmed baking sheet with foil.
2.In a bowl whisk together the olive oil, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce, honey, minced garlic, minced ginger, and pepper.

3. Transfer the chicken thighs to a bowl and pat dry with paper towels. Add the honey soy mixture to the chicken and gently turn to coat. Allow chicken to marinate for at least 30 minutes (time permitting), or cover with plastic wrap and transfer to the refrigerator. Refrigerate up to overnight.
4. When ready to bake, transfer each chicken thigh to your prepared baking sheet lined with aluminum foil, skin-side-up.
5. Transfer chicken to the oven and bake for 35-45 minutes, or until internal temperature registers 160°F as measured with a digital meat thermometer.
6. Remove from the oven and allow to rest for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Chicken fried rice
instructions: 1. In a skillet over medium-high heat, add the oil. Once the skillet is hot, add the chicken thighs. Cover and cook for 5 minutes, flip chicken over and cook for an additional 5 minutes, covered. When done, chicken juices will run clear. Remove chicken from skillet and transfer to cutting board. Cut the chicken into 1/2'' bite size pieces. Set aside for later.

2. In the same skillet you cooked the chicken in, add the onion and carrot. Cook about 5-7 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until tender. Add peas, corn, and garlic to the skillet and cook for about 2-3 minutes until corn and peas are hot and no longer frozen. Be sure to stir every so often to ensure an even cook. Add the chicken back to the skillet.
3. Turn heat up to high. Add the rice and begin to stir fry for about 3-5 minutes. Be careful not to mush the rice with a spatula or spoon when stir frying.
4. Turn heat to low. Form a whole in the middle of the fried rice and crack in the egg. Begin to scramble until just almost done. Then, gently mix everything together.
5. Remove fried rice from heat and serve immediately. Serve with soy sauce and sriracha (optional). Enjoy!

recipes.name: Teriyaki chicken skewers
instructions: 1. Combine cornstarch and water in a small bowl. In a medium saucepan, add remaining ingredients (except the chicken thighs) along with the cornstarch/water mixture. Stirring frequently, bring sauce to a simmer. Cook until sauce lightly thickens. Sauce will be dark brown. Once sauce has thickened up, remove from heat and let cool completely. (Place in fridge to speed up the process.)

2. Once the sauce is completely cooled, place cubed chicken in a large ziplock bag. Pour half of the sauce over the chicken and gently shake to coat chicken. Let chicken marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes. Place remaining sauce aside for later.
3. When the chicken is done marinating, place your chicken on skewers and heat the grill to medium heat.

4. Once the grill is hot, place skewers on lightly oiled grill. Turn the skewers every 3-4 minutes until the chicken is cooked through (internal temp 165 degrees), about 20-30 minutes. During the last few turns baste with remaining teriyaki sauce.
5. Remove skewers from grill and serve with chopped green onion and a sprinkle of sesame seeds(optional).

recipes.name: Crispy chicken tenders
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Lightly grease a baking tray / sheet with cooking oil spray, or a light coating of oil. Set aside.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together the egg, oil, lemon juice, parsley, garlic, salt and pepper.
3. Dip chicken tenders into egg mixture and let sit for 5 minutes while preparing crumb mixture.
4. In another bowl, combine both breadcrumbs, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder and parmesan cheese.
5. Dredge the egg coated chicken in the breadcrumb/parmesan mixture, lightly pressing to evenly coat.
6. Arrange tenders on the baking sheet / tray and lightly spray with cooking oil spray.
7. Bake for 10 minutes. Flip and bake for a further 5-10 minutes or until cooked through. (Broil in the last 2-3 minutes for a golden crispy crumb!)

ingredients.description: dried breadcrumbs, garlic, herb or Italian seasoned for extra flavour

recipes.name: Creamy french mustard chicken
instructions: 1. Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Dredge in flour, shaking off the excess. Set aside.
2. Heat the olive oil in a large pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
3. When hot, fry chicken breasts until golden on each side and just cooked through, about 3-4 minutes each side, depending on the thickness of your chicken. Transfer to a warm plate.
4. Heat the butter in the pan. Sauté shallots until soft, about 4 minutes, then add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
5. Add the wine to deglaze the pan, scraping up the browned bits from bottom of pan with the end of your wooden spoon. Simmer until reduced to half, about 4 minutes.

6. Stir the Dijon mustard into the pan juices. Add the chicken broth and herbs. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium. Stir in cream and let simmer until sauce starts to thicken, about 3 minutes.
7. Add chicken back into the pan. Simmer gently until chicken is heated through and sauce has thickened, about 5 minutes. Taste test and adjust salt and pepper, if desired.

recipes.name: Creamy honey mustard chicken
instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, combine the honey, mustard, garlic, oil and salt to taste (not too much salt if serving with bacon as the bacon will add a salty flavour when served). Coat chicken evenly in the sauce. Set aside.

2. Heat a nonstick pan (or skillet) over medium heat. Fry bacon until crispy; transfer to a plate. To the same pan, sear chicken fillets on each side in the oil left over from the bacon until just beginning to brown (about 3 minutes per side -- not completely cooked through as we will finish them in the sauce).

3. Add any remaining honey mustard sauce into the pan along with the cream and milk. Bring to a simmer while stirring occasionally to mix the favours through the sauce (about 3 minutes), until the chicken is cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a warm plate.

4. Mix the cornstarch with the water and pour it into the centre of the pan, mixing it through the sauce until it thickens. Place chicken back into the pan; coat with the sauce. Top with the bacon and garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Rosemary honey chicken meatballs
instructions: 1. Coat a large non-stick sauté pan with olive oil and place it over low-medium heat. Add the shallots, rosemary, and garlic. Cook just until the shallots are soft, about 4 minutes. Then add the sherry, turn the heat to high, and reduce it completely. Mix in the honey and remove the pan from the heat. Let it cool to room temperature.

2. Once the shallot mixture has cooled, in a large mixing bowl, add it to the chicken along with the breadcrumbs, salt, and a bit of pepper. Use your hands to fully incorporate all of the ingredients.
3. Shape the chicken into balls that are approximately 1 to 2-inches, placing them on a plate or sheet pan as you work. (If you have a 1 ¼ to 1½-inch cookie scoop, that's prefect.)

4. Drizzle more olive oil into the same pan, and place it over medium-low heat. Add the meatballs and cook for about 3 minutes, just to brown the bottoms. Then turn the meatballs over, cover the pan, and reduce the heat to low. Let them cook and steam for about 3 to 4 more minutes, just until they are cooked through.

recipes.name: Spinach stuffed chicken breast
instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F. Use a sharp knife to and cut the side of the chicken breast to split it. Season both sides of the chicken with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning. Set aside.
2. Place spinach in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add some of the olive oil and garlic. Stir-fry until wilted. Press spinach through a sieve to extract all of the excess juice from it.

3. Place spinach onto the chicken breast. Then spread the cream cheese, mozzarella and walnuts in an even thin layer on top of the spinach. Roll up chicken from a short side. Use toothpicks to secure the stuffing inside. Roll the chicken through a shallow plate of flour.
4. Heat a cast-iron pan on medium heat and add olive oil. Sear the chicken with garlic cloves for about 3-4 minutes per side or until golden brown. Set aside.

5. Stir fry mushrooms and asparagus with butter in the same pan on medium heat for about 5 minutes. Season with the remaining salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning. Then combine chicken and vegetables in the same pan, bake in the oven for 15 minutes. Remove chicken from the oven and let it stand for 5 minutes, discard toothpicks. Serve chicken sliced, with vegetables.

recipes.name: Spanish chicken traybake with chorizo and peppers
instructions: 1. Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Using a pestle and mortar, crush the garlic and thyme leaves with a little seasoning and  some oil to make a paste. If you don’t have a pestle and mortar, finely grate the garlic, then stir everything together.
2. Rub the herb and garlic paste on the underside of the chicken to flavour it.

3. Cut each of the pepper halves into 2 or 3 chunky strips, depending on their size. Pile into a large roasting tin with the chorizo and olives, toss with the remaining oil, then sit the chicken on top, skin-side up. Scatter over the tomato, spoon over the vinegar, season and tuck in the thyme sprigs.
4. Roast for 1 hr until the chicken skin is crispy and the vegetables have softened.

ingredients.description: chicken thigh, on the bone, excess skin trimmed
red bell pepper, halved and deseeded

recipes.name: South African chutney chicken
instructions: 1. Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and cook the onion, garlic and chili for a few mins until softened. Stir in the chutney, Worcestershire sauce and mayonnaise. Taste and season.
2. Arrange the chicken on a foil-lined baking tray and spoon over the chutney mixture. Roast the chicken in the oven for 40-45 mins until cooked through and sticky. Serve with a green salad.

ingredients.description: red chili, deseeded and finely chopped
chicken thigh, skin on and bone in

recipes.name: Indian butter chicken
instructions: 1. Using 1/3 of the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat, brown the pieces of the chicken so each side is browned. They do not need to be fully cooked all the way through.

2. Melt another 1/3 of the butter in the pan over medium heat. Add the onion, and cook until beginning to soften — about three minutes. Add the garlic, garam masala, ginger, chili powder, cumin, and cayenne. Stir to combine, and cook for about 45 seconds before adding the tomato sauce.

3. Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for five minutes before adding the cream. Bring the mixture back to a simmer, add the browned chicken, and let simmer for 10-15 minutes. Keep the heat low here — not a rolling boil.
4. Stir in the remaining butter, and season with salt and pepper, to taste. Serve with lime, cilantro, alongside the naan and cooked rice.

ingredients.description: chicken thigh fillet, cut into 1'' chunks

recipes.name: Sweet and sour chicken
instructions: 1. Heat the oil in a wok until very hot.

2. Whilst the oil is heating, place the egg in one shallow bowl and the cornflour in another shallow bowl. Add the flour, salt, pepper, garlic salt and paprika to another shallow bowl and mix together.

3. Dredge the chicken in the cornflour, then dip in the egg, and finally dredge it in the seasoned flour. Add to the wok and cook on a high heat for 6-7 minutes, turning two or three times during cooking, until well browned. Remove from the pan and place in a bowl lined with kitchen towels.

4. Whilst the chicken is cooking, you can start on your sauce. Add the oil to a frying pan/skillet, heat it up on a medium-to-high heat and add in the onions. Cook for 3 minutes, stirring every now and then, until the onions start to go translucent.

5. Add the peppers and cook for a further minute. Add in the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute. Add the tomato ketchup, vinegar, dark brown sugar, and the pineapple and stir. Bring to the boil, and then turn down the heat and let it bubble, stirring every so often until slightly thickened.
6. Transfer the cooked crispy chicken to the pan with the sauce and toss to coat. Serve with boiled rice and a sprinkling of sesame seeds.

ingredients.description: chicken breast fillet, chopped into bite-size chunks
red and green bell peppers mixed, chopped into 1'' pieces

recipes.name: Easy chicken lo mein
instructions: 1. Cook the noodles in a pan of boiling water for 3-4 minutes (until just cooked through). Drain and rinse in cold water to prevent them sticking together and put to one side.
2. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a wok. Add the chicken and cook for 5-6 minutes until cooked through.
3. Add the sliced onion and cook for a further 2 minutes to slightly soften. Add the garlic, carrots, red pepper, sugarsnap peas and spring onions (scallions). Stir and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add in the noodles, oyster sauce, soy sauce and kecap manis. Fry on a high heat, tossing everything together until warmed through - about 3-4 minutes.
5. Serve topped with sesame seeds.

ingredients.description: chicken breast fillet, chopped int obite size chunks
red bell pepper, deseeded and sliced

recipes.name: Chicken penne casserole
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°. Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Add chicken, onion, peppers and seasonings; saute until chicken is no longer pink. Add garlic; cook 1 minute longer.

2. In a blender, pulse tomato and tomato paste, covered, until blended. Add to chicken mixture. Stir in broth; bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat; cover and simmer until slightly thickened, 10-15 minutes.
3. Drain pasta; toss with chicken mixture. Spoon half of the mixture into a greased baking dish. Sprinkle with half of the cheeses. Repeat layers.
4. Cover and bake 30 minutes. Uncover; bake until heated through, 15-20 minutes longer.

ingredients.description: chicken thigh fillet, cut into 1'' piece

recipes.name: Mexican chorizo and sweet potato taco
instructions: 1. Heat heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Brown chorizo about 10 minutes until cooked through, breaking up larger pieces. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a medium bowl and cover with foil to keep warm. Do not remove oil in skillet.

2. Add sweet potatoes to hot skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Brown on all sides as much as possible and cover skillet with aluminum foil. Cook until fork tender, stirring occasionally, 8-10 minutes total. Transfer sweet potatoes to bowl with chorizo.
3. Heat the olive oil in skillet. Add bell peppers and onion. Season with salt and pepper. Cook until beginning to soften, about 5 minutes.
4. Stir in corn, garlic, jalapeno and spices. Cook 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
5. Lower heat to medium. Stir chorizo and sweet potato back into skillet. Cook another 2-3 minutes until flavors meld and warmed through.
6. Spoon the chorizo and sweet potato mixture onto warm tortillas.

ingredients.description: green bell pepper, seeded and thinly sliced
red bell pepper, seeded and thinkly sliced

recipes.name: Healthy Club Sandwich
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to Gas Mark 5/ 375°F/ 190°C.
2. Cover a baking tray with foil or greaseproof (parchment) paper, add the bacon and bake in the oven for 15 minutes, turning once after 10 minutes.

3. Meanwhile, butterfly the chicken, brush lightly with 1 tsp of the olive oil, and season with salt and pepper. Heat the griddle pan on medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for about 6 minutes on each side or until cooked through.

4. Once the bacon and chicken are cooked, put to one side, let it rest and start to build your sandwich. First, toast the bread. Then, spread mayo on the bottom slice of toast and ketchup on the top half. Pile salad up on the bottom slice of bread and cheese on the top slice.

5. Now is the perfect time to fry your egg. Use the same pan you used to cook the chicken, add the remaining olive oil and fry the egg for about 5 minutes on medium heat until the egg white sets and the yolk is runny.

recipes.name: Crispy pork cutlets with fennel salad
instructions: 1. Place cherries in a large resealable plastic bag and lightly crush with the palm of your hand to extract pits. Tear cherries into large pieces and transfer to a small bowl; discard pits. Add half of the vinegar and season with salt and pepper. Set aside for serving.

2. Place the steak in another resealable plastic bag and pound to ¼'' thick. Place flour in a bowl; season with salt and pepper. Lightly beat eggs and the mustard in another bowl. Toss together panko and fennel seeds in a third bowl.

3. Season each cutlet with salt and pepper, then dredge in flour, shaking off excess. Transfer to bowl with egg mixture and turn to coat. Lift from bowl, allowing excess to drip off. Coat with panko mixture, pressing to adhere.

4. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Working in batches, cook cutlets, shaking pan occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a wire rack set inside a rimmed baking sheet; season with salt.

5. Place fennel in a large bowl; squeeze some of the lemon over. Cut remaining lemon half into wedges and set aside for serving. Drizzle fennel with the remaining vinegar and season with salt and lots of black pepper. Toss, squeezing once or twice with your hands to help soften fennel. Add basil and gently toss again.

recipes.name: Air-fryer pork tenderloin medallions
instructions: 1. Preheat air fryer to 375°. Cut tenderloin crosswise into slices. Place bread crumbs in a bowl. Dip pork slices in crumbs, patting to help coating adhere. In batches, place pork on greased tray in air-fryer basket; spritz with cooking spray. Cook until a thermometer reads 145°, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove and keep warm.
2. Place broccoli on tray in air-fryer basket. Cook until tender, 4-6 minutes, stirring once.
3. In a small saucepan, mix preserves, broth, rosemary, salt and pepper. Cook and stir over medium-low heat until preserves are melted, 3-5 minutes. Serve with pork, broccoli and rice.

recipes.name: Quick ginger pork with rice and bok choy
instructions: 1. In a skillet or wok, stir-fry pork in oil until no longer pink. Add garlic; cook 1 minute longer.

2. In a bowl, combine the soy sauce, sugar and ginger; add to skillet. Combine water and cornstarch until smooth; add to skillet. Bring to a boil; cook and stir until thickened, about 2 minutes. Serve with rice and bok choy.

ingredients.description: pork tenderloin, cut into thin strips

recipes.name: Sticky pork stir fry with apple juice
instructions: 1. Cut your pork into bite size pieces. Place in a bowl with the apple juice and a pinch of salt and leave to marinate for 15 minutes. (You can leave it for longer if you want an even stronger flavour.)
2. Dice the pepper, bamboo shoots and spring onion into small pieces.
3. Mix together the sauce ingredients (rice vinegar, sugar, salt, tomato puree, cornstarch, sesame seed oil) in a bowl and set aside.

4. Beat the egg, and add it to your marinated pork, along with the cornflour. Mix together. Then take each piece of pork and coat it in your plain flour as best you can. It doesn’t have to be perfect, but this will make your pork crispy!
5. Cover the base of a frying pan with a thin layer of oil. Heat until it is very hot, and then add the pork to cook. Stir, and cook for around 8-10 minutes until the pork is cooked through.
6. Lower the heat, add your vegetables and the sauce and keep stirring until the sauce thickens and goes sticky.Serve with white rice.

recipes.name: Easy creamy pork marsala
instructions: 1. Cut the pork into slices that are about 0.75''-1'' thick. Season with the garlic powder and salt & pepper, and then coat each piece in flour.

2. Add the oil and one third of the butter to a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, add the pork and cook it for 3 minutes/side or until lightly golden. Transfer pork to a plate and set aside.
3. Add the remaining butter and the mushrooms to the pan. Cook for 4-5 minutes or until the mushrooms have released their water and get a nice sear.
4. Stir in the garlic, then add the marsala. Let the sauce bubble for 2-3 minutes (it'll reduce).

5. Stir in the cream and add the pork back into the pan. Cook for 4-5 minutes (you may need to reduce the heat a bit if it's furiously boiling) or until the pork is cooked through and the sauce has thickened up a bit. Be careful not to overcook the pork. Season with extra salt & pepper as needed.

recipes.name: Creamy garlic pork chops
instructions: 1. Take the pork chops out of the fridge 15-30 minutes prior to starting the recipe if possible. Season the pork generously with salt & pepper on both sides.

2. In a deep skillet, add the olive oil and half of the butter over medium-high heat. Let the pan heat up for a few minutes, and once it's hot, cook the pork chops for 3-5 minutes/side or until lightly browned (3 minutes for thinner chops and 5 minutes for pork chops up to 1'' thick). Once the pork chops are done searing, transfer them to a plate.

3. Add the remaining butter and the garlic cloves to the skillet. Turn the heat down to medium (or medium-low if using cast iron). Cook it, stirring fairly often, for about 3 minutes or until the garlic has somewhat browned on the outside.

4. Push the garlic to one side of the pan and sprinkle the flour in (avoiding the garlic). Let it cook for around 30 seconds, and give it a stir so it's incorporated with the butter (we're making a quick roux).
5. Add in the chicken broth and lemon juice. Stir and let it cook for about a minute or until the sauce is noticeably thickened.
6. Add in the cream and garlic powder. Stir or whisk it until the garlic powder has dissolved.

7. Add the pork back in and cook for another 4-5 minutes or until the sauce has thickened up a bit (let the sauce bubble a bit but not furiously boil) and the pork chops are fully cooked through (145F). Season the sauce with extra salt & pepper as needed and parsley if you wish.

recipes.name: Easy pork chops and apples
instructions: 1. Sprinkle the pork chops with salt & pepper and garlic powder, and then dredge them in flour. Add half of the butter + the olive oil to a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the pan's hot, add the pork. Cook it for 3-4 minutes/side or until it has a nice golden crust.
2. Meanwhile, chop the apple.
3. Take the pork chops out and set aside.
4. Add the Dijon mustard, chicken broth, and the rest of the butter. Give it a good stir until the mustard dissolves. Add the apples and Italian seasoning and let the sauce cook for a few minutes.
5. Add the pork back into the skillet. Reduce the heat to medium-low, cover the pan, and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the pork is cooked through.
6. Take the lid off the pan, and if the sauce is reduced to your liking and the apples and pork are done, serve. If not, continue cooking for a little longer (leave the lid off to reduce sauce).

ingredients.description: boneless pork loin center chops, (about 1'' thick)

recipes.name: Swedish meatballs
instructions: 1. In a bowl, mix the breadcrumbs together with egg, garlic, salt, peppers and spice. Allow the egg to soak into the breadcrumbs for at least 10 minutes.
2. Once the egg has absorbed some, add in the onion, meat(s) and parsley. Mix well with your hands to combine.
3. Roll meat into balls.
4. Heat the oil in a pan on medium-high heat. Fry meatballs in batches so they don’t stew or simmer. Transfer to a warm plate and cover with foil.

5. Add the butter to the juices in the pan to melt. Whisk in the flour until it dissolves and turns brown in colour. Pour in the broth (or stock), cream, soy sauce and dijon. Bring to a to simmer and season with salt and pepper to taste. Mix the sauce through well to combine all of the flavours together. Continue to simmer until thickened.

recipes.name: Sun dried tomato cheesy meatballs
instructions: 1. Combine mince, breadcrumbs, tomato drained of oil (reserve oil), cheese, garlic, paste, oregano and basil in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Shape into balls.
2. Heat oil in a non stick oven proof pan or cast iron skillet over medium heat. Cook meatballs, in batches for 3 to 4 minutes while occasionally turning to brown on all sides.
3. Heat reserved semi-dried tomato oil in pan. Add the tomato sauce. Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes.
4. Return meatballs to pan; bring to the boil; reduce heat to low and allow to simmer, covered for 15-20 minutes or until meatballs have cooked through and sauce has thickened.
5. Meanwhile, preheat oven to grill (or broil) settings on medium heat halfway through cooking time. When meatballs are ready place pan into the oven. Grill/broil until cheese has melted.

ingredients.description: sun-dried tomato in oil, drained and oil reserved

recipes.name: Leftover ham fried rice with pineapple
instructions: 1. Mix the soy sauce and pineapple juice together in a bowl.
2. Add third of the oil to a nonstick pan and heat it over medium-high heat until hot. Add the ham and pineapples. Cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized, about 2 to 3 minutes.
3. Add the bell peppers. Stir a few times to mix well, then transfer everything to a plate and set aside.

4. Add some oil and the garlic into the skillet. Stir a few times to release the fragrance. Add the rice and spread it out with your spatula. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the rice is lightly toasted.

5. Move the rice to one side of the pan and add the remaining oil to the other side of the skillet. Add the beaten egg onto the oil. Let it cook until the bottom sets, 30 seconds. Scramble a few times until most of the egg is cooked but some parts are still runny. Mix the rice into the egg, chopping and stirring to mix everything together.

6. Move the rice to the edge of the pan to make a well in the center. Pour the soy sauce and pineapple juice into the center. Let it cook for a few seconds to evaporate the liquid. Stir everything together until the rice is evenly coated with the seasonings. Let it cook, stirring occasionally, until the moisture is cooked off.
7. Add the cooked ham mixture back into the pan. Stir everything together. Taste the rice. Add a pinch of salt and mix again, if needed.

recipes.name: Char siu (chinese BBQ pork)
instructions: 1. Prepare the marinade and the glaze the day before you cook. For the marinade combine the soy sauce, hoisin sauce, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar, molasses, garlic, five spice powder and salt. Stir to mix well.

2. Transfer the pork into a ziplock bag. Pour half of the mixed sauce into the bag. Squeeze out as much air as possible and seal the bag. Massage the bag a few times so the pork piece are covered evenly with the sauce. Transfer to the fridge and marinate overnight (highly recommended), or for at least 6 hours.

3. For the glaze microwave the honey for 20 seconds or so, until the top loosens. Grease your tablespoon with a thin layer of oil. Transfer it into a saucepan. Add the rest mixed sauce into the same pan. Heat over medium heat and stir frequently to melt the honey, until brought to a simmer. Turn to medium low heat. Cook for 5 minutes to thicken the sauce slightly. Once done, let the sauce cool for at least 10 minutes. Carefully transfer the sauce into a heat-proof mason jar or container. Let cool for another 10 to 15 minutes. Cover and transfer into the fridge. The sauce will continue to thicken once chilled.

4. When the pork is marinated and the glaze is chilled, you’re ready to cook. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 C). Line a baking tray with aluminum foil and add 1/4 inch (1/2 cm) water. Place a grilling rack on top. (Alternatively, you can grill the pork as well.) Transfer the pork onto the grilling track. Drizzle some marinating liquid onto the pork. Bake for 10 minutes.

5. Baste the pork, using a brush to dab the glaze onto the top side. Turn to the other side and dab glaze on top. Bake for 5 minutes. Baste the top of the pork, and bake for another 5 minutes. Once done, you can check the doneness by inserting a thermometer into the thickest part of the pork. It should read at least 145 F (63 C). Return the pork to the oven to bake for another 5 minutes or so if needed.

6. Turn on the broiler. Broil for 3 minutes. Flip the pork to baste the other side. Broil for another 3 minutes. The pork should look glossy, lightly charred, and cooked through. Once the pork is done, brush it with the rest of the glaze. Cover loosely with aluminum foil. Let rest for 10 to 15 minutes before serving. You can serve the pork hot over rice, and wilted spinach as a main dish.

recipes.name: Salt and pepper pork chops
instructions: 1. Combine the cut pork with the smaller amount of oil, dry sherry, the smaller amount of cornstarch, and a bit of salt. Mix until the pork is evenly coated. Marinate for 15 minutes.
2. Mix the salt and pepper in a small bowl.Add enough oil to a medium-sized pan to cover half of the pork. Heat over medium heat until hot. Prepare a plate lined with paper towels.

3. Add the garlic and pepper to the oil and fry them until the garlic just turns pale golden and the jalapeno crisp up on the edges, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove them from the pan with a slotted spoon, draining the excess oil as you do, and place them onto the paper towel lined plate. Once the pepper and garlic have cooled, transfer them to a big bowl.

4. Add the bigger amount of cornstarch to the marinated pork chops and toss to coat. Add the pork to the pan, a few pieces at a time, so they do not crowd the pan. Cook on each side for 2 to 3 minutes, until the coating is crispy and lightly browned.
5. Remove the pork from the pan, draining the excess oil as you do, and place them on the paper towel lined plate.
6. Let rest for at least 10 to 20 seconds, so the paper soaks up some of the oil. Once you’ve cooked all the pork chops, transfer them to the bowl with the pepper and garlic.
7. Sprinkle half of the salt and pepper over everything and toss to evenly distribute. Taste the pork and sprinkle with more salt and pepper, if needed.

ingredients.description: boneless pork chops, cut into irregular 1''

recipes.name: Sweet and sour pork
instructions: 1. Combine the pork pieces, peanut oil, and half of the salt in a big bowl. Mix well and let marinate for 15 minutes while you prepare the other ingredients.
2. Mix all the sauce ingredients (ketchup, apple cider vinegar, wine or sherry, brown sugar, the smaller amount of cornstarch and the rest of the salt) in a bowl and set aside.

3. When you’re ready to cook, add the beaten egg into the bowl with the pork. Stir to mix well. Add the bigger amount of the cornstarch. Stir to coat the pork until it forms an uneven coating with a little dry cornstarch left unattached.

4. Heat the oil in a heavy-duty skillet until hot, until it just starts to smoke. Add the pork all at once and spread it out into a single layer in the skillet. Separate the pork pieces with a pair of tongs or chopsticks.

5. Cook without touching the pork for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the bottom turns golden. Flip to brown the other side, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer the pork to a big plate and remove the pan from the stove. Let cool for 2 to 3 minutes.

6. Place the pan back onto the stove and turn to medium heat. You should still have some oil in the pan. Add the green onion and garlic. Cook and stir a few times until it releases its fragrance, a few seconds.

7. Stir the sauce again to dissolve the cornstarch completely. Pour it into the pan. Stir and cook until it thickens, when you can draw a line on the bottom with a spatula without the sauce running back immediately.
8. Add back the cooked pork and stir to coat with sauce, about 30 seconds. Transfer everything to a plate immediately. Serve hot as a main over steamed rice.

recipes.name: Mongolian beef fried rice
instructions: 1.Heat half of the oil in a nonstick (or carbon steel pan) over medium-high heat until hot. Add the ground beef and quickly spread it across the pan with your spatula to form a thin layer. Let the bottom cook until browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Drizzle with some of the soy sauce. Flip the beef and chop it into smaller pieces with your spatula. When the beef is almost cooked through, move it to one side of the pan.
2. Add the more oil and green onion onto the empty side of the pan. Stir a few times.

3. Add the rice and pour the remaining soy sauce over the rice. Stir and cook for 30 seconds until evenly mixed. Stir everything together. Add the frozen veggies, bell pepper, cumin powder, chili flakes, and sprinkle with the salt. Stir and cook for a minute. Move everything to one side of the pan.

4. Add the remaining oil onto the other side of the pan. Add the beaten egg onto the oil. Let them cook for a few seconds until the bottom sets. Scramble the egg using your spatula, cut them into smaller pieces, and mix them with everything else.
5. Transfer everything to a plate and serve hot as a main dish.

ingredients.description: medium grain rice, cooked then chilled
frozen veggies (e.g. broccoli, carrot, corn, peas)

recipes.name: Chinese Beef Chow Mein
instructions: 1. Boil noodles according to package instructions until al dente. Rinse with tap water, drain, and set aside.
2. Combine all the “Marinade” ingredients (flank steak, shaoxing wine, bigger amount of cornstarch adn a bit of salt) in a bowl. Mix well and let marinate for 10 minutes.

3. Whisk all the sauce ingredients (chicken stock, oyster sauce, more shaoxing wine, soy sauce, sugar, black pepper and the smaller amount of cornstarch) together in a bowl. Chop aromatics and vegetables.

4. Heat half of the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Spread the beef in the pan. Cook for 30 to 45 seconds without touching, until the bottom browns. Flip to cook the other side for 30 to 45 seconds, stirring occasionally, until the beef is lightly charred but the inside is slightly pink. Transfer to a plate.

5. Add the remaining oil. Add onion and peppers. Cook and stir until the veggies just start to turn soft, 1 minute or so. Add the ginger, garlic, and green onion. Stir a few times to release the fragrance.

6. Add the noodles. Toss a few times with a pair of tongs. Add the cooked beef back into the pan. Pour the sauce over the ingredients. Toss to mix everything together well. The noodles are done when the sauce is absorbed, 1 minute or so. Transfer everything to serving plates and serve hot as main.

recipes.name: Pressure cooker curry beef stew
instructions: 1. Add the diced tomato, wine, light soy sauce, ginger, garlic, bay leaf and chili pepper into the Instant Pot. Stir to mix well.
2. Spread the onion into a single layer on top of the previous mixture. Add the beef chunks on top of the onion without overlapping. Smear tomato paste onto the beef as evenly as possible.
3. Sprinkle the curry powder, black pepper, sugar and sea salt onto the beef as evenly as possible. Seal the Instant Pot. Set on Manual at high pressure for 30 minutes. Use natural release when done.

4. Taste the beef and adjust seasoning by adding more salt if needed. Remove the bay leaves and the chili peppers and discard them. Stir everything to mix well. You can store the beef curry in an airtight container in the fridge for 3 to 4 days, or serve directly.

5. To add veggies to your curry, simply microwave some frozen green peas in microwave and add them into the curry. You can also turn on the saute function of your Instant Pot, add the veggies, and cook until they are done. Serve hot over steamed rice.

ingredients.description: beef chuck roast, cut into 1'' chunks

recipes.name: Butter dill potatoes
instructions: 1. Fill a pot ¾ full with water, place on high heat, and bring to a boil. Take the butter out and allow to warm to room temperature.

2. Add the potato, carefully, avoiding splashing water, and allow pot to return to a boil. Cook until the potato are firm but tender, about 10-15 minutes. Test by poking with a fork; if the fork easily inserts, they are done.
3. Remove the potato and allow to cool slightly in a wide bowl. Cut the potato in half, coat in butter, and sprinkle with dill weed, gently mixing to incorporate.

recipes.name: Roasted Rosemary Garlic Potatoes
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
2. Cut the red potato into fours and place in a bowl. Add garlic, rosemary, olive oil, melted butter, garlic salt and pepper.
3. Gently toss potato to fully coat in seasonings.
4. Pour the potato onto a baking sheet and evenly spread out. Bake it in the oven for 45 minutes, turning them every 15 minutes to ensure an even golden cook.

recipes.name: Air-fryer sweet potato fries
instructions: 1. Preheat air fryer to 400°. Combine all ingredients; toss to coat. Place on greased tray in air-fryer basket. Cook until lightly browned, 10-12 minutes, stirring once. Serve immediately.
2. If you don’t have an air fryer, you can make this recipe in an oven.

recipes.name: Millet tabbouleh
instructions: 1. Cook the Millet: add the millet and 2,5x more water, and a pinch of salt to a saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then cover and reduce the heat to medium low; simmer for 20 minutes, then remove the lid and fluff with a fork. Transfer to a bowl and let cool.

2. In the meantime, combine the lemon juice, oil, and garlic together in a bowl and let marinate while the millet cooks; this helps to mellow out the garlic flavor and infuse the oil. You can also chop and prepare the remaining ingredients during this time.

3. Once the millet has cooled in its bowl, add the tomato, cucumber, parsley, mint, green onion, salt, and garlic/lemon/oil mixture to the bowl. Use a spatula to fold everything together until all ingredients are uniformly distributed. Let sit for at least 10 minutes, to allow the flavors to mingle.
4. Serve chilled.

ingredients.description: continental cucumber, seeds removed and diced
parsley, stems remove and leaves finely copped

recipes.name: Instant pot cilantro lime rice
instructions: 1. Roughly separate the Cilantro leaves from the Stems. Finely dice the Stems, and add them to the Instant Pot. Finely chop the Leaves, and set them aside for later.

2. Add the dry Rice and Vegetable Broth to the Instant Pot, then close your device and set it to sealing. Cook on Manual High Pressure for 22 minutes, then let the iPot naturally release pressure for 10 minutes before shifting the valve to venting.
3.  Stir the fresh Lime Juice into the rice, and add Salt to taste.
4. Fold in the diced Cilantro Leaves, then serve as desired. Refrigerate leftovers in a sealed container for up to 5 days.

recipes.name: Basic stovetop barley
instructions: 1. Place the barley into a saucepan. Add the water and a pinch of salt.
2. Over medium-high heat, bring the water to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and cook.
3. Cooking time for pearl barley is around 35 minutes.
4. Turn off the heat, stir the barley, cover the saucepan and let it stand for another 5 to 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Black rice
instructions: 1. Add water and rinsed black rice to a saucepan.

2. Over medium-high heat, bring the water to a boil. Add the salt, reduce heat, cover and cook for about 30-35 minutes. (Don't open the lid too often because this will let a lot of steam out.) Continue cooking until the rice is tender and chewy and all water is absorbed.
3. Take off the heat and let it stand covered for about 5 to 10 minutes then fluff with a fork and serve.

recipes.name: German red cabbage
instructions: 1. Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring frequently, until the onion start to brown.

2. Increase the heat to medium-high and start adding the cabbage a few handfuls at a time stirring constantly to make sure the cabbage doesn't burn. If at any time you feel that your pan is overheated take it off the burner for a few seconds. Once the first batch wilts a bit and becomes fragrant add the next batch. Repeat the steps until you've transferred all the cabbage into the pot.
3. Reduce the heat to medium and add the vegetable broth, apple cider vinegar, chopped apple, bay leaf, cinnamon, and garlic. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well to combine.

4. Cover the pot and cook for about 30 minutes or until the cabbage is very tender. Make sure to check on it and stir every so often. Add more vegetable broth if needed. However, all liquid should have evaporated by the end of the cooking time. If the cabbage is done but you still have a lot of liquid, open the lid and bring the heat to medium high. The liquid should evaporate quickly.

recipes.name: Cooked buckwheat
instructions: 1. Place the uncooked buckwheat into a fine-mesh strainer and rinse under cool running water until the water runs clear. Drain it well.
2. In a saucepan (covered with lid), bring the cold water, unsalted butter and the salt to a boil over high heat.

3. Stir in the buckwheat into boiled water and cover saucepan with lid. Bring back to a gentle simmer and reduce the heat to low. Cook until the water is absorbed, 13-15 minutes. (Just like rice, you should hear hissing while it’s cooking and it will get quiet once done).
4. Remove from heat and let the buckwheat rest covered for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork and serve.
5. Enjoy fresh or refrigerate once cooled. Avoid leaving at room temperature for prolonged hours.

recipes.name: Buckwheat kasha
instructions: 1. Prepare all ingredients for the buckwheat dish. To cook buckwheat: Bring water to boil, add buckwheat and salt to taste, cook on low heat for 20-25 minutes.
2. Preheat a pan, add butter and onion to the pan. Add diced mushrooms to the mix and cook until it becomes golden brown.
3. Combine mushroom mixture with buckwheat, let it sit for about 5 min to allow flavors to come together.
4. Finally, add in fresh green onion and stir to combine everything together. Serve right away.

recipes.name: Millet and greens salad
instructions: 1. Bring 1 inch of water to a boil in a medium saucepan over high heat, add salt, and add the asparagus. Cover and simmer for 2 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking and preserve the green color.

2. Whisk together the oil, vinegar, onion, mustard, salt and pepper in a bowl. Add the cooled asparagus, arugula, basil, cherries and millet. Toss everything to combine with the dressing and serve at room temperature.

ingredients.description: asparagus, cut into bite size pieces

recipes.name: Mediterranean farro salad
instructions: 1. Boil farro in water. Add a splash or olive oil and a pinch of salt to water. Let cook for 25 minutes. There will be almost no water at end of 25 minutes. If there is drain in a colander. Let cooked farro aside to cool down.
2. Chop the shallot, add in a container with cold water. This will remove the strong smell.
3. Dice the bell pepper. Peel and dice the cucumber too.
4. Chop the cilantro and then squeeze the lime.
5. Finally start assembling the salad in a salad bowl. There's no proper order to do this, you can just mix everything together.
6.Mix everything together and serve.

recipes.name: Farro and orange salad
instructions: 1. Cook farro according to package directions. Drain and set aside to cool completely.
2. In a glass measuring cup or mason jar, combine dressing ingredients and shake to blend completely.
3. In a wide serving dish, add cooled farro and top with the remaining ingredients except reserve some of the oranges, almonds and parsley to use as a garnish on top.
4. Toss with dressing. Garnish with additional toppings.

ingredients.description: canned mandarin oranges, keep the liquid

recipes.name: Creamy tomato soup
instructions: 1. heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. cook onion, garlic and celery for 3 minutes or until tender.
2.add tomato and water, cover and cook 10 minutes or until it just comes to the boil. transfer to a blender and blend until smooth. return soup to the saucepan. bring to the boil.
3.blend cornflour with a little evaporated milk. add to the soup and bring to the boil, stirring. remove from the heat and stir in remaining evaporated milk.
4.serve sprinkled with feta cheese, basil and pinenut.

recipes.name: Thick vegetable and pasta soup
instructions: 1.heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat; add onion, garlic and bacon, cook 2 minutes.
2.add combined water, stock cube and tomato paste, bring to boil.
3.add celery, carrot, potato, cabbage, tomato and zucchini; simmer covered for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally until vegetables are tender.
4.add pasta, cook a further 15 minutes. sprinkle with parsley before serving.

recipes.name: Chilled cucumber soup
instructions: 1.cut cucumber in half lengthways, remove seeds. slice 2 halves thinly; grate remaining cucumber.

2.heat a large saucepan over low heat; add oil, sliced cucumber, leek and bay leaf; cook for 10 minutes without browning. add flour, cook 1 minute; gradually stir in stock, cover and simmer 20 minutes. remove bay leaf, puree soup in a food processor or blender.
3.stir in grated cucumber, cooking cream and lemon juice; chill.
4.if desired, garnish with a sprinkle of paprika.

recipes.name: Mild curried potato and pumpkin soup
instructions: 1.heat a large saucepan over high heat; add oil, onion, pumpkin, carrot and potato; cook for 2 minutes; add curry powder, stir 1 minute or until fragrant.
2.Add stock and stock cube, bring to the boil; simmer, covered for 20 minutes. Pour into a food processor or blender; blend until smooth.
3.Return to saucepan, add cooking cream, reheat without boiling. If desired, serve garnished with chopped parsley or coriander. Swirl with Sweet Chili Sauce if desired.

recipes.name: Leek soup
instructions: 1.heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat; cook the leek for 2 minutes. add garlic and paprika, cook a further 2 minutes.
2.add potato and water. bring to the boil; reduce heat, cover and simmer 10 minutes or until the vegetables are soft. stir in cooking cream.

recipes.name: Leek and spinach soup
instructions: 1.cook pasta shells according to directions on packet, drain; set aside.
2.meanwhile, heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat; add leek, cook until soft.
3.add spinach and water, bring to the boil, reduce heat, simmer 5 minutes. transfer to a to blender or food processor with cooking cream, blend until pureed.

recipes.name: Golden carrot soup
instructions: 1.heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat; add carrot, onion, garlic and bay leaf; cook 5 minutes. add stock, bring to the boil, simmer 15 minutes or until tender. remove bay leaves and discard.

recipes.name: Creamy pumpkin soup
instructions: 1.melt margarine in large saucepan over medium heat; add onion, cook 2 minutes. add stock and pumpkin; bring to boil, reduce heat, simmer uncovered 25 minutes or until pumpkin is tender.
2.place pumpkin and liquid in blender or food processor, process until smooth; return to saucepan.
3.add cooking cream  and nutmeg, reheat, do not boil.
4.serve with a dollop of light sour cream and chives, if desired.

recipes.name: Creamy thai chicken soup
instructions: 1.heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat; add chicken, cook 2 minutes; add onion and pepper, cook 1 minute; stir in curry paste, cook 1 minute, or until fragrant.
2.add stock; bring to the boil; blend cornflour with 1 tablespoon cooking cream add to pan with remaining milk and fish sauce. bring to the boil; add zucchini and pea, simmer 1 minute.

recipes.name: Minestrone soup with chorizo
instructions: 1.cook chorizo in a large saucepan over a high heat until crisp, stirring. add garlic and onion and cook 2-3 minutes.
2.add tomatoes, stock cube, tomato paste, cumin, oregano, sugar and water and bring to the boil. simmer 5 minutes.
3.add kidney beans and corn and cook 2 minutes
4.stir in parsley before serving.

ingredients.description: canned red kidney beans, drained, rinsed

recipes.name: Creamy chicken sweet corn soup
instructions: 1.heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat; add onion and chicken and cook 4 minutes or until browned. add mushroom, cook a further 1 minute.
2.combine water, cornflour and stock cube; add to the saucepan with creamed corn and corn kernels.
3.stir soup until it comes to the boil; stir in cooking cream; remove from heat, stir in egg and allow to set. serve sprinkled with green onion.

recipes.name: Spinach and blue cheese soup
instructions: 1.heat butter in a large saucepan over low heat. add onion and leek, cook 15 minutes or until soft and lightly golden, stirring occasionally.
2.add chicken stock, spinach; bring to the boil; simmer 5 minutes.
3.puree in a blender or food processor. return to saucepan; add cheese and cream; cook over a low heat until warmed through.

recipes.name: Creamy parsnip and cauliflower soup
instructions: 1.heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat; add onion, cook 2 minutes or until soft. add parsnip, potato, cauliflower and chicken stock; bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer, covered, 12 minutes or until the vegetables are soft.
2.remove from heat, add cooking cream, puree with a stick blender or in a blender. gently reheat if necessary and serve sprinkled with walnut.

recipes.name: Barley and vegetable soup
instructions: 1.heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat; add onion and carrot; cook for 5 minutes or until onion is soft. add tomato, tomato paste, barley, stock. bring to the boil, reduce heat; simmer for 30 minutes.
2.add the peas; simmer for 2-3 minutes; add spinach and parsley and simmer for further 1-2 minutes.

recipes.name: Seafood chowder
