instructions: 1.heat a large saucepan over medium heat; spray with oil. add onion and celery, cook for 3 minutes or until soft. add garlic and cook for 1 minute
2.add potato, stir to combine; add stock. bring to the boil; reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, for 20 minutes or until the potato is very tender.

3.add fish and simmer for 3–4 minutes or until the fish is cooked. use a potato masher to mash the vegetables and fish until almost smooth or a food processor to puree the soup and make it very smooth.

ingredients.description: potato, peeled and cut into small cubes

recipes.name: Dairy-free pea and leek soup
instructions: 1.Combine the leek, potato and stock in a large saucepan. Place over high heat. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook, partially covered, for 20 mins or until potato is tender.
2.Reserve 25g  peas. Add the remaining peas to the pan and bring to a simmer. Set aside to cool slightly.

3.Use a stick blender to carefully blend the pea mixture until smooth. Return pan to medium heat. Add the lemon juice and reserved peas. Stir until heated through. Season well. Divide the soup evenly among serving bowls.

ingredients.description: leek, pale section only, thickly sliced

recipes.name: Air fryer fried rice
instructions: 1.Preheat the air fryer to 180C. Place the chicken and bacon on the air fryer rack. Cook for 8 minutes or until cooked through. Transfer to a plate and set aside to cool slightly. Slice the chicken and chop the bacon.

2.Meanwhile, use your fingers to separate the rice grains in the packet. Microwave the rice for 1 minute. Transfer to a round 20cm, high-sided ovenproof dish or cake pan. Add the oyster sauce, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger and 2 tablespoons water. Stir to combine.

3.Place the dish or pan in the air fryer. Cook for 5 minutes or until the rice is tender. Stir through the egg, peas, chicken and half of the bacon. Cook for 3 minutes or until the egg is cooked through. Stir in half the shallot and season with salt and white pepper.
4.Serve sprinkled with chili, remaining shallot, remaining bacon and extra oyster sauce.

recipes.name: 5 ingredient meatball carbonara
instructions: 1.Cook pasta in a large saucepan of boiling, salted water, following packet directions. Drain, reserving 1/3 cup cooking liquid.

2.Meanwhile, squeeze sausage mince from casings. Roll level tablespoons of mixture into balls. Heat oil in a large, deep frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook meatballs, in batches, turning for 5 to 6 minutes or until browned and cooked through.

3.Add cream and reserved cooking liquid. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to low. Simmer for 2 to 3 minutes or until sauce thickens slightly. Add 1/2 cup parmesan. Stir until smooth and combined. Add pasta and spinach. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes or until spinach wilts and pasta is coated in sauce. Serve sprinkled with remaining parmesan.

recipes.name: One pan thai coconut chicken
instructions: 1.Heat oil in a large, deep frying pan over high heat. Add chicken. Cook, turning for 2 to 3 minutes or until browned. Add 1/2 cup curry sauce. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes or until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through. Transfer to a plate.
2.Place remaining sauce in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on HIGH (100%) for 20 to 30 seconds or until heated through.

3.Meanwhile, add rice and vegetables to pan. Cook, stirring, for 2 to 3 minutes or until vegetables and rice are heated through. Top with chicken and drizzle with remaining sauce. Serve sprinkled with coriander.

recipes.name: Lentil pasta, with turkey, beans and cherry tomatoes
instructions: 1.Cook pasta in a large saucepan of salted boiling water following packet directions, adding the beans in the last 2 minutes of cooking.

2.Meanwhile, heat the oil in a deep non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes or until the onion softens. Add the garlic and chili flakes. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until aromatic. Add the turkey and cook, using a wooden spoon to break up any lumps, for 5 minutes or until browned.
3.Addtomato, vinegar and 60ml (1 ⁄4 cup) water. Bring to the boil then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Add pasta, beans and spinach. Toss to combine. Top with spoonfuls of ricotta to serve.

recipes.name: Tuscan chicken spaghetti
instructions: 1.Cook the pasta in a large saucepan of boiling, salted water, following packet directions or until al dente. Drain.

2.Heat 0,5 tablespoon of the oil in a large deep frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken, stirring, for 2-3 minutes or until browned and almost cooked through. Add tomatoes and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes or until warmed through.

3.Add the cream and spinach. Cook, stirring, for 2 minutes or until spinach just wilts. Add cheese and spaghetti. Toss gently to combine. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons oil. Toss gently to coat. Season. Top with basil, if desired.

ingredients.description: rosmary infused extra virgin olive oil

recipes.name: 22 minutes spiced lamb cutlets with couscous salad
instructions: 1.Sprinkle lamb with cumin. Season. Heat 11 ⁄2 tbs oil in a large non-stick frying pan over high heat. Add onion and pepper. Season. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Push pepper mixture to the side. Add lamb. Cook, turning lamb and moving pepper mixture, for 5 minutes or until lamb is cooked to your liking and pepper mixture has softened. Remove from heat. Squeeze over 1 lemon half.

2.Meanwhile, place couscous and lemon rind in a heatproof bowl. Add boiling water and remaining oil. Cover with a plate. Set aside for 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Use a fork to separate grains. Add coriander, reserving a few leaves and chickpeas. Squeeze over remaining lemon half. Season. Stir to combine.
3.Place yoghurt in a serving bowl. Swirl through harissa. Serve with lamb, pepper mixture and couscous, topped with reserved coriander.

recipes.name: One pot chicken alfredo tortellini
instructions: 1.Heat oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the onion and garlic. Cook, stirring often, for 5 minutes or until softened. Add the thyme and chicken. Cook, stirring, for 3 minutes or until chicken is light golden.

2.Add the cream and 45ml water to the pan. Bring to the boil. Add the tortellini. Simmer, stirring occasionally, for 6 minutes or until mixture is thickened and tortellini is tender. Season. Stir in the shallot, 10g of the cheese and half of the parsley and chives until combined.
3.Serve pasta topped with the remaining cheese, sprinkled with the remaining herbs.

ingredients.description: chicken breast fillet, cut into 2 cm pices

recipes.name: One pan fish with beans and tomatoes
instructions: 1.Season the fish. Heat half of the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the fish for 2-3 minutes each side or until golden and cooked through. Transfer to a plate and cover to keep warm.

2.Add the remaining oil to the pan. Cook the leek for 1-2 minutes or until just softened. Add the garlic and pine nuts, and cook for 1 minute or until lightly golden. Add the baby capers and cherry tomatoes, and cook, stirring often, for 3-4 minutes or until tomatoes just begin to collapse.

3.Add the cannellini beans and baby spinach, and cook, stirring, until spinach has wilted. Add the lemon juice and season well. Return the fish to the pan and warm through. Arrange on a serving plate. Serve with cracked pepper and lemon wedges.

ingredients.description: cod fillet, thick, taken from the head end rather than the tail end of the fish

recipes.name: Ham and macadamia pesto zoodles
instructions: 1.Combine basil, garlic, nuts and parmesan in a small food processor. Process until finely chopped. With motor operating, gradually add oil and juice until pesto is almost smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
2.Place zucchini zoodles and peas in a large heatproof bowl. Cover with boiling water. Stand for 2 minutes. Drain well.

3.Place zoodle mixture and pesto in a large bowl. Toss gently to combine. Arrange zoodle mixture and ham in a serving bowl. Dollop with ricotta. Sprinkle with chopped toast and extra basil leaves. Serve.

ingredients.description: fresh basil leaves, plus extre leaves to serve

recipes.name: Mexican green rice lamb
instructions: 1.Process the coriander, parsley, pickled jalapeño and brine, shallot and garlic in a food processor until a coarse paste forms.

2.Heat the oil in a large frying pan over high heat. Add the lamb and cook for 2 minutes. Sprinkle the cumin over the lamb, then turn the lamb and cook for a further 2 minutes for medium or until cooked to your liking. Season. Transfer to a plate. Cover with foil. Set aside for 5 minutes to rest. Thinly slice the lamb.

3.Meanwhile, heat the rice following the packet directions and add to the frying pan. Stir in three-quarters of the herb paste until well combined. Reduce the heat to low and cover the pan. Cook for 2-3 minutes to develop the flavours. Stir in the lime juice.
4.Divide the rice mixture among serving bowls and top with the lamb. Dollop with the remaining herb paste. Top with the rocket, sliced chili and extra coriander. Serve with lime halves.

ingredients.description: fresh coriander, coarsley chopped, plus extra to serve
pickled jalapeno chilies, chopped, plus 1 tsp pickling liquid
lime, juiced, plus a lime quarter to serve

recipes.name: Chicken and chorizo with warm potato salad
instructions: 1.Thickly slice potato. Place in a saucepan of boiling water. Cook for 10-12 minutes or until tender. Add the peas for the last 2 minutes of cooking. Drain and return to pan. Set aside, covered, to keep warm.

2.Meanwhile, heat oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add chorizo and cook, stirring, for 3-4 minutes or until crisp. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel. Add the chicken to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes each side or until golden and cooked through. Season well. Transfer to a separate plate and cover to keep warm.
3.Chop half the mint and reserve. Add the remaining whole leaves to the pan. Cook in the residual oil until just crisp. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel.

4.Fold the spinach and chopped mint through the potatoes and peas. Season. Arrange the warm potato salad on a serving plate. Top with the chicken tenderloins, chorizo, fried mint leaves and pistachios. Drizzle with any pan juices. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Salmon and crispy lettuce with pearl couscous
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 180C/160C fan forced. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Cook the couscous according to the packet directions. Drain.
2.Meanwhile, spread the lettuce over the prepared tray. Spray with oil. Season. Bake for 10 minutes.
3.Place couscous, crispy lettuce, zucchini, shallot, sprouts and salmon on a platter. Combine oil, garlic and vinegar in a bowl. Drizzle over the top. Season. Gently toss.

ingredients.description: snow peas, cut into short lenghts

recipes.name: 15-minute chicken and pumpkin laksa
instructions: 1.Heat a large, deep saucepan over medium-high heat. Add the laksa paste and ginger paste and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until aromatic. Add the stock and bring to a simmer. Add the chicken and pumpkin. Reduce heat to medium-low. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 mins or until chicken is cooked through and the pumpkin is tender.
2.Meanwhile, place the noodles in a large heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Set aside for 5 mins or until noodles soften. Drain well.
3.Add the coconut milk and choy sum to the stock mixture. Stir until the choy sum wilts and the mixture is heated through.
4.Put the noodles in a serving bowl. Spoon over the laksa and sprinkle with bean sprouts and chili, if using.

recipes.name: Honey sesame and ginger salad
instructions: 1.To make the salad, whisk together the vinegar, honey, sesame oil and ginger in a small bowl. Season with salt. Place the salad leaves and tomato in a large bowl. Add the dressing and toss to combine.
2.Arrange the salad on a serving plate and eat it with roasted salmon or with some other meat.

ingredients.description: rice vinegar, or apple cider vinegar

recipes.name: Apricot chicken tray bake
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 200C/180C fan-forced. Grease a large baking tray with sides. Line tray with baking paper.

2.Drain apricots, reserving 1/3 cup juice. Remove leaves from t5he half of the rosemary sprig. Finely chop. Place chicken stock, chopped rosemary, oil and reserved juice in a jug. Stir until well combined. Arrange chicken, apricots, potato and onion, in a single layer, on prepared tray. Drizzle over soup mixture. Season with salt and pepper.
3.Bake, turning chicken and adding remaining rosemary sprigs halfway, for 45 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and potato is tender. Serve.

ingredients.description: red onion, cut into thin wedges

recipes.name: Sticky mango pork and roast vegie tray bake
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 220C/200C fan-forced. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Place vegetables on prepared tray. Roast for 20 minutes.

2.Meanwhile, heat oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add pork. Cook, turning, for 5 minutes or until browned on all sides. Remove pan from heat. Add 1 tbsp mango chutney. Turn pork to coat in chutney.
3.Add pork to vegetables in oven. Drizzle pork with chutney from pan. Bake for 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender and pork is just cooked through.
4.Meanwhile, place yoghurt in a serving bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Swirl through remaining chutney. Slice pork. Serve with vegetables and yoghurt, sprinkled with coriander.

ingredients.description: frozen veggies (e.g. broccoli, carrot, corn, peas)

recipes.name: Cheesy baked mushrooms in tomato sauce
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 200C/180C fan-forced.

2.Pour tomatoes over base of a roasting pan. Season well with salt and pepper. Drizzle over 1 tablespoon of oil. Stir to combine. Top with mushrooms. Drizzle with remaining oil. Season with salt and pepper.
3.Combine corn thins and cheese in a bowl. Top mushrooms with mixture. Bake for 30 minutes or until sauce slightly thickens and mushrooms are tender. Sprinkle with rocket. Serve.

recipes.name: Mediterranean salmon tray bake
instructions: 1.Preheat the oven to 200C/180C fan forced. Evenly arrange the potato over base of a large baking dish. Evenly scatter with the cherry tomatoes. Drizzle over the oil then bake for 15 minutes.
2.Arrange the salmon, skin-side down, in the dish. Sprinkle with the olives, capers and lemon rind. Season well. Bake for a further 10 minutes.
3.Scatter with the basil. Serve immediately with the mixed salad leaves.

ingredients.description: baby potato, (coliban) cut into 1 cm thick slices

recipes.name: Steak with smashed minted peas recipe
recipes.description: A juicy scotch fillet teams deliciously with low-cal, low-fat nutrient-stacked smashed peas.
instructions: 1.Cook the peas in a saucepan of boiling water following packet directions. Drain then return peas to the pan. Coarsely mash.

2.Meanwhile, heat half the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Season the steaks. Cook for 2-3 minutes each side for medium or until cooked to your liking. Transfer to a plate and cover to rest.

3.Wipe the frying pan clean. Heat remaining oil over medium-high heat. Add asparagus and garlic. Stir for 2 minutes. Add zucchini. Toss gently for 30 seconds or until just tender. Remove from heat. Add mint and toss.
4.Arrange smashed peas on a serving plate. Top with the steak and zucchini mixture. Sprinkle with feta. Season and serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Indian chicken with rice
recipes.description: You only need fifteen minutes prep for these flavour-filled Indian spiced chicken drumsticks.
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 180C/160C fan-forced. Place yoghurt, paste and garlic in a large bowl. Add chicken. Stir to coat.

2.Heat oil in a heavy-based, flameproof roasting pan over medium-high heat. Add onion. Cook, stirring, for 5 minutes or until light golden. Add ginger, curry leaves and peanuts. Cook, stirring, for 2 to 3 minutes or until nuts are golden. Add rice. Stir to coat.

3.Add stock and milk to rice mixture. Bring to the boil, stirring occasionally. Place chicken on top. Cover tightly with foil. Bake for 40 minutes. Remove foil. Move chicken to one side. Fluff rice with a fork. Arrange chicken and peas over rice. Bake, uncovered, for 5 to 10 minutes or until rice is tender and chicken is browned and cooked through.
4.Serve chicken sprinkled with shallots, coriander and chili.

recipes.name: Tabouli-stuffed roasted eggplant
recipes.description: This delicious vegetarian side is perfect for mid-week dinner or when friends come over on the weekend.
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 180C/160C fan-forced. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Using a skewer, prick eggplant halves all over. Place on prepared tray. Spray with oil. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden and tender.
2.Meanwhile, prepare burghul following packet directions. Set burghul aside for 10 minutes to cool.
3.Make Yoghurt and Garlic Dressing. Combine yoghurt, garlic, cumin, half the zest and 2 tablespoons water in a small bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
4.Place tomato in a large bowl. Add parsley, mint, onion, lemon juice, oil and burghul. Season with salt and pepper. Stir until well combined.

5.Using a metal teaspoon and leaving a 1cm border, scoop out eggplant esh. Roughly chop esh. Add to tabouli mixture. Stir to combine. Transfer eggplant shells to a serving plate. Spoon tabouli mixture evenly into shells. Drizzle with a little dressing. Top with remaining zest and extra mint leaves. Serve.

recipes.name: Spicy apricot chicken wings with roasted broccoli salad
recipes.description: Impress the whole family at dinner time with these spicy apricot chicken wings.
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 220C/200C fan-forced. Line 2 large baking trays with baking paper.

2.Whisk jams and soy sauce together in a large bowl. Reserve 1⁄4 cup marinade. Add chicken. Stir to coat. Place a wire rack over 1 baking tray. Place chicken, skin-side up, on wire rack. Roast for 40 to 45 minutes, basting with reserved marinade during the last 15 minutes of cooking time.

3.Meanwhile, place broccoli, in a single layer, on remaining tray. Combine garlic, chili and 2 tablespoons oil in a small bowl. Drizzle oil over broccoli. Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, sprinkling with almonds halfway through cooking time. Season.
4.Transfer broccoli mixture to a large bowl. Add rocket, dried apricots, cranberries and chives. Drizzle over lemon juice and remaining oil. Toss to combine.
5.Divide broccoli mixture among serving plates. Top with wings. Serve.

ingredients.description: broccoli, cut into 1 cm thick slices

recipes.name: One-pan creamy chicken and bacon
recipes.description: For an easy mid-week dinner try this delicious all-in-one creamy chicken and bacon.
instructions: 1.Heat half the oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken. Cook, turning, for 5 minutes or until golden and browned. Transfer to a plate.

2.Add remaining oil to pan. Add onion and bacon. Cook, stirring, for 5 minutes or until onion softens and bacon is golden. Add garlic. Cook, stirring, for 30 seconds or until fragrant. Transfer 1/4 of the bacon mixture to a bowl. Cover to keep warm.

3.Return chicken to pan with cream, stock, parmesan and 0,5 cup water. Bring to the boil. Reduce heat to medium. Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened.

4.Stir in peas and spinach. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Remove pan from heat. Stir in lemon rind. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with reserved cooked bacon. Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.name: One-pan roasted prawns with parmesan asparagus
recipes.description: Turn up the heat with this super easy one-pan chilli roasted prawns, served with delicious, in-season asparagus and freshly grated parmesan
instructions: 1.Position a rack in the lower third of oven and preheat oven to 250°C (230°C fan-forced). Line a large rimmed baking tray with baking paper.
2.On the lined tray, toss asparagus with 1 tbs oil. Arrange in 1 even row over one-half of tray. Sprinkle three-quarters of the parmesan evenly over asparagus.

3.Using paper towel, pat prawns dry. In a medium bowl, toss prawns with garlic, paprika, chili flakes, if using, remaining 1 tbs oil, ¾ tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Spread the prawns evenly over the other side of the tray.
4.Roast for 10 mins or until prawns are cooked through and asparagus is tender. Sprinkle prawns with parsley. Sprinkle asparagus with remaining parmesan. Serve with lemon wedges and bread.

ingredients.description: tiger prawns, peeled, leaving tails intact, deveined

recipes.name: One-pan summer lemon chicken with risoni
recipes.description: This summery one pan chicken dish can go straight from the stove top to the table. Dig in.
instructions: 1.Heat oil in a large heavy-based cast-iron frying pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken. Cook for 6 minutes each side or until golden. Transfer to a large plate.

2.Add onion and garlic to pan. Cook, stirring, for 3 minutes or until onion softens. Add risoni. Cook, stirring for 2 minutes or until risoni starts to brown. Add wine. Cook for 1 minute until almost evaporated. Add stock and lemon juice. Bring to a simmer.

3.Return chicken to pan, skin-side up. Reduce heat to medium-low. Cook for 10 minutes or until risoni is almost tender. Stir risoni. Top with zucchini and tomatoes. Cover. Cook for 5 minutes or until zucchini and risoni are just tender. Sprinkle with basil and lemon zest. Serve.

recipes.name: One-pan chicken with tomato and potatoes
recipes.description: Nothing beats baked chicken and veggies in a rich sauce.
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 180°C. Combine tomato paste, garlic, cumin, coriander and chili, if using, in a small bowl.

2.Cut 3 slits in top of the chicken. Rub tomato paste mixture over chicken. Place in a large roasting pan with the potato, onion, cherry tomato and 20ml water. Sprinkle with half the thyme. Spray with olive oil spray and season.
3.Bake for 1 hour or until chicken is cooked through. Stir in the spinach and sprinkle with remaining thyme.

recipes.name: Magic sticky tofu
recipes.description: This quick and easy vegetarian tofu stir-fry has a simple Asian sauce you'll want to put on everything.
instructions: 1.Heat the oil in a large wok over high heat until smoking. Add half the tofu. Cook, turning occasionally, for 3 minutes or until golden. Use a slotted spoon to transfer to a plate lined with paper towel. Repeat with the remaining tofu.

2.Drain the oil from the pan. Add the passata, chili sauce, soy sauce and sugar to the wok. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes or until thickened. Return the tofu to the wok and toss to combine. Serve sticky tofu on rice with broccoli and shallot.

ingredients.description: frim tofu, cut into 2,5 cm pieces
medium grain rice, steamed, to serve

recipes.name: One-pan creamy Tuscan salmon
recipes.description: For a quick and easy dinner, you can't beat this one-pan winner - the creamy sun-dried tomato sauce is so nice with the salmon.
instructions: 1.Heat half the reserved oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the salmon for 1 minute each side or until golden. Transfer to a plate.

2.Heat the remaining reserved oil in the same pan over medium-high heat. Cook the onion and garlic, stirring often, for 5 minutes or until softened. Add the cream and 80ml (1/3 cup) water. Bring to the boil. Return the salmon to the pan. Add the sun-dried tomato. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 minutes or until salmon is almost cooked through.
3.Stir through the spinach and capers. Cook for 1-2 minutes or until spinach is wilted. Scatter over the basil and serve with crusty bread.

ingredients.description: sun-dried tomato in oil, chopped, 1,5 tbsp oil reserved

recipes.name: Strawberry banana smoothie with peanut butter
instructions: 1.Place all ingredients in a high-speed blender and mix until smooth.
2.Serve with a drizzle of peanut butter and fresh fruit.

recipes.name: Triple berry smoothie
instructions: 1.Place all ingredients in a high-speed blender and mix until smooth.

recipes.name: Blueberry banana smoothie
instructions: 1.Place all ingredients into a high speed blender and blend until smooth.

recipes.name: Dark chocolate date smoothie
instructions: 1.Place all ingredients into a high-speed blender and mix until smooth.

recipes.name: Apple pie smoothie bowl
instructions: 1.Place all ingredients in a high-speed blender. Blend until smooth.
2.Serve with lots of fixings on top!

recipes.name: Pineapple upside down strawberry smoothie
instructions: 1.Place all ingredients for your strawberry pineapple smoothie into a high-speed blender.
2.Blend on high until smooth. Depending on how frozen your fruit is, you may need to add more almond milk.
3.Serve with extra fresh pineapple chunks on the bottom.

ingredients.description: pineapple, peeled, roughly cut into 2 cm pieces, frozen

recipes.name: Kale smoothie
instructions: 1.Place all ingredients in a high-speed blender and blend on high until smooth. Option to add more orange juice as needed.

recipes.name: Carrot cake smoothie
instructions: 1.In a high speed blender, blend all ingredients (minus the additional carrot) together until creamy and smooth.
2.If desired, mix in additional finely grated carrot (highly recommend!). Top with a few chopped walnut and enjoy!

recipes.name: Beet Smoothie
instructions: 1.Place the almond milk, blueberries, beet, pineapple, and Greek yogurt in a high speed blender (if you do not have a high speed blender, I’d suggest microwaving, roasting, or lightly steaming the beet before using so that they are softer and puree more smoothly).
2.Blend until smooth. Taste and if you desire a sweeter smoothie, add a little honey or date and blend again. Enjoy immediately or refrigerate for up to 1 day.

recipes.name: Berry turmeric smoothie
instructions: 1.Place the ingredients in a high-powered blender in the order listed: almond milk, spinach, yogurt, oats, berries, turmeric, ginger, and 1,5 teaspoon honey.

2.Blend until smooth. Taste and adjust sweetness as desired. If you do not have a high-powered blender, I recommend blending the almond milk, spinach, and yogurt first, and then adding the other ingredients. Enjoy immediately.

recipes.name: Creamy Citrus Ginger Smoothie
instructions: 1.Add all of the ingredients into blender – make sure your oranges are segmented if you prefer a more pulp-free orange juice.
2.Blend until smooth. Add more ice or liquid for desired consistency.

recipes.name: Watermelon
instructions: 1.Wash the fruit.
2.Cut into cubes.
3.Enjoy!

recipes.name: Redcurrant
instructions: 1.Wash the fruit.
2.Arrange in a bowl.
3.Enjoy!

recipes.name: Melone
instructions: 1.Wash the fruit.
2.Cut into cubes.
3.Enjoy!

recipes.name: Blackberries
instructions: 1.Wash the fruit.
2.Arrange in a bowl.
3.Enjoy!

recipes.name: Mandarin
instructions: 1.Wash the fruit.
2.Peel it.
3.Enjoy!

recipes.name: Blood orange
instructions: 1.Wash the fruit.
2.Peel it.
3.Enjoy!

recipes.name: Passion fruit
instructions: 1.Wash the fruit.
2.Cut into halves.
3.Eat it with a spoon.

recipes.name: Grapefruit
instructions: 1.Wash the fruit.
2.Cut into halves.
3.Enjoy!

recipes.name: Tortellini Skewers
instructions: 1.Fill a pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil; stir in tortellini. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the tortellini float to the top, 5 to 6 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water.
2.Place tortellini, cherry tomatoes, and pesto in a bowl; toss until evenly coated.
3.Arrange the ingredients on a skewer. Put on a plate. Keep refrigerated until serving.

recipes.name: Prosciutto e Melone
instructions: 1.Remove the flesh from the rind of the cantaloupe; wrap each piece of cantaloupe with a slice of the ham. Serve cold.

ingredients.description: cantaloupe, seeded and cut into wedges

recipes.name: Caprese Appetizer
instructions: 1.Toss tomatoe, mozzarella cheese, olive oil, basil, salt, and pepper together in a bowl until well coated. Skewer one tomato and one piece of mozzarella cheese on each toothpick.

recipes.name: Olive Balls
instructions: 1.In a bowl, or food processor, mix together the cream cheese, seasoning salt, and 1 tablespoon of juice from the olive jar until well blended. Set aside in the refrigerator to firm up, about 30 minutes.

2.When the cheese mixture is firm, pack enough of the cream cheese mixture around the outside of each olive so that it is completely covered. Roll each olive ball in chopped pecans, and return them to the refrigerator until firm.
3.To serve, cut each olive ball in half, and arrange on a serving tray cut side up.

recipes.name: Sausage Stuffed Jalapenos
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 220 degrees C.
2.Place sausage in a skillet over medium heat, and cook until evenly brown. Drain grease.
3.In a bowl, mix the sausage, cream cheese, and Parmesan cheese. Spoon about 1 tablespoon sausage mixture into each jalapeno half. Arrange stuffed halves in baking dishes.
4.Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until bubbly and lightly browned. Serve with Ranch dressing.

recipes.name: Bacon and Date Appetizer
instructions: 1.Preheat the broiler.
2.Slit dates. Place one almond inside each date. Wrap dates with bacon, using toothpicks to hold them together.
3.Broil 10 minutes, or until bacon is evenly brown and crisp.

recipes.name: Watermelon Caprese Appetizer
instructions: 1.Trim basil leaves into small circles about 1 inch in diameter.
2.Thread watermelon and mozzarella cheese on toothpicks, sandwiching a basil leaf in between. Arrange on a serving plate.
3.Pour olive oil and balsamic vinegar over toothpicks. Sprinkle salt and black pepper on top.

recipes.name: Cheese Stuffed Mushroom Appetizer
instructions: 1.Sprinkle the mushrrom cups with salt and balckpepper.
2.In a bowl mix feta cheese, butter, and chopped chives together.
3.Fill mushrooms with the mixture, put on a baking tray, and bake for about 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Cucumber Sandwich Appetizers
instructions: 1.Mix cream cheese, sour cream, and Italian salad dressing mix in a bowl until well blended.
2.Spread cream cheese mixture atop pumpernickel party bread and top each slice with 2 cucumber slices.

recipes.name: Italian Salami Appetizer Kebabs
instructions: 1.In skillet over medium heat cook meatballs 5 to 6 minutes or until heated through; turn frequently to brown.

2.To assemble kebabs, wrap 1 basil leaf around 1 cherry tomato; thread onto skewer. Thread 1 heated meatball. Wrap 1 mozzarella ball with a halved salami slice; thread onto skewer. Repeat with remaining ingredients.

recipes.name: Cucumber and Olive Appetizers
instructions: 1.In a small bowl, combine the cream cheese and blue cheese dressing. Spread the cheese mixture on the rye bread slices. Top with a slice of cucumber and a slice of olive.

recipes.name: Smoked Sausage and Apple Stuffing Bites
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 220 degrees C. Coat a mini-muffin pan with cooking spray.
2.Arrange bread on a baking sheet in a single layer. Bake until toasted and dry, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and place in a bowl. Reduce oven temperature to 180 degrees C.

3.Heat butter in a skillet over medium-high until foamy, about 2 minutes. Add sausage; cook about 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned. Add apple, onion, garlic, and sage; cook 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until apple and onion are slightly softened. Remove from heat and cool 5 minutes. Transfer to the bowl with bread.

4.Add chicken stock, parsley, salt, pepper, nutmeg, and eggs to bowl with bread mixture; toss gently until moistened. Divide mixture among muffin cups. Bake until set, about 20 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Use a small offset spatula to carefully remove from pans; serve warm.

recipes.name: Bacon Chicken Livers
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to broil setting.
2.Cut each slice of bacon in half and wrap around each chicken liver, securing with toothpicks.
3.Broil until bacon is cooked and crisp on one side, then turn and repeat (about 6 to 8 minutes each side). Serve with honey in a bowl, for dipping.

recipes.name: Double Tomato Bruschetta
recipes.description: A delicious and easy appetizer. The balsamic vinegar gives it a little bite. Dried basil can be substituted but it is best with fresh.
instructions: 1.In a bowl, combine the roma tomato, sun-dried tomato, garlic, olive oil, vinegar, basil, salt, and pepper. Allow the mixture to sit for 10 minutes.
2.Put  the baguette slices on a baking sheet. Broil for 1 to 2 minutes, until slightly brown.
3.Divide the tomato mixture evenly over the baguette slices. Top the slices with mozzarella cheese.
4.Broil for 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

recipes.name: Yummy Roll Ups
instructions: 1.Lay the ham slices flat on a serving plate and pat dry. Spread with cream cheese. Place half of the pickle spear at one end of each slice, and roll the slices into cylinders around the spears; secure with toothpicks.

recipes.name: Cheese and Bacon Potato Rounds
recipes.description: Potatoes, cheese and bacon--a great combination! Serve with sour cream if you so desire.
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 200 degrees C.

2.Brush both side of potato slices with butter; place them on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in the preheated 200 degrees C oven for about 20 minutes or until lightly browned on both sides, turning once.
3.When the potato slices are ready, top with bacon, cheese, and green onion; continue baking until the cheese has melted

recipes.name: Cheesy Avocado Bites
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 175 degrees C.
2.Spread butter onto 1 side of each baguette slice.

3.Mix avocado, tomaes, and onion in a bowl until smooth and consistent in texture; scoop onto butter-side of baguette slices. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over avocado mixture layer. Arrange baguette slices on a baking sheet.
4.Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted, about 7 minutes.

recipes.name: Cranberry Brie Bites
instructions: 1.Place Brie cheese in the freezer for 20 minutes. Oil a mini muffin pan with cooking spray.
2.Roll the puff pastry sheet out, than cut it into bite sized pieces.

3.Cut chilled Brie cheese into pieces approximately 3/4-inch in size. Add 1 teaspoon cranberry sauce to each pastry-lined muffin cup; press in 1 piece of Brie and top with 1 teaspoon of chopped walnuts. Sprinkle bites with sea salt. Chill for at least 30 minutes and up to 3 days.
4.Preheat oven to 200 degrees C.
5.Bake bites in the preheated oven until golden brown, 18 to 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Parmesan Baskets
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

2.Place about 2 teaspoons of Parmesan cheese onto a silicone sheet or baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and gently spread the cheese out into a circle about 2 inches in diameter. Spread more circles of cheese onto the baking sheet, keeping them at least 1 inch apart.

3.Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes. Watch carefully to avoid burning. Remove from the oven, and let cool on the sheets until warm; while still warm, drape the wafers over a small bowl or other container. Let cool.
4.Fill them with tomato, mozzarella, and cucumber, drizzle with some olive oil, and lemon juice.

ingredients.description: extra virgin olive oil, to drizzle

recipes.name: Fruit salsa with cinnamon chips
recipes.description: Easy to make, tasty fruit salsa and cinnamon tortilla chips. Great as an appetizer or a snack. Great for anytime!
instructions: 1.In a large bowl, thoroughly mix kiwi, Golden Delicious apple, raspberries, strawberries, white sugar, brown sugar and fruit jam. Cover and chill in the refrigerator at least 15 minutes.
2.Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

3.Coat one side of the flour tortilla with butter flavored cooking spray. Cut into wedges and arrange in a single layer on a large baking sheet. Sprinkle wedges with desired amount of cinnamon sugar. Spray again with cooking spray.
4.Bake in the preheated oven 8 to 10 minutes. Allow to cool approximately 15 minutes. Serve with chilled fruit mixture.

recipes.name: Yogurt Bark
instructions: 1.Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2.Whisk together yogurt, maple syrup, and vanilla extract. Spread the mixture out using a spatula until about 1/4-inch thick. Scatter sliced almonds, dried blueberries on the baking sheet.
3.Place the baking sheet in the freezer for at least 3 hours, or overnight. Remove from freezer and roughly break or slice into about 2 dozen pieces.

recipes.name: Balsamic Bruschetta
recipes.description: Simple appetizer - the balsamic vinegar gives it a little kick. Best if the mixture has 1 or 2 hours to blend flavors before serving.
instructions: 1.In a bowl, toss together the tomatoes, basil, Parmesan cheese, and garlic. Mix in the balsamic vinegar, olive oil, kosher salt, and pepper. Serve on toasted bread slices.

recipes.name: Spinach Brownies
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly grease a baking dish.
2.Place spinach in a medium saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Lower heat to simmer and cook until spinach is limp, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, drain, and set aside.
3.In a large bowl, mix flour, salt and baking powder. Stir in egg, milk and butter. Mix in spinach, onion and mozzarella cheese.
4.Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish. Bake in the preheated oven 30 to 35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool before serving.

recipes.name: Whole Grain Healthy Banana Bread
instructions: 1.Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and a loaf pan.

2.In a medium bowl, mix together the sugar blend, flax meal, banana, milk, sour cream and egg white until well blended. Combine the flour, baking soda and salt; stir into the banana mixture until moistened. Spoon into prepared loaf pan.
3.Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until a toothpick inserted into the crown of the loaf comes out clean.

recipes.name: Healthy Peanut Butter Fruit Dip
recipes.description: A healthier, lower-fat and lower-calorie version of peanut butter fruit dip. Great with crisp apples! Use soon after prep, especially if using flax or chia seeds.
instructions: 1.Mix yogurt, peanut butter, honey, and cinnamon in a bowl until well blended; fold in chia seeds.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Apple Delight
instructions: 1.Stir yogurt, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and stevia together in a small bowl. Add apples and toss to coat. Refrigerate for about 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Black Bean Hummus
instructions: 1.Combine black beans, cilantro, lime juice, jalapeno pepper, sesame oil, garlic, cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper in a food processor or blender; blend until smooth.
2.Pair with veggies and crackers for a healthy snack or spread on sandwich for extra protein and spice!

recipes.name: Baked Sweet Potato Coins
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a baking sheet with cooking spray.
2Cut potatoes into coins using the slicer attachment on a spiralizer. Arrange coins on the baking sheets. Spray with cooking spray. Season both sides with seasoned salt.
3.Bake in the preheated oven until edges start to curl, 20 to 25 minutes. Season with more salt. Let cool until crisp, about 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Mango Papaya Salsa
instructions: 1.In a medium bowl, mix mango, papaya, red bell pepper, avocado, sweet onion, cilantro, and balsamic vinegar. Season with salt and pepper. Cover, and chill in the refrigerator at least 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Kale Chips with Honey
instructions: 1.Combine the kale pieces, olive oil, lemon juice, and sea salt in a resealable bag. Seal and massage the mixture for 3 minutes. The kale will be starting to break down a bit. Drizzle the honey over the mixture and again massage gently for another 3 minutes; the kale will now be half the bulk you started with.

2.Lay flat and even in a food dehydrator; cook at 115 degrees F (46 degrees C) until crispy, about 8 hours. Alternately, you can bake in an oven at 145 degrees F (65 degrees C) until crispy, 4 to 5 hours.

recipes.name: Figs Stuffed with Almonds
instructions: 1.Preheat your oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
2.Cut each fig in half. (If you cannot find fresh figs and would like to use dried figs, cut a little opening in the top of the fig and make a pocket for the stuffing.)
3.In a small mixing bowl, combine chocolate chips, almonds, and liqueur. Spoon about 2 teaspoons of the stuffing mixture into each fig half.
4.Bake on a cookie sheet for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Oven baked banana chips
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 225 degrees F (110 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2.Spread banana slices out onto the prepared baking sheet, making sure slices are not touching. Brush slices with lemon juice.
3.Bake in the preheated oven for 90 minutes. Check bananas, lifting slices up to separate from the paper once or twice. Continue baking until bananas are dried out, 30 to 90 minutes more.
4.Let bananas cool until crispy, at least 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Apple Circles
instructions: 1.Using an apple corer, keeping the apple whole, core the apple straight down. Discarding the bottom and top slices, cut the apple crosswise into 6 slices and spread on a cutting board. Spread the slices with strawberry yogurt and sprinkle with nuts. Serve.

recipes.name: Easy-to-Make Apple Sandwich
instructions: 1.Spread peanut butter over one side of one apple slice; top with granola. Place remaining apple slice atop the granola to finish the sandwich.

recipes.name: 3 ingredient banana oatmeal cookies
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet with silicone baking mat.

2.In a large bowl, add oat and mashed banana. Mix with a fork until it becomes an evenly mixed, thick batter. If you plan on using add-ins like chocolate chips, mix them into the cookie batter at this time.

3.Make 4 round balls out of the cookie batter. Place onto baking sheet, spacing about 2 inches apart. Gently press down on each ball so that it flattens into a round disc. Cookies will not spread much during baking, so keep that in mind when shaping and flattening your discs.

4.Bake for about 15 minutes or until cookies are lightly brown and set. Cookie bottoms should also be brown and easily come off baking sheet. Let cookies cool before eating. Store uneaten cookies in the fridge.

recipes.name: 3 ingredient no bake oatmeal bar
instructions: 1.Line the bottom of a baking pan with parchment paper.

2.Add peanut butter and honey into a large bowl. Place into microwave and heat at 30 second intervals, stirring in between, until the two ingredients are melted and smoothly blended together. You can also do this on the stove using the double boiler method.
3.Add rolled oats. Stir until evenly combined.

4.Spread evenly into prepared pan. Apply some light pressure across the surface. Place bars into fridge to set (at least 1 hour). Cut into bars with a sharp knife. Store uneaten bars at room temperature or in the fridge.

recipes.name: Avocado chips
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 325°F. Line a (half sheet) baking sheet with parchment paper or silicone baking mats.
2.In a medium bowl, add avocado. Mash with a spoon until completely pureed. Add in cheese, lemon juice, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper. Stir until everything is evenly blended.
3.Add 1 heaping teaspoon of batter to prepared baking sheet. Space each dollop of batter 3 inches apart.

4.Cut a sheet of parchment paper to fit one pan. Place on top of mounds of avocado batter. Using your palm, gently flatten each mound with the help of the parchment paper (your hand should be above the parchment paper and not touching the avocado directly). Use the parchment paper to help you shape the avocado into flat circles.

5.Gently peel back the parchment paper. Scrape any avocado that gets stuck on the parchment paper and put back onto rounds. Use the back of the spoon to finish shaping rounds, making sure they are evenly spread and as thin as possible. Your rounds should be 3 inches wide and 1/16 inches thick. It is important that your rounds are as thin as possible because otherwise the chips will not get crispy.

6.Bake chips for about 15 minutes or until the cheese is golden brown. Gently flip the chips using a thin cookie spatula. Cook an additional 2-3 minutes on the other side, keeping watch carefully to make sure cheese does not turn dark brown.
7.Let chips cool completely before eating. Chips will crisp up further as they cool.
8.Chips are best eaten after they are cooled. Uneaten chips can be stored in a sealed ziploc bag and may lose some of their crispness.

recipes.name: Cacao brownie bites
instructions: 1.In a food processor, add walnuts and pulse until finely ground. Add in remaining ingredients. Pulse until dates are broken down and everything is combined. The finished result should look a little crumbly but when you touch the mixture, it should be slightly sticky and moist rather than dry. If you scoop out a small spoonful and squeeze, the mixture should be sticky enough to stay together.

2.Using a tablespoon, measure out 1 tbsp of the mixture and then press a few times into the palm of your hand to compact it before rolling into a round ball with both hands. Set aside. Repeat with remaining mixture.

3.Roll balls in cacao powder or other toppings like unsweetened coconut flakes or crushed nuts. Store in airtight container in fridge. Balls can be eaten straight from the fridge. Store up to one week.

recipes.name: Cornjacks
instructions: 1. Combine cormeal, bicarbonate of soda and flour in bowl, make a well in the centre. 2. Pour in margarine, cooking cream, corn and green onion, stir until combined. 3. Spray a non-stick frying pan with spray oil, heat on medium, cook tablespoonfuls of corn mixture until top has set. Turn and brown other side.

recipes.name: Minted lemon dip
instructions: 1. Place reduced fat cream, cheese, mint and zest in a bowl, mix well. Spoon into a serving bowl, refrigerate 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Crunchy noodle salad
instructions: 1. Combine cabbage, almonds, sesame seeds, and green onions in a bowl, mix well. 2. add broken noodles from oriental noodles packet; do not add contents of flavour sachet.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Laksa
instructions: 1.cook noodles in a saucepan of boiling water for 2 minutes or until just tender. drain well. divide among 4 serving bowls. 2.heat a wok over high heat. add curry paste and tofu and cook for 2 minutes. add stock,  fish sauce and coconut milk and bring to a simmer. add carrot, mushroom and beans and cook for 2 minutes. add bok choy and cook for a further 1 minute, or until just tender. remove from heat and stir in sugar. 3.divide the vegetables among the 4 serving bowls. pour over the liquid evenly. top with bean sprouts and coriander. serve with lime wedges

ingredients.description: firm tofu, cut into 1 cm cubes

recipes.name: Baked Mushroom risotto
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 180°c/160°c fan-forced. 2. in a saucepan, melt margarine over medium-low heat; add onion and garlic, cook, stirring for 4-5 minutes or until softened. add thyme and wine, bring to the boil. cook, stirring, for 2 minutes or until liquid has almost evaporated.3.add mushrooms, cook for 2-3 minutes or until browned lightly. add rice; cook, stirring, for 1 minute. transfer mixture to 6 cup (1.5l) capacity oven proof dish. add combined stock and light & creamy cooking milk, stir to combine. 4.cover tightly with foil; transfer to oven. bake, stirring occasionally, for 55 minutes. stir in cheese and herbs. serve topped with shaved parmesan, if desired.

recipes.name: Creamy lentil soup
instructions: 1.soak lentils in water overnight. 2. heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat. add onion, garlic, carrots and celery; cook 4 minutes. add paste, cook 1 minute or until fragrant. 3.pour in water and tomato; bring to the boil; add drained lentils and simmer 30 minutes or until tender. stir in light & creamy coconut flavoured cooking milk and coriander.

recipes.name: Vegetarian rolls
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 200°c/180°c fan forced. 2. heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat; add onion, cook 1 minute, add zucchini and mushrooms, cook a further 2 minutes. stir in combined tomato, cook in the pot chili con carne recipe mix and cornflour. 3.bring to boil stirring, add kidney beans, return to boil, reduce heat, simmer 5 minutes stirring occasionally. 4.remove from heat and divide mixture between 8 lebanese rounds, roll up and place in a baking pan, top with cheese. 5.bake 10-15 minutes, until cheese is melted and golden.

ingredients.description: canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained

recipes.name: Quinoa porridge with banana, raisins and pistachio
instructions: 1.place quinoa in a sieve and rinse well under cold running water. tip into a saucepan and add milk. bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring often.2.add raisins and cinnamon; simmer for 8 - 10 minutes or until all of the liquid is absorbed. stir in the honey.

ingredients.description: pistachio, unsalted, finely chopped, to serve

recipes.name: Indian cauliflower and chickpea tray bake
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 200C/180C fan-forced. Grease a baking tray with sides. 2. Remove tomato from vine. Thickly slice cauliflower florets. Place curry paste in a bowl. Add cauliflower, chickpeas and onion. Toss to combine. Transfer mixture to prepared tray. Season with salt and pepper. Add lemon wedges, tomatoes and reserved cauliflower leaves. Roast for 40 minutes or until cauliflower is tender and beginning to char. 3. Dollop vegetables with yoghurt. Season with salt and pepper. Top with coriander leaves. Serve.

ingredients.description: red onion, cut into thin wedges

recipes.name: Vegetarian spinach-walnut pate
instructions: 1. Bring a pot of water to a boil. Line a 5-inch ramekin with plastic wrap, leaving at least a 2-inch overhang; smooth out the plastic in the ramekin as much as possible.2. Add the spinach to the pot of water, stir to submerge and cook until wilted and tender, about 2 minutes. Drain and let cool completely. Squeeze every last drop of water out of the spinach, then finely chop. Transfer to a medium bowl.3. Process the walnuts, warm water, cilantro, tarragon, dill, vinegar, scallions, garlic, 1 pinch salt, coriander and cayenne in a food processor until the mixture is the consistency of mayonnaise.4. Add the walnut-herb mixture to the bowl with the spinach, and stir to combine thoroughly. Spoon into the prepared ramekin, and pat down with the back of the spoon to compact. Cover with the plastic overhang, and refrigerate at least 4 hours up to overnight. 5. To serve, unwrap and invert onto a serving platter. Garnish with pomegranate seeds and chopped walnuts. Serve with crackers or crudites.

recipes.name: Meatless meatloaf
instructions: 1. Over a gas burner or under an electric broiler, char the eggplant until the skin is black, turning as needed to cook all sides evenly. Wrap in foil and set aside to steam for 20 minutes. Remove from the foil and gently brush the skin off or rinse under warm water. 2. Preheat oven to 400 F. 3. Pulse the walnuts in a food processor until finely ground. Transfer to a bowl. Pulse the eggplant, tofu, and mushrooms into small pieces. Add mixture to the walnuts along with the remaining loaf ingredients. Mix together until evenly combined. Transfer the mixture into a loaf pan or casserole dish and bake for 1 hour.

ingredients.description: shiitake mushroom, or button mushroom, stemmed

recipes.name: Mushroom gravy
instructions: 1. Melt the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes. Season mushrooms with salt and pepper to taste. Scatter the flour over the mushrooms and stir until lightly browned, about 1 minute. Add the marsala and broth and bring to a boil, cooking until thickened, about 2 minutes. Add the cream and fresh thyme leaves and season with salt and pepper.

ingredients.description: shiitake mushroom, or cremini or button mushroom

recipes.name: Butternut squash and kale stir fry
instructions: 1. Heat 0,5 tablespoon of the butter and the olive oil in a skillet over high heat. Add the squash and sprinkle with the salt, chile powder and pepper. Cook for several minutes, turning gently with a spatula, until the squash is deep golden brown and tender (but not falling apart). Remove to a plate and set aside. 2. In the same skillet, melt the remaining butter over medium-high heat and add in the kale. Toss it around with tongs and cook it for 3 to 4 minutes. Add in the cooked squash and gently toss together.

ingredients.description: butternut squash, peeled, seeded and diced

recipes.name: Stovetop granola
instructions: 1. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add oats then cook and stir until starting to brown and crisp, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and spread out on a cookie sheet to cool. 2.Melt the butter in the same pan over medium heat. Stir in the honey and brown sugar; cook, stirring constantly, until bubbly. Return the oats to the pan. Cook and stir for another 5 minutes or so. Pour out onto the cookie sheet and spread to cool. 3. Once cool, transfer to an airtight container and stir in the almonds and dried cranberries. Any additional nuts and fruit can be stirred in at this time also.

recipes.name: Waffled falafel
instructions: 1.Preheat a waffle iron according to manufacturer's instructions. Spray inside of waffle iron with cooking spray. 2. Process chickpeas in a food processor until coarsely chopped. Add onion, egg whites, cilantro, parsley, garlic, flour, cumin, salt, coriander, black pepper, cayenne pepper, and cardamom to chickpeas. Pulse, scraping down the sides of the bowl occasionally, until falafel batter resembles a coarse meal. Pour batter into a bowl and stir with a fork. 3.Spoon about 1/4 cup falafel batter onto each section of the preheated waffle iron. Cook until evenly browned, about 5 minutes. Repeat with remaining batter.

recipes.name: Baked tofu slices
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). 2.Arrange tofu slices onto a baking sheet. Brush olive oil over the top of each slice. Sprinkle salt and pepper over the tofu. 3. Bake tofu in preheated oven until lightly browned on top, 8 to 10 minutes. 4. Stir soy sauce, hot sauce, sesame oil, chile-garlic sauce, sesame seeds, garlic, and green onion together in a bowl; spoon atop the tofu slices. 5. Return baking sheet to oven and continue baking tofu until topping is warmed, 3 to 5 minutes more.

recipes.name: Creamed spinach
instructions: 1. In a pot of boiling salted water, cook spinach for 30 seconds. Drain and place in a bowl of ice water. When cool enough to handle, drain and squeeze out as much excess water as possible.In a skillet over medium heat, melt butter. Add onion and cook until soft, 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute more. Add milk, heavy cream, and cream cheese to skillet. Simmer until cream cheese is melted. Season with salt, pepper, and a pinch of cayenne. Add spinach and Parmesan and stir to combine.

recipes.name: Green bean casserole bundles
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350° and grease a 9''-x-13'' baking dish.In a bowl, stir together soup, milk, soy sauce, pepper, and fried onions. Add green beans and toss to combine.Grab small bundles of green beans and wrap with a strip of bacon, placing each in the baking dish snugly, seam side down. Cover with foil and bake until the bacon is fully cooked, 37 to 40 minutes.

ingredients.description: snap beans, trimmed, blanched and cooled

recipes.name: Best-ever grilled zucchini
instructions: 1. Preheat grill on medium-high. In a bowl, toss zucchini with oil, lemon zest, and red pepper flakes. Season with salt and pepper.2.Once grill is hot, carefully use tongs to rub an oiled paper towel over grates. 3. Using tongs, place zucchini on grill. Cover and cook, 3 minutes. Flip and continue cooking on high, covered, 2 to 3 minutes more.4. When zucchini is tender, remove from heat and garnish with basil and more red pepper flakes.

recipes.name: Garlicky Shrimp Zucchini Boats
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°. Score zucchini (like you’re dicing an avocado) and scoop out insides to use later. Place zucchini boats in a baking dish and drizzle all over with oil. Season with salt and pepper and sprinkle thyme leaves on top. Bake until tender, about 20 minutes. 2. In a skillet over medium heat, melt butter. Add shrimp and season with salt and pepper. Cook until pink and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat and when cool enough to handle, chop into bite-size pieces. Return shrimp to skillet then stir in reserved zucchini, tomatoes, and garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute more. Add cream, Parmesan, and lemon juice, and cook until slightly reduced, 3 minutes. 3. Fill zucchini boats with shrimp mixture and top with mozzarella. Cook until cheese is bubbly, about 10 minutes more. 4. Garnish with more Parmesan and parsley, if desired, before serving.

recipes.name: Pineapple baked chicken
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 375°. In a bowl, combine Italian seasoning, sweet paprika, and garlic powder. Season chicken with salt and pepper. 2. In an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil. Cook chicken on top side until golden, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and sprinkle all over with seasoning mixture. 3. Sprinkle tops of chicken with mozzarella and most of Parmesan. Arrange a pineapple round on top of each piece of chicken. Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella and remaining Parmesan.4. Bake until cheese is melty and chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.5. Garnish with red onion and cilantro before serving.

recipes.name: Italian Mac and Cheese
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350° In an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat, cook sausage, breaking up with a wooden spoon, until seared and no longer pink, about 4 minutes. Add onion, garlic, and bell pepper and cook, stirring, until soft, 5 minutes more.2. Add cavatappi and stir until coated, then pour over marinara and broth and season with salt. Bring liquid to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until pasta is al dente and almost all liquid has been absorbed, about 25 minutes.3. Stir in half-and-half and simmer until mostly absorbed, 2 minutes more. Remove from heat and stir in half of mozzarella.4. Transfer mixture to a large baking dish and sprinkle with remaining mozzarella. Bake until cheese is bubbly and golden, about 10 minutes.5. Garnish with parsley before serving.

recipes.name: Shaved Brussels Sprouts Salad
instructions: 1. Whisk together oil, lemon juice, and honey in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Add Brussels sprouts, apple, shallot, and hazelnuts; toss to combine. Fold in Pecorino.

ingredients.description: brussels sprouts, trimmed and thinly sliced

recipes.name: Banana chocolate shake
instructions: 1. Place milk, cocoa powder (sweetened) and banana in a food processor or blender. 2. Blend until combined and smooth.

recipes.name: Tapioca pudding
instructions: 1. Add the milk and egg to a saucepan and whisk well to combine. 2.Stir in sugar and tapioca and let sit for 5 minutes.3.Turn heat to medium and bring mixture to a bubbling, full boil (stirring constantly, being careful not to let it burn!). 4. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla.5. Place a piece of plastic wrap directly on the surface of the pudding and cool for 15-20 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

recipes.name: Mini sesame zucchini loaves
instructions: 1. Heat oven to 350°F. Oil 3 mini (3- by 6-inch) loaf pans.2.In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.3. In second bowl, combine sugars, then finely grate lemon zest on top. Rub zest into sugars with fingertips, breaking up any clumps of brown sugar. 4. Add egg and oil and whisk until smooth. Stir in zucchini, then flour mixture. Gently fold in walnuts.5. Divide batter evenly among prepared pans. Sprinkle tops with sesame seeds and bake until wooden pick inserted in centers comes out clean, 35 to 40 minutes. 6. Cool in pans on wire rack 10 min. Run thin-bladed knife along edges of pans and unmold loaves. Cool completely on rack.

recipes.name: Mango Madness smoothie
instructions: In blender, puree the ingredients until smooth.

recipes.name: Strawberry fields smoothie
instructions: In blender, puree the ingredients until smooth.

recipes.name: Green Goddess smoothie
instructions: In blender, puree the ingredients until smooth.

ingredients.description: banana, cut into pieces and frozen

recipes.name: Razzle-dazzle smoothie
instructions: In blender, puree the ingredients until smooth.

recipes.name: Peanut butter energy bites
instructions: 1. Combine all five ingredients in a bowl. 2. Stir to combine. 3. Place in the fridge for 15-30 minutes so they are easier to roll. 4. Roll into bite and store in the fridge up to a week.

recipes.name: Flower power sunny-side egg
instructions: 1.Slice bell pepper (or 4 in different colors) horizontally to make  1/2-inch-thick ring and remove inner white flesh and seeds.In 12-inch nonstick skillet, heat vegetable oil on medium.2. Cook peppers 2 minutes. Turn peppers over; crack 1 egg into center of each ring. Cook, covered, until eggs have reached desired doneness. Season a picnh salt and pepper.3.To serve, garnish with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Choco-Cherry supercarb bars
instructions: 1. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.2. In a bowl, combine oats, quinoa, chia seeds,almonds, cherries, and chocolate.3.In a saucepan on low, heat almond butter, honey, coconut oil and 1/2 teaspoon salt until melted and smooth, stirring occasionally. Stir in prune puree.4. Pour almond butter mixture over oat mixture and stir to combine.5.With hands, form into bar using about 1/3 cup mixture for each; place on prepared sheet and refrigerate until set, about 1 hour. Store in refrigerator, in airtight container, up to 3 weeks.

recipes.name: Spinach and cheese breakfast pockets
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F. Line rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. In a bowl, whisk together 1 egg with 1 tablespoon water; set aside.In a bowl, combine ricotta, spinach, basil, tomatoes, red pepper, remaining egg and a pinch kosher salt.Unroll pie crusts and cut each into 4 wedges. Divide ricotta mixture among wedges, placing on 1 side. Fold dough over filling and press edges with fork to seal.Transfer to prepared baking sheet. Brush tops with egg mixture and sprinkle with sesame seeds, if desired. Bake until golden brown, 16 to 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Spinach and cheddar microwave quiche in a mug
instructions: If using fresh spinach, place it in mug with 2 tablespoons of water. Cover with a paper towel and microwave on high for one minute. Remove from microwave and drain the water and liquid from spinach thoroughly.If using frozen spinach, make sure it is completely thawed and drained and add it to the mug.Crack the egg into the mug with the spinach and add the milk, cheese, bacon (if using), and salt and pepper. Mix until thoroughly combined.Cover with a paper towel and microwave on high for 3 minutes (see note on timing below), or until fully cooked.

recipes.name: Gingery meatball soup
instructions: Arrange oven rack 6 inches from broiler heat source. Preheat broiler on high. Line large rimmed baking sheet with foil.In medium bowl, combine pork, green onions, garlic, ginger, and 1/2 teaspoon each salt and pepper. Form mixture into bite-size meatballs (about 1 inch each); arrange in single layer on prepared baking sheet. Broil 5 to 7 minutes, or until browned.Meanwhile, in covered 5-quart saucepot, heat broth to simmering on high. Uncover; add snow peas, rice, and broiled meatballs. Reduce heat to medium; simmer 5 minutes, or until meatballs are cooked through and snow peas are tender.

recipes.name: Sweet beet soup
instructions: 1.In a skillet, heat oil on medium-high. Add onion and pinch salt. Cook 5 minutes or until browned and starting to soften, stirring frequently. Let cool.2. To blender, add beets, apple, broth, onion, and a pinch salt. Blend until smooth. Refrigerate until cold about 3 hours. Makes about 5 cups. To serve, garnish with sour cream and dill.

ingredients.description: Granny Smith apple, peeled, cored, and chopped

recipes.name: Barbecue chicken sweet potato
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 375°. Place sweet potatoes on a baking sheet. Toss with oil and season with salt and pepper. 2. Bake until tender, about 1 hour, depending on size. Let cool slightly, then, using a paring knife, slice along top of the sweet potato and push in both ends to create a well. 3.In a bowl, toss chicken with barbecue sauce and garlic. Stuff into sweet potatoes, then top with red onion, jalapeño, and Gouda. Return to oven and bake until cheese is melty and chicken is warmed through, about 15 minutes more. 4.Drizzle with barbecue sauce before serving.

ingredients.description: BBQ sauce, plus more for serving
red onion, thinly sliced into quarter moons

recipes.name: Zucchini pizza bites
instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees.2. Using a mandoline or sharp knife, slice the zucchini into 1/2'' thick roundsLay on a paper towel and sprinkle with salt. Let sit for a few minutes and dab with the paper towel to remove the moisture.3. Spray a large baking sheet with non-stick spray, or lay down a sheet of parchment paper, then arrange the zucchini in a single layer.4.Top with a spoonful of sauce and a pinch of cheese.5. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the cheese begins to brown. Sprinkle with fresh basil and parmesan and serve!

recipes.name: Baked eggplant parm
instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 425°. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper and coat with cooking spray. In a shallow bowl, whisk together panko, Parmesan, and Italian seasoning. Season with salt and pepper. In another shallow bowl, whisk eggs with 2 tablespoons water and season with salt and pepper. 2. Dip an eggplant slice into egg wash, then dredge in panko mixture. Place on baking sheet. Repeat to coat all eggplant slices. Spray tops lightly with cooking spray.3.Bake until soft inside, and golden and crisp on the outside, 30 to 35 minutes. 4. In a dish, add a cup of marinara and spread evenly. Add an even layer of eggplant slices, then pour marinara on top. Sprinkle with mozzarella, half of the remaining Parmesan, and fresh basil. Repeat process once more to use up all ingredients.5.Bake until bubbly and golden, 15 to 17 minutes more.

recipes.name: Three-ingredient spaghetti
instructions: 1.In a pot of salted, boiling water, cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of boiling water, then drain.2.Return spaghetti to pot and mix with lemon juice, zest, and Parmesan. Season with more salt and pepper if desired.

recipes.name: No bake energy balls
instructions: 1. In a pan, toast the oats over low heat until just browned around the edges, about 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside.2. In a bowl, combine the flaxseed and warm water and set aside to thicken for about 5 minutes. In a food processor, combine the almond butter, maple syrup, dates, coconut oil, vanilla, cinnamon and salt. Add the flaxseed mixture and blend until smooth.3. Add the walnuts and pulse until combined. Add the oats and coconut and pulse until combined. Add the chocolate chips and pulse just until evenly incorporated.4. Roll the mixture into 12 balls and chill until firm, at least 30 minutes. If the dough is too sticky to work with, chill it for several minutes before rolling.5. Store in an air-tight container in the refrigerator.

recipes.name: Green smoothie
instructions: 1. In a blender mix all ingredients until smooth.

recipes.name: Hash Brown Ham and Cheese Egg Cups
instructions: 1.Pre-heat oven 350 degrees.2.In a bowl, stir all ingredients together until well blended.3.Liberally grease the muffin tin.4. Scoop mixture into each space trying to make sure you get enough of the egg liquid.5. Sprinkle the tops with a little extra cheese.6. Place in the oven on the middle rack for about 30 min, or until golden brown.

recipes.name: Avocado toast
instructions: 1.  Make a toast from a slice of wholemeal bread. 2. Smash the avocado with a fork, then put it on your toast. 3. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Arugula and goat cheese avocado toast
instructions: 1. Make a toast from a slice of wholemeal bread. 2. Smach the avocado with a fork then put it on the toast, season it with salt and pepper. 3. Put the arugula and crumbled goat cheese or feta on the top of the smashed avocado. 4. Season it with fresh lemon juice.

recipes.name: Chocolate avocado toast
instructions: 1.Make a toast from a slice of wholmeal bread. 2. Mix the cocoa powder and the maple syrup into the half avocado. 3. Top your toast with raspberries.

recipes.name: Scrambled egg toast
instructions: 1.Spread a thin layer of softened butter on both sides of the bread. Frythe bread over heat for about 2 minutes on each side, until a goldencrust forms. 2.Remove the bread from the frying pan and add  butter. Add the egg and feta cheese and cook, stirring often, for about 3-4 minutes, until the egg are cooked through. 3.Divide the egg between the bread slices andsprinkle them with freshly chopped dill or parsley.

recipes.name: Fall harvest breakfast salad
instructions: 1. Combine butternut squash, oil, cinnamon and sea salt together on a baking sheet and roast in a 450° oven for about 30 minutes or until squash is cooked through. Remove and let cool. 2.Fill a salad bowl with spring mix and add toppings: roasted squash, apple slices, avocado, red onion, walnuts and hemp seeds. 3. Portion salad into two bowls and place cooked egg on top of each salad. Drizzle dressing over the salad and enjoy!

ingredients.description: egg, cooked any way you like

recipes.name: Shaksuka
instructions: 1. Add extra virgin olive oil to a skillet over heat. Add onion and red pepper and fry for 5mins or until soft and starting to brown. Add garlic and fry for another 1-2mins until it just begins to brown.2. Add cumin & paprika, smoked paprika and cayenne pepper (or to taste). Stir into the pepper/onion and fry for a couple of minutes. Pour in tomatoe and stir to combine.3. Season with salt, sugar and black pepper (or to taste). Allow to simmer for 5 mins until it begins to reduce ever so slightly.4. Turn heat to low and carefully crack in your egg. Simmer for another 10mins, or until the whites of the egg are mostly opaque (don't need them fully cooked through at this point, just slightly). Consider moving the skillet around every now and then so the egg cook evenly.5.From there, either pop a lid on and finish by poaching the egg until the yolk is just cooked. Or, carefully pop the skillet in the oven at 180c/355f for 5mins or until the yolk just cooked. Be aware that the egg will continue cooking once taken off heat in both instances.Season the yolks with a pinch of salt and pepper and garnish the whole dish with feta and fresh parsley or coriander/cilantro. Serve right away with toasted ciabatta or chunky buttered bread.

recipes.name: BLT sandwich
instructions: 1. Cook the bacon in a deep skillet over heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain the bacon slices on a paper towel-lined plate. 2. Arrange the cooked bacon, lettuce, and tomato slices on one slice of bread. Spread one side of remaining bread slice with the mayonnaise. Bring the two piece together to make a sandwich..

recipes.name: Pear and gouda grilled cheese sandwich
instructions: 1. Brush one side of each slice of bread with butter or oil. Form sandwiches (buttered-side out) with the Dijon, cheese, pear, and arugula.2. Heat a nonstick skillet over heat. Cook the sandwich, covered, until the bread is golden brown and crisp and the cheese has melted, 4 to 5 minutes per side.

recipes.name: Pimento- cheese sandwich
instructions: 1. Stir together cheese, cayenne pepper, horseradish, Worcestershire sauce, dry mustard, and mayonnaise in a bowl. Blend half the mixture in a food processor until smooth. Transfer back to bowl, add roasted red pepper, and stir to combine.2.Trim crusts from 2 slice firm white bread. Spread pimento cheese among 1 slice. Top with remaining bread. Cut the sandwich into quarter, slicing on the diagonal.

recipes.name: Chicken avocado pita sandwich
instructions: 1. Cut 1 piece of Swiss cheese into the pita pocket.2. In a bowl, combine Greek yogurt and garlic salt. Set aside.3. In a bowl, combine avocado, tomatoe, lemon juice, and half of the Cilanto. Set aside. In a skillet, brown the cooked chicken with the olive oil over heat for 3-4 minutes. While cooking, sprinkle with half of the cilantro.4. Take off of heat and add the chicken to the pita.5. Top the chicken with a drizzle of the yogurt mixture followed by a spoonful of the avocado mixture, all within the pita pocket. Can be served cold, or grilled on a sandwich maker/foreman grill for 2 minutes to serve warm.

ingredients.description: avocado, hollowed and cut into piece

recipes.name: Greek yogurt egg salad sandwich
instructions: 1. Place egg in a saucepan and cover with cold water by 1 inch. Bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute. Cover egg with a tight-fitting lid and remove from heat; set aside for 8-10 minutes. Drain well and let cool before peeling and dicing.2. In a bowl, roughly mash egg with Greek yogurt, mayonnaise, dill, salt and pepper, to taste.3. Serve sandwich on baguette with arugula, tomatoe, avocado and egg salad mixture.

recipes.name: Brussels sprouts hash
instructions: 1. In a skillet over heat, cook bacon until crispy. Turn off heat and transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. Keep most of bacon fat in skillet, removing any black piece from pan.2.Turn heat back and add onion and brussels sprouts to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables begin to soften and turn golden. Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.3.Add  water and cover skillet. Cook until brussels sprouts are tender and water has evaporated, about 5 minutes. (If all the water evaporates before the brussels sprouts are tender, add more water to skillet and cover for a couple minutes more.) Add garlic to skillet and cook until fragrant, 1 minute.4. Using a wooden spoon, make a hole in the hash to reveal bottom of skillet. Crack an egg into the hole and season the egg with salt and pepper. Replace lid and cook until the egg cooked to your liking, about 5 minutes for a just runny egg. 5.Sprinkle cooked bacon bits over entire skillet and serve warm.

recipes.name: Mocha oatmeal bowl
instructions: 1. Mix the brewed coffee with the coconut milk. Pour 1/4 cup (60 ml) of the coffee mixture over the oats in either a microwave-safe bowl or a saucepan on the stovetop. For the microwave, the oats and coffee should cook for about 1 to 2 minutes. On the stovetop over heat, the oats should cook for 5 to 10 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed.2. Keep an extra 1/4 to 1/3 cup (60 to 80 ml) of the coffee mixture for topping. Once the oats are heated, add the cocoa and stir together.3.Divide the oats into two bowls. Add in the chocolate chips, coconut, chia and maple syrup, if desired.4.Pour the rest of the coffee mixture on top and sprinkle with the cocoa powder. Feel free to add more coconut milk or cream to make the oats more creamy.5.Top with additional dark chocolate and chia seeds.

recipes.name: Quinoa fruit salad
instructions: 1. Rinse and prepare quinoa according to package. Let quinoa cool to room temperature. 2. In a bowl combine quinoa, strawberries, blueberries, and mango. 3. To make the glaze in a bowl combine the honey and lime juice, drizzel over the fruit salad and toss coat, garnish with fresh basil.

ingredients.description: fresh basil leaves, chopped, for garnish

recipes.name: Banana Peanut Butter Chia Seed pudding
instructions: 1.In a blender, puree the banana, milk and peanut butter. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the chia seed. Cover with plastic wrap and chill in the refrigerator for 4 hours or overnight.2.Stir the mixture before serving. Can be stored in an airtight container refrigerated for up to 1 week.

recipes.name: Tomato mozarella toast
instructions: 1. In a bowl mix the tomatoe sauce and the paste, put the seasons in it. 2. Put the mixture on the toast, put the shredded mozarella over it, and on the top comes the sliced cherry tomatoe, season it with freshly chopped basil.

recipes.name: Spicy buffalo honey mustard ham and cheese croissant
instructions: 1. Whisk honey mustard, barbecue sauce and buffalo sauce together to get the spicy buffalo honey mustard. 2. Heat oven to 350 degrees. 2. Cut  open the croissant lengthwise to open up. 3. Spread some spicy buffalo honey mustard sauce on the croissant. 4. Stack with a few slices of ham and a slice of pepper jack cheese. 5. Close the croissant and brush the tops with melted butter. 6. Sprinkle with poppy seed or sesame seed.  7. Spray a bakin sheet with non-stick cooking oil and place croissant on top. 8. Bake for 8 minutes.

recipes.name: Bagel with Sun-dried tomatoes and provolone
instructions: 1.Cut the bagel in half. Toast if desired. Drizzle both halves with extra virgin olive oil.2. Sprinkle the dried oregano, if using.3. Distribute the cheese, sun-dried tomatoe & basil around the bagel.

recipes.name: Breakfast yogurt parfait in a jar
instructions: Place a layer of berries or grapes on the bottom of the jar, add a layer of yogurt, a layer of granola, a layer of fruit, another layer of yogurt and a layer of the shredded coconut. Cap the jar, and off you go!

recipes.name: Smoky beans on toast
instructions: 1. Heat the oil in a pan, add the onion and pepper, and fry gently until soft, about 10-15 mins. Crush half the garlic and add this to the pan, along with the tomatoe, paprika, vinegar, bean, sugar and some seasoning. Bring to a simmer and cook for 10-15 mins or until slightly reduced and thickened.2. Toast the bread, rub with the remaining garlic and drizzle with a little oil. Spoon the bean over the toast, drizzle with a little more oil and scatter over the parsley.

ingredients.description: red bell pepper, thinly sliced into strips
canned butter beans, or chickpeas, drained

recipes.name: Cauliflower waffle
instructions: 1. Preheat your waffle press.2. In a bowl, mix together cauliflower, cheese, egg, cornstarch and paprika until combined. Season with salt and pepper.3. Pour 1 cup batter into a preheated waffle press, and cook for 6 minutes.4. Serve alone or with the toppings of your choice.

recipes.name: French toast bowl
instructions: 1. Heat oven to 350°F. Butter four 1-cup oven-safe bowls or baking dishes.2. In a pitcher, measuring cup or bowl, whisk together the milk, egg,  sugar, vanilla, and salt.3. Remove the crusts from the bread, then spread one side of each piece with the butter. Cut each piece in half to make two triangles. Arrange some of the bread, buttered-side up, around each bowl or baking dish. Top with the berries, then repeat, making sure to keep the bread around the edges of the dish.4.Pour the custard mixture over the bread and berries. Sprinkle with sugar and place the bowl on a rimmed baking sheet.5. Cover the dishes loosely with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Uncover and continue baking until the custard is set and the bread is lightly golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes more.
