recipes.name: Breakfast tomatoe
instructions: 1. Preheat ovean to 400 degrees and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Slice the top off tomatoe and hollow with a metal spoon. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. 2. Place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes, until softened slightly. Crack the egg into center and place bacnk in oven to bake 12 to 15 minute more, until egg is cooked to your preference. Season with more salt and pepper and garnish with chive and parmesan

recipes.name: Brunch-style portobello mushroom
instructions: 1. Place the mushroom, stem side up, in an ungreased baking pan. Spoon spinach onto mushroom, building up the sides. Carefully crack an egg into the center of the mushroom, sprinkle with cheese and bacon. 2. Bake at 375 degree for 18-20 minutes or until egg is set. Sprinkle with salt and pepper if desired.

recipes.name: Easy breakfast spinach roll-up
instructions: 1. In a bowl, beat together egg and water/milk until combined. Lay tortilla out on a plate, top with cheese, if you wish to use.2. Spray a pan with cooking spray that has nearly the same diameter as the tortilla. Heat pan over heat and pour egg mixture into pan. Gently tilt or swirl pan to ensure that liquid egg covers the entire bottom of the pan. Continue to cook until egg is cooked and no longer liquid. Season with salt and pepper.3. Using a heat-resistant rubber spatula, help slide cooked egg directly on top of tortilla/cheese.Top egg with optional fillings. Roll up tortilla somewhat firmly, but without tearing tortilla or shifting ingredients. Cut roll-up in half and serve.

recipes.name: Spicy pumpkin parfaits
instructions: 1. In a bowl, stir together pumpkin, half of the yogurt, and cinnamon. In another bowl, stir together the remaining yogurt and orange zest. In a third bowl, toss together the granola and cayenne pepper.2. In four pint-size canning jars or parfait glasses, layer half of the pumpkin mixture and a third of the granola. Top with the yogurt mixture, another third of the granola, and the remaining pumpkin mixture. Finish with the remaining granola and drizzle with maple syrup

recipes.name: Briam (Greek roasted vegetables)
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Place a rack in the middle.2. Place sliced potatoe and zucchini in a mixing bowl. Season with kosher salt, pepper, oregano, and rosemary. Add fresh parsley, garlic, and a generous drizzle extra virgin olive oil. Toss to make sure the vegetables are well coated with the EVOO and spices.3. Grab a round pan on skillet. Pour 1/2 of the canned diced tomatoe in and spread to cover the bottom of the pan.4. Arrange the seasoned potatoe, zucchini, and sliced onion in the pan in rows (simply going around the shape of the pan and alternating.)5. If you have any of the extra virgin olive oil and garlic mixture left in the mixing bowl, pour that all over the veggies, then top with the remaining diced tomatoe from your can.6. Cover the pan with foil (tent foil a bit so it is not touching the veggies). Bake in 400 degrees F heated-oven for 45 minutes. Take pan out briefly to carefully remove foil, then place back in oven,  uncovered, and roast for another 30-40 minutes or until the veggies are soft and charred and most of the liquid has evaporated. (ovens do vary, so pay attention and check as needed.)7. Remove from oven. Serve warm or at room temperature with an added generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

recipes.name: Creamy roasted squash puree
instructions: 1. Heat oven to 400 F. Line rimmed baking sheet wit foil,oil foil. 2. Cut butternut squash lenghtwise in half and scoop out and discard seeds. Working on prepared baking sheet, coat squash with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Turn squash sides down and roast it lower half of oven until flesh is beginning to turn golden brown, 30 to 35. minutes. 3. Meanwhile, toss shallot and thyme with remaining oil and salt and pepper. Turn squash, scatter shallot and thyme on top, then drizzle with maple syrup. Roast until skin is golden brown and crisp, 40 to 50 minutes more. 4. Let sit until cool enough to handle. Working in batches, scoop some of the softened squash and shallot from the peels into a food processor and puree until smooth.

recipes.name: Cucumber- Melon soup
instructions: 1. In blender, puree cucumber, melon, parsley, vinegar, lime juice, sugar, and a pinch of salt until smooth.Refrigerate at least 1 hour and up to overnight. Serve topped with watercress, sliced cucumber, and cracked pepper.

ingredients.description: honeydew melon, seeded and rind removed

recipes.name: Tofu pad thai
instructions: 1. Slice tofu thick. Place on rimmed baking sheet between layer of paper towel, sandwich with second sheet and place cast iron skillet on top to weigh down 10 minute. Cut into cube, transfer to bowl and toss with cornstarch. 2. Meanwhile, cook noodle per package direction and rinse with cold water, drain. 3. In a bowl, combine soy sauce, sugar, chili sauce, lime juice and garlic, set aside. 4. Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet. Add pepper and cook until tender, 4 to 5 minute. Remove from skillet. Add tofu and cook, tossing, until golden brown, 4 to 5 minute. Add noodle and sauce and toss to combine. Fold in pepper, sprout and scallion and cook 2 minute.

recipes.name: Asian sesame zucchini noodle
instructions: 1. In a bowl, whisk cilantro, vinegar, oil, garlic, red pepper, sugar and salt. 2. Add zucchini, toss until well-combined. Serve immidiately.

recipes.name: Supergreen mushroom and orzo soup
instructions: 1.In a saucepot heat olive oil, add salt, celery, shallot, and garlic. Cook 8 minute or until golden, stirring. 2. Add broth and broccoli. Heat to simmering on high. Reduce heat, simmer 15 minute, stirring occasionally. 3. Add spinach, mushroom and orzo. Simmer 8 to 10 minute or until starches and veggie are softened. 4. Remove from heat. Stir basil pesto to taste.

recipes.name: Kung pao brussels sprouts
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425 degree, on a rimmed baking sheet toss brussels with olive iol and season with salt and pepper. 2.Bake until brussels sprout are tengder and slightly cispy,,about 20 minute. Transfer brussels sprout to a bowl (but keep the baking sheet close by). Preheat broiler. 3. In a skillet over heat, heat sesame oil. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1minute. Stir in cornstarch. Add soy sauce, water, apple cider vinegar, hoisin sauce, brown sugar and garlic chili paste. Season with salt, pepper and red pepper flake. Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until thickened, about 3 minute. 4. Pour sauce over brussels sprout and toss to combine.Return brussels sprout to baking sheet and broil until brussels sprout are glazed and sticky. 5. Garnish with peanut, sesame seed and green onion before serving.

ingredients.description: roasted unsalted peanuts, chopped, for garnish

recipes.name: Vegetable pakoras
instructions: 1. Heat butter or oil in a skillet over heat. Add the coriander seed and red chili pepper flake. Cook, stirring constantly until the spices are toasted and fragrant. Do not overcook. 2. In a bowl combine chikpea flour, water, flour, lemon juice, turmeric, cumin, and salt to make a smooth batter. 3. Gently fold the sliced potato, onion, spinach, cilantro and toasted spices from step one into the chickpea batter. 4. In a deep, heavy bottomed saucepan, heat frying oil. Allow plenty time for oil to get hot. 5. Use a spoon to drop loose spoonfuls of the pakora batter into the frying oil. Don't compress the batter too much when scoop it. Cook the first side until deeply golden and crispy, flip and cook the other side. Drain cooked pakora on cooling rack or paper/kitchen towel. 6. Serve with creamy cilantro sauce, chutney or your favorite dipping sauce.

ingredients.description: margarine, or vegan butter or vegetable oil

recipes.name: Balsamic glazed roasted cauliflower
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 400. Place the cauliflower into a baking dish and surround with tomato, onion wedge, and green bean. Season with salt and coat with oil. 2. In a saucepan over heat, whisk together balsamic and brown sugar. Bring to a boil, then immiediately reduce to a simmer. Let simmer until reduced by hald, about 15 minutes. Brush glaze all over cauliflower, reserving some for basting. 3. Roast until golden and tender, and periodically basting with glaze. 4. Garnish with parsley before serving.

recipes.name: Baked garlic pepper polenta fries
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 450F. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper, set aside. 2. Cut your polenta in half width-wise. Halve each half lenght-wise. Then cut each fourth into thirds lenght-wise. Finally slice each third lenght-wise into 3-5 fries. 4. Place your fries in a single layer on your parchment lined cookie sheet. Sprinkle with seasoning and drizzle with olive oil. 5. Bake for 20 minutes, remove and flip fries. Bake for an additional 20 minutes or until desired crispness is achieved.

recipes.name: Best brokkoli salad
instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.2. Chop the broccoli florets into  piece and any remaining stems into dice. Peel any woody or course parts from the stem first.3. In the bottom of a bowl, whisk together the olive oil, mayo, apple cider vinegar, mustard, maple syrup, garlic, and salt. Add the broccoli, onion, and cranberry and toss to coat.4. Place the almonds and pepitas on the baking sheet, toss with the tamari, maple syrup, and smoked paprika and spread into a thin layer. Bake 10 to 14 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes (they’ll get crispier as they sit).5. Toss the almonds and pepitas into the salad, reserving a few to sprinkle on top. Season to taste and serve.

recipes.name: Cauliflower rice
instructions: 1. Make sure your cauliflower is fully dry. Chop the cauliflower into piece. You can include the cores, but discard the leaves or save for another use. Place the cauliflower piece in a food processor and pulse until it has the texture of rice. Work in batches if necessary and don’t over process or it will get mushy. Use in any recipe that calls specifically for riced cauliflower. Continue following that recipe’s instructions.If you plan to serve your cauliflower as a side dish or use it in place of regular rice, I recommend lightly cooking it and seasoning it to take off the raw bite. In a skillet, heat olive oil over heat. Add the scallion and cauliflower and sauté until heated through, about 3 to 5 minutes. Season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lime juice to help remove any bitterness from the raw cauliflower.

recipes.name: Vegan fettuccine alfredo
instructions: 1.Mince the garlic, chop the cauliflower. 2.Make the psta as the package recommends. 3. Start the sauce, heat olive oil in a pot over heat. Add the cauliflower and cashew and saute for 4 minute until lightly browned. Add the garlic and cook for 1 to 2 minute until fragrant. Add the vegetable broth, onion powder, black pepper, nutmeg and salt. Bring to a simmer, then cover and cook 6 to 7 minute on heat, until the cauliflower is tender when pierced with a fork. 4. Carefully transfer the contents to a blender and add salt and black peper. Blend until a smooth sauce forms. Pour the sauce on the cooked pasta.Top with finely chopped parsley and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Szechuan tofu and veggies
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet. Season oil generously with salt and pepper. Swirl the seasoned oil around until spread out uniformly.  Add tofu and sear on at least two sides, until crispy and golden. Be patient here. Set aside.To the same pan, add a little more oil if needed,  onion, and mushroom and sauté over heat – stirring constantly, until tender, about 3 minutes. Add the remaining veggie, add the dried chilies if you like -and lower heat, and sauté,  tossing & stirring for 3-5 minutes until just tender or al dente. Tender, but vibrant and still slightly crisp!Add the Szechuan Sauce, starting with 50 ml and adding more to taste. Cook the sauce 2 minutes, letting it thicken a bit. Toss in the crispy tofu,right at the end, just to warm it up.Sprinkle with sesame seeds and scallions. Add chili flakes for more heat.

ingredients.description: firm tofu, patted dry and cubed

recipes.name: Caprese quinoa bake
instructions: Preheat to oven to 400°. Prepare quinoa according to package instructions, using vegetable broth. Season with  salt.Chop one tomato into piece. Into a baking dish, combine cooked quinoa, chopped tomato, spinach, Italian seasoning, Parmesan, and garlic, and season with salt and pepper. Spread into an even layer. Slice remaining tomatoe, then layer slices with mozzarella on top of the quinoa mixture. Bake until cheese is melty and slightly golden, 30 minutes. Garnish with basil before serving.

recipes.name: Vegan chili
instructions: In a pot, heat olive oil over heat. Add pepper, onion and celery and cook until softened, 3 to 4 minutes. Add garlic, chili powder, paprika, cumin, and oregano and sauté until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes more. Season with salt and pepper.Add beer and cook until it has reduced by half, about 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add sweet potato, black and pinto bean, tomatoe and vegetable broth. Stir and bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook until slightly reduced and sweet potatoe cooked through, 30 to 35 minutes.Serve with the toppings of your choice.

recipes.name: Vegan pancakes
instructions: 1. whisk flour, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
2. whisk milk, apple sauce, coconut oil, sugar and vanilla extract in a medium bowl.
3. add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and whisk just until combined.
4. let the batter sit, without stirring, for 10 to 15 minutes.
5. heat over a large nonstick skillet medium heat. without stirring the batter, measure out pancakes using about 1/4 cup batter per pancake and pour into the pan (or onto the griddle).
6. cook until the edges are dry and you see bubbles on the surface, 2 to 4 minutes. flip and cook until golden brown on the other side, 2 to 4 minutes more.

recipes.name: Muffin-tin spinach & mushroom mini quiches
recipes.description: Switch up your morning routine with these easy vegetarian mini quiches.
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 325 degrees F.
2. heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
3. add mushrooms in an even layer; cook, undisturbed, until browned on the bottom, about 4 minutes. stir and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until browned all over, about 5 minutes.
4. add onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until beginning to soften, about 4 minutes. stir in garlic and thyme; cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
5. add spinach; cook, stirring constantly, until just wilted, about 2 minutes. remove from heat.
6. whisk egg, milk, Dijon, salt and pepper in a large bowl. stir in cheese and the mushroom mixture.
7. coat a standard muffin tin with muffin liner. pour the mixture in the prepared muffin cup.˘8. bake, uncovered, until puffed and set, about 30 minutes. remove from the pan and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Apple & peanut butter toast
recipes.description: A pinch of ground cardamom punches up the flavor in this classic combo of apples and peanut butter on toast.
instructions: 1. top toast with peanut butter, apple and cardamom.

recipes.name: Cauliflower ''toast''
recipes.description: Looking for a low-carb way to enjoy toast in the morning? Try these toasts made from cauliflower rice, egg and cheese.
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 425 degrees F. line one large baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. place cauliflower in a food processor, process until finely grated.
3. transfer to a microwave-safe bowl. cover loosely and microwave on high for 3 minutes. let cool slightly.
4. transfer the cauliflower to a clean kitchen towel and wring out excess moisture.
5. return to the bowl and stir in cheddar, egg, pepper and salt until thoroughly combined.
6. using about 1/4 cup of the cauliflower mixture for each, create two 3-inch squares on the prepared baking sheet.
7. bake until the toasts are browned and crispy around the edges, 22 to 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Coconut overnight oatmeal
instructions: 1. combine oats, coconut milk and salt in a jar or bowl.
2. cover and refrigerate overnight.
3. in the morning, heat if desired.
4. top with apricots, hazelnuts and maple syrup.

recipes.name: Smoked  salmon breakfast wraps
instructions: 1. in a small bowl, stir together cream cheese, chives, lemon peel, and lemon juice until smooth.
2. spread over the tortilla, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edges.
3. place salmon on the bottom half of each tortilla.
4. draw a sharp vegetable peeler lengthwise along the zucchini to cut very thin slices. place zucchini slices on top of salmon.
5. starting from the bottom, roll up tortillas. cut in half.

recipes.name: Beets & goat cheese toast
instructions: 1. top toast with goat cheese, beets and zest.

recipes.name: Gluten-free morning glory blender muffin
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 350 degrees F. coat muffin tin with muffin liner.
2. pulse oats in a blender until finely ground. add cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda and salt; pulse once or twice to blend.
3 add egg, applesauce, brown sugar, oil and vanilla; puree until smooth.
4. stir in carrot, raisins and nuts.
5. fill the prepared muffin cup (it will be full).
6. sprinkle with coconut, if desired.
7. bake the muffin until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 16 to 19 minutes. cool in the pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes, then turn out to cool completely.

recipes.name: Waffle with spinach, tomato & feta
instructions: 1. toast waffle.
2. transfer to a plate and top with spinach, tomato, salt, lemon juice and feta. serve immediately.

recipes.name: Anti-inflammatory cherry-spinach smoothie
instructions: 1. place kefir in a blender.
2. add cherries, spinach, almond butter, ginger and chia seeds; puree until smooth.
3 pour into a glass; garnish with more chia seeds, if desired.

recipes.name: Strawberry-mango-banana smoothie
instructions: 1. combine strawberries, mango, banana, coconut milk, cashew butter and chia seed in a blender.
2. process until smooth, adding more coconut milk, if needed, for desired consistency. serve immediately.

recipes.name: Cocumber cooler yogurt
instructions: 1. combine yogurt, cucumber, lemon zest and juice, mint and salt in a bowl or jar.

recipes.name: Sweet beet-raspberry yogurt
instructions: 1. combine yogurt, beets and jam in a bowl or jar. top with almonds.

recipes.name: Mermaid smoothie bowl
instructions: 1. combine banana, kiwi, pineapple, almond milk and spirulina in a blender. blend on high until smooth, about 2 minutes.
2. pour the smoothie into a bowl. top with blueberries and shredded coconut.

recipes.name: Tomato-arugula omelet
instructions: 1. coat a nonstick skillet with flared side with cooking spray. heat skillet over medium heat.
2. combine egg and pepper in a medium bowl.

3. pour the egg mixture into the prepared skillet. immediately begin stirring the egg gently but continuously with a wooden or plastic spatula until the mixture resembles small pieces of cooked egg surrounded by liquid egg.
4. stop stirring. cook for 30 to 60 seconds more or until the egg is set but still shiny.
5. sprinkle arugula, tomato, cheese, and olives over half of the egg. with a spatula, lift and fold the other half of the egg up over the filling.
6. transfer omelet to a serving plate.

recipes.name: Fruit and yogurt parfait
instructions: 1. peel and chop fruit, reserving 2 wedges for garnish. set aside.
2. combine yogurt and vanilla.
3. spoon half of the yogurt mixture into a parfait glass. top with half of the crushed biscuits, all of the chopped fruit, syrup, remaining yogurt mixture and remaining crushed biscuits.
4. sprinkle with almonds and cinnamon. garnish with a reserved fruit wedge.

recipes.name: Carrot cake waffle breakfast sandwich
instructions: 1. toast waffle.
2. spread cream cheese on one waffle.
3. top with carrot, raisins and walnuts. drizzle with maple syrup.
4. top with the remaining waffle.

recipes.name: Vegetarian cream cheese & bagels
instructions: 1. stir together cream cheese, dill, salt, and ground pepper in a small bowl.
2. cut bagel half, spread bagel halves with the cream cheese mixture.
3. top with cucumber slices, onion slices, and red pepper strips. if desired, garnish with fresh dill sprigs.

ingredients.description: red bell pepper, cut into thin strips

recipes.name: Mascarpone & berries toast
instructions: 1. top toast with mascarpone, berries and chopped mint.

recipes.name: Pear-spiced oatmeal
instructions: 1. combine oats with milk, heat until dense.
2. stir in ginger. top with pear.
3. sprinkle with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Peanut butter & fig crispbread
instructions: 1. top each crispbread with half the peanut butter, the fig slices, pepitas, and the coconut flakes.

recipes.name: Salsa scrambled eggs
instructions: 1. beat egg in a bowl.
2. coat a small nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium heat.
3. add the egg and cook, stirring, until almost firm; stir in cheese and salsa.
4. spoon onto tortilla and top with cilantro.

recipes.name: Salsa-tofu breakfast burrito
instructions: 1. heat oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
2. add tofu and cook, stirring occasionally, until beginning to brown, about 2 minutes.
3. stir in salsa, salt and pepper; continue cooking until heated through, about 30 seconds.
4. spread cheese down the center of tortilla. top with the tofu mixture. fold in the ends of the tortilla and roll into a burrito.

recipes.name: Berry-mint kefir smoothie
instructions: 1. combine kefir, berries, juice, mint to taste and honey in a blender.
2. process until smooth.

recipes.name: Mushroom-spinach eggs benedict
instructions: 1. for sauce, stir together sour cream, milk, and mustard in a small bowl; set aside.
2. heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. add mushrooms and shallot.
3. cook for 4 minutes or until mushrooms are golden brown, stirring frequently. stir in spinach until it just starts to wilt. set aside.

4. fill a medium nonstick skillet halfway with water. bring water to boiling; reduce heat to simmering (bubbles should begin to break the surface of the water). break the egg into a small dish. carefully slide egg into simmering water, holding the lip of the dish as close to the water as possible.  simmer, uncovered, for 3 to 5 minutes or until egg white is completely set and yolk being to thicken but is not hard.
5. remove egg from skillet with a slotted spoon.

6. meanwhile, toast the two muffin halves in a toaster. place one half on a serving plate. top with mushroom mixture; place egg on top of mushroom mixture. spoon sauce over egg. sprinkle with freshly ground pepper and nutmeg. if desired, garnish with thyme sprigs.
7. top with the other muffin half.

recipes.name: Tutti-frutti muesli
instructions: 1. stir together yogurt, blueberries, apple, banana, muesli and maple syrup to taste in a bowl.

recipes.name: Ham & jam crispbreads
instructions: 1. top each crispbread with half of the cultured butter, raspberry jam, ham and chives to taste.

recipes.name: Apple & smoked gouda sweet potato toast
instructions: 1. toast sweet potato in a toaster or toaster oven until just cooked through and starting to brown, 12 to 15 minutes.
2. top with cheese, apple, coconut, maple syrup and salt.

recipes.name: Sweet potato, kale & chicken salad with peanut dressing
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 425 degrees F. line a rimmed baking sheet with foil; lightly coat with cooking spray. set aside.
2. cut sweet potato into 1-inch cubes, toss with oil, salt and pepper in a bowl.
3. arrange the sweet potato on the prepared baking sheet. roast, turning once, until tender and lightly browned and crispy on the outside, about 20 minutes. set aside to cool before assembling bowls.
4. for the dressing, mix peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, water, honey and garlic in a jar.
5. put kale in a single-serving container, top with the sweet potato and chicken.
6. just before serving, drizzle each salad with the peanut dressing and toss well to coat. top with chopped peanuts.

recipes.name: Chopped Greek salad with chicken
instructions: 1. whisk vinegar, oil, dill, garlic powder, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
2. add lettuce, chicken, tomato, cucumber, onion, olives and feta; toss to coat.

recipes.name: Chicken caprese pasta salad bowl
instructions: 1. bring a large pot of water to a boil. cook rotini according to package directions. drain and rinse under cold running water, then set aside.
2. put spinach into a single-serving container. Top with the cooked pasta, tomato, chicken and mozzarella balls.
3. for the dressing, combine basil, oil, vinegar, agave, mustard, pepper and salt in a blender. puree until smooth.
4. dress the salad with the vinaigrette just before serving.

recipes.name: Turkey spinach salad with beets
instructions: 1. place spinach in a salad bowl or on a plate. top with beets, turkey, blueberries, onion and cheese.
2. prepare dressing: in a small container, combine orange juice, vinegar and oil. mix it well.
3. drizzle dressing over salad.

ingredients.description: canned beetroot, cut into thin wedges
smoked turkey breast, sliced, cut into strips

recipes.name: Tex-mex salad
instructions: 1. mix lettuce, black beans, tomato, corn, onion, avocado, green peppers, red peppers, and cheese in a medium bowl.
2. sprinkle salsa on top.

ingredients.description: canned black beans, rinsed and drained

recipes.name: B-l-t salad
instructions: 1. for dressing, whisk together yogurt, milk, mayonnaise, pepper and garlic in a small bowl. stir in half of the bacon.
2. in a large bowl, combine lettuce, tomato and cucumber. drizzle lettuce mixture with balsamic vinegar; toss well to combine.
3. add toasted bread cubes; toss again.
4. drizzle with the dressing and top with the remaining bacon.

recipes.name: Quinoa chickpea salad with hummus dressing
instructions: 1. stir hummus, lemon juice and red pepper in a small dish. thin with water to desired consistency for dressing.
2. arrange greens, quinoa and chickpeas in a large bowl. top with sunflower seeds, parsley, salt and pepper.
3. serve with the dressing.

recipes.name: No-cook black bean salad
instructions: 1. place onion in a medium bowl and cover with cold water. set aside.
2. combine avocado, cilantro, lime juice, oil, garlic and salt in a mini food processor. process, scraping down the sides as needed, until smooth and creamy.
3. just before serving, combine salad greens, corn, tomato and beans in a large bowl. drain the onion and add to the bowl, along with the avocado dressing.

ingredients.description: canned black beans, rinsed and drained

recipes.name: Greek salad baked potatoes
instructions: 1. prick potato all over with a fork. place in the microwave and cook at 50% power, turning once or twice, until it is soft, about 20 minutes.
2. combine tomato, onion, olives, vinegar, oil, oregano, salt and pepper in a bowl.
3. spoon the mixture on top of the baked potato. sprinkle the feta on top and serve.

recipes.name: Loaded portobello mushrooms
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 400 degrees F.
2. combine oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper in a small bowl. coat mushroom all over with the oil mixture. place the mushroom on a rimmed baking sheet and bake until mostly soft, about 10 minutes.

3. meanwhile, stir cheese, sour cream and all but one third of scallions in a medium bowl. once the mushroom have softened, remove from the oven; fill with the cheese mixture and sprinkle with bacon. bake until the cheese is melted, about 5 minutes more. sprinkle with the reserved scallion.

recipes.name: Loaded zucchini
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 400 degrees F.
2. Cut zucchini in half lengthwise.  scoop out the pulp, leaving a thin shell. (reserve the pulp.) sprinkle the shells with salt and pepper. place on a rimmed baking sheet; bake for 5 minutes.
3. meanwhile, finely chop the pulp, then squeeze dry using a clean kitchen towel. place in a bowl. Add cheese, all but one quater of scallions and half the bacon ; stir to combine.
4. spoon the filling into the prebaked shells. return to the oven and bake until the cheese is melted and the filling is hot, 12 to 15 minutes.
5. dollop each piece with sour cream and sprinkle with the remaining scallions and bacon.

recipes.name: Loaded twice-baked potatoes
instructions: 1. pierce potato all over with a fork. place in the microwave and cook on medium, turning once or twice, until the potato is soft, about 20 minutes.
2. meanwhile, brown meat in a large skillet over medium-high heat, stirring often, about 3 minutes. transfer to a large bowl.
3. increase heat to high, add broccoli and water to the pan, cover, and cook until tender, 4 to 5 minutes. drain the broccoli; add to the meat.

4. carefully cut off the top third of the cooked potato; reserve the tops for another use. scoop out the insides into a bowl. Place the potato shell in a baking dish. Add half of cheddar, sour cream, salt and pepper to the potato insides and mash with a fork or potato masher. add scallions and the potato mixture to the broccoli and meat; stir to combine.
5. put the mixture into the potato shell and top with the remaining cheese. microwave on high until the filling is hot and cheese is melted, 2 to 4 minutes.

recipes.name: Stuffed chard with fresh marinara
instructions: 1. gently mix beef, breadcrumbs, half of the shallot, half the Italian seasoning, garlic powder and pepper in a bowl until just combined. divide the mixture into 2 oblong 3-inch portions.
2. overlap the two sides of a chard leaf where the stem was removed and place a portion of beef there. tightly roll the chard around the beef.
3. place each roll, seam-side down, in a large nonstick skillet. pour in broth, cover and bring to a boil over high heat. reduce heat to a simmer; cook 8 to 10 minutes. discard any remaining broth.

4. meanwhile, heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat. add the remaining shallot, Italian seasoning and crushed red pepper. cook, stirring often, until the shallot is soft, 1 to 2 minutes. stir in tomato and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly reduced and thickened, about 8 minutes.
5. serve the chard rolls topped with sauce and parmesan cheese, if desired.

recipes.name: Loaded cauliflower bowl
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 425 degrees F.
2. toss cauliflower and oil together in a bowl. transfer to a rimmed baking sheet; roast until just tender, 12 to 15 minutes.
3. return to the bowl and stir in cheddar, pepper, salt and half the scallions. put the cauliflower mixture into a bowl, then top each with sour cream, the remaining cheese, bacon and scallion.

recipes.name: Stuffed peppers
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 350 degrees F.

2. cut out stem end of bell pepper and discard. scoop out seeds. bring water to a boil in a large pot and blanch the peppers until tender-crisp, about 1 minute. rain and cool under cold running water. set aside.

3. heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes. Add turkey, garlic powder and cook, crumbling with a wooden spoon, just until it loses its pink color, about 2 minutes. drain the fat.

4. transfer the turkey mixture to a medium bowl and mix in rice, half the tomato sauce, parsley, salt and pepper. stuff the pepper with the mixture and place it in a casserole dish. spoon the remaining tomato sauce over the pepper. cover and bake until the pepper is tender and the filling is heated through, 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Stuffed eggplant
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
2. halve eggplant lengthwise. cut around the inside edge of a half with a paring knife to separate the flesh from the skin. scoop out the flesh and roughly chop. set the shell aside.

3. heat half the oil in a saucepan over medium heat. add the chopped eggplant and cook, stirring frequently, until starting to soften, 2 to 3 minutes. add garlic and cook, stirring frequently, until soft, 3 to 5 minutes. transfer to a bowl, season with salt and pepper and set aside to cool.

4. heat the remaining oil in a skillet over medium heat until shimmering. season the eggplant shell with half the Parmesan. cook in the hot oil, turning once, until golden brown and soft, 5 to 8 minutes. (use caution: they will bubble and spit a little when you turn them over.) drain on paper towels.

5. dunk breadcrumbs in a bowl of water and squeeze them out. transfer to the bowl with the eggplant filling. add the, egg, and parsley and mix thoroughly. fill the eggplant shell with the stuffing and use a spoon to smooth the tops.

6. spoon half the tomato sauce into an ovenproof dish big enough to fit the eggplant in one layer. transfer the stuffed eggplant to the dish. spoon the remaining sauce over each and top with basil leaf. Sprinkle with the remaining parmesan.
7. bake for about 25 minutes

recipes.name: Cheese & spinach stuffed portobellos
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 450 degrees F. coat a rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray.
2. place mushroom cap, gill-side up, on the prepared pan. sprinkle with salt and pepper. roast until tender, 20 to 25 minutes.
3. meanwhile, mash ricotta, spinach, half the Parmesan, olives, and Italian seasoning in a medium bowl.
4. place marinara sauce in a small bowl, cover and microwave on high until hot, 30 seconds to 1 minutes.

5. when the mushroom is tender, carefully pour out any liquid accumulated in the cap. return the caps to the pan gill-side up. spread half the marinara into each cap; cover the remaining sauce to keep warm. mound the ricotta filling into the cap and sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan. bake until hot, about 10 minutes. serve with the remaining marinara sauce.

recipes.name: Sheet-pan chili-lime salmon with potatoes & peppers
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 425 degrees F. coat a rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray.
2. toss potato, half the oil, half the salt and pepper together in a bowl. transfer to the prepared pan and roast for 15 minutes.

3. meanwhile, combine chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, lime zest and the remaining salt in a small bowl. Place bell pepper in the medium bowl and add the remaining oil and  half the spice mixture; toss well to coat. coat the salmon with the remaining spice mixture.

4. after 15 minutes, remove the pan from the oven. add the pepper and stir to combine. roast for 5 minutes. remove from the oven; move some of the vegetables over and add the salmon to the pan. roast until the salmon is just cooked through, 6 to 8 minutes. serve with lime wedges.

recipes.name: Creamed spinach-stuffed salmon
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 425 degrees F. line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.

2. heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. add shallot and garlic; cook, stirring often, until softened, about 2 minutes. stir in crushed red pepper; cook, stirring constantly, for 30 seconds. add spinach in batches; cook, stirring until wilted before adding more, about 3 minutes total. remove from heat. add mozzarella and cream cheese; stir until the cheeses melt. let cool for 10 minutes.
3. place salmon fillet skin-side down on a clean work surface. with a sharp knife, make a cut lengthwise down the middle of the fillet, cutting to but not through the skin.

4. transfer the salmon to the prepared baking sheet. sprinkle evenly with salt and pepper. fill the pocket with about the spinach mixture. bake until the salmon is opaque in the center, 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Parchment packet baked tuna steaks & vegetables with creamy Dijon-turmeric sauce
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 450 degrees F. cut a large sheet of parchment paper, about 16 by 12 inches.
2. combine mayonnaise, parsley, mustard, honey and turmeric in a small bowl.

3. to make packets, lay the parchment sheet on a work surface with the long sides closest to you. Fold each in half (bringing the short sides together), then open. place the potato slices on one side of parchment and sprinkle with half the salt and pepper. top each with kale and tuna. sprinkle the tuna with the remaining salt and pepper. brush with the mayonnaise mixture. close the packet and seal the edges with small, tight folds. place the packet on a large baking sheet.
4. bake until the fish is just cooked through, 10 to 15 minutes. set packet on a plate. let stand for 3 minutes. cut an X in the top of each packet with scissors and carefully fold open to serve.

recipes.name: Lemon-glazed trout
instructions: 1. rinse the fish; pat dry with paper towels. sprinkle the fish with salt and pepper.
2. place milk in a shallow dish. place flour in another shallow dish. dip the fish into the milk, then into the flour, turning to coat evenly.

3. heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. add the fish to the skillet. cook for 6 to 8 minutes or until golden and the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork, turning once halfway through cooking. remove the fish from the skillet; cover with foil and keep warm.

4. add shallot to the same skillet. cook over medium heat for about 2 minutes or until softened, stirring occasionally. add broth, lemon juice, and butter. cook over low heat until heated through, stirring to scrape up any crusty browned bits. spoon the sauce over the fish. sprinkle with parsley. serve with lemon wedges, if desired.

recipes.name: Trout amandine
instructions: 1. grease a shallow baking pan; set aside. preheat oven to 450 degrees F. rinse the fish; pat dry with paper towels. measure thickness of the fish.

2. pour buttermilk into a shallow dish. combine breadcrumbs, parsley, dry mustard, salt, and pepper in another shallow dish. dip the fish into the buttermilk, then into the breadcrumb mixture, coating it on both sides. place the coated fish in the prepared baking pan.
3. sprinkle the fish with almonds. drizzle melted butter over the fish. bake for 4 to 6 minutes per 1/2-inch thickness of fish or until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

recipes.name: Tilapia with herbet shiitake sauce
instructions: 1. thaw fish. preheat oven to 450 degrees F. lightly coat a baking pan with cooking spray; set aside. rinse the fish; pat dry with paper towels. brush the fish lightly with lemon juice.
2. place the fish, skinned sides down, in the prepared pan. combine bread crumbs, pepper, and salt in a bowl. sprinkle evenly onto the fish. coat the fish generously with cooking spray.
3. bake until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

4. meanwhile, for sauce: heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. add mushroom and shallot; cook about 3 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally. stir flour into mixture in the skillet. add white wine; cook and stir until thick and bubbly. add chicken broth. bring to boiling; reduce heat. simmer, uncovered, for 4 minutes, stirring occasionally. stir in chives, parsley, and thyme.
5. serve the sauce over the fish.

recipes.name: Air-fryer fish cakes
instructions: 1. coat the basket of an air fryer with cooking spray.
2. combine fish, panko, cilantro, chili sauce, mayonnaise, egg, salt and pepper in a bowl; stir until well combined. shape the mixture into two 3-inch-diameter cakes.
3. coat the cakes with cooking spray; place in the prepared basket. cook at 400 degrees F until the cakes are browned, 9 to 10 minutes. serve with lime wedge.

recipes.name: Indian curry fish
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 450 degrees F. coat a shallow baking pan with cooking spray; set aside.
2. thaw fish. rinse the fish; pat dry with paper towels. sprinkle the fish with salt and pepper.
3. place the fish in a single layer in the prepared baking pan. tuck under any thin edges. bake, uncovered, for 4 to 8 minutes or until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.
4. meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. add pea pods and tomato; reduce heat to medium. cook and stir for 2 to 4 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.

5. to serve, stir half of the cilantro, half of the curry powder, and half of the garam masala into the vegetable mixture. stir the remaining cilantro, the remaining curry powder, and the remaining garam masala into the cooked lentils. place the lentil mixture and the vegetable mixture on a dinner plate; top with the fish.

recipes.name: Mediterranean cod with roasted tomatoes
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 450 degrees F. thaw fish. rinse fish and pat dry with paper towels.
2. in a bowl combine snipped oregano, snipped thyme, salt, garlic powder, paprika and black pepper. sprinkle half of the oregano mixture over both sides of the fish fillet.

3. line a baking pan with foil. coat foil with cooking spray. place fish on one side of the foil-lined pan. add tomato and garlic slices to the other side of the foil-lined pan. combine remaining oregano mixture with oil. drizzle oil mixture over tomato; toss to coat. bake for 8 to 12 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork, stirring tomato mixture once. stir olives and capers into cooked tomato mixture.
4. serve fish and tomato mixture on a plate.

recipes.name: Tuscan tuna with tomato salad
instructions: 1. thaw fish. rinse fish; pat dry with paper towels. set aside.
2. stir together half the vinegar, the olive oil, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper in a bowl. brush on both sides of tuna steak. set aside.
3. for tomato salad, stir together tomato, fennel, basil, shallot, garlic and the remaining vinegar in a bowl. set aside.

3. For a charcoal grill, place fish on the grill rack directly over medium coals. grill, uncovered, for 6 to 8 minutes or until fish begins to flake when tested with a fork, turning fish once halfway through grilling. (for a gas/electric grill, preheat grill. reduce heat to medium. place fish on a grill rack over heat. cover and grill as directed.)
4. serve tuna with reserved tomato salad. sprinkle with pine nuts and Parmesan.

recipes.name: Fennel & shrimp fra diavolo
instructions: 1. bring a medium pot of water to a boil. add penne and cook according to package directions. drain, return to the pot and cover to keep warm.

2. meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. add onion and fennel and cook, stirring, until starting to soften, 4 to 5 minutes. add garlic, crushed red pepper, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper and cook 1 minute more.
3. add tomato with its juice; bring to a simmer. cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes. add shrimp and cook, stirring, until they are just cooked through, about 4 minutes.
4. stir half the tomato sauce into the pasta to lightly coat it. put it into a pasta bowl and top with the remaining shrimp and sauce. serve sprinkled with chopped fennel fronds, if desired.

recipes.name: Curry scallops & cilantro rice
instructions: 1. pat scallops dry and sprinkle both sides with curry powder,half the salt and pepper.
2. heat butter in a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat until beginning to sizzle. add the scallop and cook until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. remove to a plate.
3. add cooked rice, cilantro, scallion, lemon juice and the remaining salt to the pan. cook, stirring, until heated through, about 1 minute. serve the scallops with the rice.

recipes.name: Seafood couscous paella
instructions: 1. heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat. add onion; cook, stirring constantly, for 3 minutes. add garlic, thyme, fennel seed, salt, pepper and saffron; cook for 20 seconds.
2. stir in tomato and broth. bring to a simmer. cover, reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes.

3. increase heat to medium, stir in scallop and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes. add shrimp and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes more. stir in couscous. cover, remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes; fluff.

recipes.name: Seafood stew
instructions: 1. heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. add onion; cook, stirring constantly, for 3 minutes. add garlic, thyme, fennel seed, salt, pepper and saffron; cook for 20 seconds.
2. stir in tomato, broth and green beans. bring to a simmer. cover, reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes.
3. increase heat to medium, stir in scallop and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes. add shrimp and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes more.

recipes.name: Spanish tapas-inspired mussels
instructions: 1. heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. add chickpeas, tomato, onion, garlic and pimiento. cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 6 to 8 minutes.
2. stir in oregano, pepper and saffron. cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
3. pour in broth and sherry, stirring to scrape up any browned bits. bring to a simmer.
4. add mussels and stir to combine. return to a simmer. cover, reduce heat and simmer until the mussels open, 6 to 8 minutes. stir; discard any unopened mussels before serving.

recipes.name: Seafood salad with citrus vinaigrette
instructions: 1. bring a saucepan of water to a boil. add scallop and cook until firm, opaque and just cooked through, about 1 minute. drain and rinse under cold water until cool.

2. Slice a thin slice off the bottom of the grapefruit; stand it on a cutting board. using a sharp paring knife, remove the peel and pith. hold the fruit over a medium bowl and cut between the membranes to release individual grapefruit sections into the bowl, collecting any juice as well. discard membranes, pith, peel and any seeds. transfer just the grapefruit sections to a serving bowl.
3. whisk shallot, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper into the bowl with the grapefruit juice. whisk in oil in a slow, steady stream. add the scallops and crab to the dressing; toss well to coat.
4. add lettuce, tomato and avocado to the bowl with the grapefruit; toss to combine. add the seafood and dressing; toss gently.

ingredients.description: dry sea scallop, quartered, tough muscle removed

recipes.name: Air-fryer scallops
instructions: 1. sprinkle scallop with pepper and salt. coat the basket of an air fryer with cooking spray. place scallop in the basket and coat them with cooking spray. place the basket in the fryer. cook the scallops at 400 degrees F until they reach an internal temperature of 120 degrees F, about 6 minutes.
2. combine oil, parsley, caper, lemon zest and garlic in a small bowl. drizzle over the scallop.

ingredients.description: scallops, cleaned and patted very dry

recipes.name: Garlic shrimp on spinach
instructions: 1. peel and devein shrimp, leaving tails on if desired. in a bowl, toss together shrimp, oil, garlic, lemon peel, and pepper.
2. place a steamer basket in a wok or large skillet with a tight-fitting lid. add water to just below the basket.

3. place shrimp in a single layer in steamer basket. cover and place over medium-high heat. steam for 5 to 6 minutes or until shrimp are opaque (start timing when wok is placed on the burner). remove shrimp and keep warm.

4. meanwhile, wash spinach. arrange spinach evenly in steamer basket. cover and steam about 2 minutes (start timing immediately) or until wilted. put spinach into a serving plate. thread shrimp onto 6- to 8-inch wooden skewers. place shrimp on top of spinach. sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. serve with lemon wedge.

recipes.name: Salt & pepper shrimp
instructions: 1. whisk lime juice, soy sauce, sesame oil and sugar in a bowl until the sugar is dissolved. add cabbage and bell pepper; toss to combine.

2. combine rice flour, salt, pepper and five-spice powder in a medium bowl. add shrimp and toss to coat. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. add the shrimp and cook, stirring often, until they are pink and curled, 3 to 4 minutes. Add jalapeno and cook until the shrimp are cooked through, about 1 minute more. serve the slaw topped with the shrimp.

recipes.name: Grilled calamari & potato salad
instructions: 1. preheat (electric) grill to medium-high. toss calamari with oil and vinegar and half the salt and pepper. toss potato with oil, salt and pepper. thread garlic on a grilling skewer.

2. take the calamari, potato, garlic skewer and tomato out to the grill. grill the garlic and potato, turning occasionally, until tender, 6 to 8 minutes for the garlic, 10 to 12 minutes for the potato. place the tomato halves on the grill skin-side down; grill until lightly charred, 5 to 7 minutes. turn and grill for 1 minute more. remove the calamari from the marinade and place on the hottest part of the grill; grill, turning once or twice, until just cooked through, 2 to 4 minutes total.

3. when the garlic is cool enough to handle, peel and put in a blender. add parsley, anchovy, caper, water, the lemon zest and juice, the remaining oil, vinegar, salt and pepper to taste. puree until smooth.

4. place spinach in a large bowl and toss with about half the dressing; put it info a plate. top with the potato and tomato halves. slice the calamari bodies into rings, but leave the tentacles whole; place on the spinach. drizzle with the remaining dressing.

recipes.name: Low-carb eggplant pizzas
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 375 degrees F. sprinkle eggplant slices with salt; place on a paper-towel-lined plate and let stand for 10 minutes. pat with a paper towel to remove excess moisture. brush both sides with oil and sprinkle with pepper; place in a single layer on a parchment-paper-lined rimmed baking sheet. bake until tender and lightly browned, 18 to 20 minutes. remove from oven. increase oven temperature to broil with rack about 6 inches from heat.

2. meanwhile, heat a medium nonstick skillet over medium-high. add sausage and mushroom and cook, stirring often, until the sausage is no longer pink and the mushroom is tender and browned, about 6 minutes. set aside.
3. spread marinara evenly over the eggplant slices. divide the sausage mixture evenly among the slices and sprinkle evenly with cheese.
4. broil until the cheese is melted and browned, about 3 minutes. sprinkle with basil and serve immediately.

ingredients.description: eggplant, cut crosswide into thick slices

recipes.name: Sesame-orange shrimp
instructions: 1. whisk sesame seed, egg white, cornstarch, salt and pepper in a large bowl. add shrimp and toss to coat.

2. heat half the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. add half the shrimp and cook until golden, 1 to 2 minutes per side. transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain. repeat with the remaining oil and the rest of the shrimp.

3. add orange juice, sherry, soy sauce and sugar to the pan. bring to a boil and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened and reduced by half, 4 to 6 minutes. return the shrimp to the pan and stir to coat with the sauce. serve immediately, with scallion sprinkled on top.

recipes.name: Easy cauliflower fried rice
instructions: 1. To make cauliflower rice, place cauliflower florets in a food processor and pulse until broken down into rice-size granules.

2. heat half the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add egg and cook, tilting the pan and lifting the edges with a spatula to let the uncooked egg flow underneath, until almost set on the bottom, 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. flip and continue cooking until set completely, about 30 seconds more. transfer to a cutting board and slice into bite-size strips.

3. Heat the remaining oil in the pan over medium-high heat. add cauliflower rice, bell pepper, scallion and ginger. cook, stirring occasionally, until the cauliflower is soft and beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. add chile-garlic sauce, soy sauce, peanuts and the egg. stir until combined and heated through, about 30 seconds. garnish each serving with scallion.

recipes.name: One-pot garlicky shrimp & spinach
instructions: 1. heat half the oil in a large pot over medium heat. add half the garlic and cook until beginning to brown, 1 to 2 minutes. add spinach and half the salt and toss to coat. cook, stirring once or twice, until mostly wilted, 3 to 5 minutes. remove from heat and stir in lemon juice. transfer to a bowl and keep warm.

2. increase heat to medium-high and add the remaining oil to the pot. add the remaining garlic and cook until beginning to brown, 1 to 2 minutes. add shrimp, crushed red pepper and the remaining salt; cook, stirring, until the shrimp are just cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes more. serve the shrimp over the spinach, sprinkled with lemon zest and parsley.

recipes.name: Grilled steak salad with tomatoes & eggplant
instructions: 1. preheat electric grill to high.
2. cook oregano in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it smells toasty, about 2 minutes. transfer to a bowl.
3. cut steak in half lengthwise (with the grain); season on both sides with half the salt and pepper. brush both sides of pepper and eggplant with half the oil.

4. grill the meat, turning once, 8 to 10 minutes total for medium. grill the pepper, turning once, until softened and charred in spots, about 10 minutes. grill the eggplant, turning once, until browned and slightly soft, about 8 minutes.

5. while the steak rests, add tomato, onion and garlic to the bowl with the oregano. drizzle with vinegar and the remaining oil. season with salt and pepper; toss to combine. chop the pepper and eggplant; add to the bowl. cut the steak across the grain into 1/4-inch-thick slices, add to the bowl and toss to combine.

ingredients.description: eggplant, cut crosswide into thick slices

recipes.name: Chicken, brussels sprouts & mushroom salad
instructions: 1. whisk oil, vinegar, shallot, mustard, thyme and pepper in a large bowl. add chicken, mushroom, Brussels sprouts, arugula and celery; toss to coat.
2. sprinkle with Parmesan.

recipes.name: Sautéed mushrooms with sherry & shallots
instructions: 1. heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. add shallot and cook, stirring, until softened, about 3 minutes. add mushroom, rosemary, salt and pepper; cook, stirring, until the vegetables are cooked through and starting to brown, about 8 minutes. add sherry; continue cooking until the sherry is mostly evaporated, 1 to 2 minutes more. sprinkle with Parmesan, if desired.

recipes.name: One-skillet chicken paprikash with mushrooms & onions
instructions: 1. sprinkle chicken with half the salt and pepper. heat half the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. add the chicken and cook, turning once, until browned, about 6 minutes total. transfer to a plate and cover to keep warm.

2. add the remaining oil and onion to the skillet. cook, stirring, until the onion is mostly soft and lightly browned, about 5 minutes. add mushroom and cook, stirring, until cooked through, 4 to 5 minutes. add paprika, crushed red pepper and the remaining salt; cook, stirring, for 1 minute. whisk broth and sour cream in a bowl; add to the pan. bring to a simmer and cook, stirring, until the flavors have melded and the sauce has thickened, 2 to 3 minutes more. add the chicken and cook until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes more. garnish with parsley, if desired.

recipes.name: Dilly potato salad with green beans
instructions: 1. place onion in a bowl and cover with ice water. let stand for at least 10 minutes, then drain well and set aside. cut the beans into 1-inch slices.

2. meanwhile, bring 1 inch of water to a boil in a medium saucepan fitted with a steamer basket. add potato, cover and steam until just tender when pierced with a knife, 12 to 15 minutes. add beans to the steamer basket with the potato; cover and continue cooking until the potato is soft and the beans are tender-crisp, 5 to 7 minutes more. rinse the vegetables under cool water and drain well.

3. whisk dill, oil, vinegar, mustard, pepper, and salt in a large bowl. halve potato and add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the beans, red onion, and chopped egg. stir gently to combine. garnish with more fresh dill, if desired.

recipes.name: Easy Sesame Chicken with Green Beans
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 425°F. place chicken on a large rimmed baking sheet. brush with half the oil and sprinkle with half the garlic powder and half the salt. roast for 15 minutes.
2. Meanwhile, toss green beans with the remaining oil, garlic powder, and salt in a large bowl.

3. after the chicken has roasted for 15 minutes, add the beans to the baking sheet in an even layer around the chicken. brush hoisin sauce over the chicken. return to the oven and roast until the beans are tender and beginning to brown, 10 to 15 minutes more.
4. combine sesame seeds and scallion in a small bowl. toss half of the sesame seed mixture with the beans and sprinkle the remaining sesame seed mixture over the chicken.

recipes.name: Honey-mustard chicken with asparagus farrotto
instructions: 1. heat half the oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. add farro and cook, stirring frequently, until toasted, about 2 minutes. add 3/4 of the broth and bring to a boil. reduce heat to maintain a simmer, cover and cook until the farro is tender, about 30 minutes. remove from heat.

2. meanwhile, sprinkle chicken with mustard and half the salt and pepper. heat the remaning oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. add the chicken and cook, flipping once, until browned, 6 to 8 minutes. transfer to a plate.

3. add asparagus to the skillet. sprinkle with the remaining each salt and pepper and cook, stirring frequently, until tender-crisp, about 3 minutes. add the asparagus to the farro and stir until the mixture is creamy, about 2 minutes.

4. add the remaining broth, honey and crushed red pepper to the skillet. bring to a simmer and cook, scraping up any browned bits, until the sauce is reduced by half, about 2 minutes. add the chicken and turn to coat.
5. stir parsley into the farro. serve the farro topped with the chicken and the sauce.

recipes.name: Shaved artichoke salad with shrimp
instructions: 1. squeeze half the lemon into a bowl of cold water. cut stems from artichoke and discard. working with one artichoke at a time, pull off all the leaves and soft purple petals and discard. using a sharp paring knife, trim any remaining green parts from the heart. rub with the cut side of the remaining lemon. scoop out the fuzzy choke. rub again with the lemon. place the artichoke heart in the lemon water to prevent discoloration while you trim the rest.
2. very thinly slice the artichoke hearts and immediately toss them in a bowl with half the oil, mint, salt and half the pepper.
3. heat the remaining oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. add shrimp and the remaining pepper. cook, stirring occasionally, until the shrimp are pink, 3 to 4 minutes.
4. serve the shrimp with the artichoke and garnished with more mint, if desired.

recipes.name: One-pan chicken & asparagus bake
instructions: 1. preheat oven to 375 degrees F. place chicken on a clean work surface and cover with plastic wrap. using a meat mallet, pound the chicken to an even thickness. put it on one half of a large rimmed baking sheet. arrange potato and carrot in a single layer on the other half of the pan. drizzle the chicken and vegetables with half the oil; sprinkle with half the coriander, the salt and the pepper. bake for 15 minutes.
2. meanwhile, whisk lemon juice, shallot, mustard and the remaining oil, coriander, salt and pepper in a small bowl.

3. remove the pan from the oven; switch the oven to broil. stir the potato-carrot mixture; arrange asparagus in the center of the pan. spoon the lemon juice-shallot mixture evenly over the chicken and vegetables. broil until the chicken and vegetables are lightly browned, asparagus is tender-crisp, about 10 minutes. remove from oven; sprinkle evenly with parsley and dill. serve with lemon wedge.

recipes.name: Arepas with spicy black beans
instructions: 1. combine masarepa, water and half the salt in a medium bowl. stir until a smooth dough forms. set aside.

2. heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. add bell pepper and onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes. stir in garlic, cumin and the remaining salt; cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. stir in beans and tomato. bring to a simmer over high heat. reduce heat to maintain a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 15 to 20 minutes. remove from heat and stir in cilantro and lime juice.

3. meanwhile, form the dough into a ball shape and press into disk 4 inches wide and 1/2 inch thick. heat  oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. add arepa and cook, turning once, until golden brown, 7 to 8 minutes total.
4. top the arepas with some of the bean mixture and cheese. garnish with more cilantro and serve with lime wedges, if desired.

recipes.name: Broccoli-cauliflower soup
instructions: 1. bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. add broccoli and cauliflower; cook for 3 minutes. remove half the broccoli and cauliflower florets with a slotted spoon; set aside. add spinach to the pot; cook until the broccoli and cauliflower are tender and the spinach has wilted, about 2 minutes. drain.

2. transfer the mixture to a blender; add broth and shallot. secure the lid on the blender and remove the center piece to allow steam to escape. place a clean towel over opening. process until smooth, about 30 seconds.

3. return the pureed soup to the pot. stir in milk and salt. cook over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until steaming, about 2 minutes. remove from heat. put into a bowl; top with the reserved broccoli-cauliflower mixture, cheese and parsley.

recipes.name: Cream&carrot soup
instructions: 1. heat oil in a medium bowl. add onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly browned and softened, about 8 minutes. add broth, carrot, potato and garlic powder; stir to combine.
2.  cook until carrot and potato are tender, about 20 minutes. stir in milk, cream, salt and pepper.

3. use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth, or puree the soup in a blender. if using a traditional blender, secure the lid on the blender and remove the center piece to allow steam to escape. place a clean towel over the opening. process until smooth, about 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Vegan gnocchi soup
instructions: 1. Heat half the oil in a pot over medium-high heat. add onion and carrot; cook, stirring, until starting to soften, about 3 minutes. add mushroom and garlic powder and continue cooking and stirring until softened, about 4 minutes more.

2. stir in Italian seasoning, salt and pepper. add broth and diced tomato, turn heat to high and bring to a boil. stir in kale, reduce heat to maintain a simmer and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.

3. meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. add gnocchi and cook, stirring often, until puffy and browned in spots, 5 to 7 minutes. stir the cooked gnocchi into the soup.

recipes.name: Cauliflower soup with bacon
instructions: 1. in a blender or food processor, combine cauliflower, broth, garlic powder and pepper. cover and blend until smooth.
2. transfer to a saucepan. bring just to boiling over medium heat. whisk in cream cheese and enough of the remaining broth to reach desired consistency; heat through.
3. to serve, top soup with yogurt, bacon, parsley and lemon zest.

recipes.name: Dilled yogurt-pea soup
instructions: 1. combine broth, peas, spinach, onion, the chopped dill, salt, and pepper in a medium saucepan. bring to boiling; reduce heat. cover and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes for fresh peas or until the peas are very tender. cool mixture slightly.
2. blend the pea mixture, half at a time, in a blender until smooth. return the pureed mixture to the same saucepan. stir in yogurt; heat through. if desired, garnish with fresh dill sprigs.

recipes.name: Quick french onion soup
instructions: 1. heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. add onion, stir to coat and cover. reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring often, until the onion is soft and starting to brown, 6 to 8 minutes. add leek, garlic and thyme and cook, uncovered, stirring often, until the leek begins to soften, 3 to 4 minutes.

2. add sherry and pepper. increase heat to medium-high and cook, stirring, until most of the liquid has evaporated, about 30 seconds. stir in broth and chickpeas; bring to a boil. reduce heat to a simmer and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 3 minutes. remove from the heat and stir in chives.
3. place bread in the bottom of a bowl; top with cheese. ladle the soup over the bread and cheese and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Creamy asparagus soup
instructions: 1. heat half the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. add shallot and cook, stirring, until softened, 2 to 3 minutes. add broth, asparagus, potato, horseradish and salt; bring to a boil. reduce heat and simmer until the vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes. puree with an immersion blender or in a regular blender.
2. meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. reduce heat to medium, add bread cubes and cook, stirring, until browned and crispy, 3 to 5 minutes.
3. serve the soup topped with the croutons and scallion, if desired.

recipes.name: Red lentil & caramelized onion soup
instructions: 1. heat half the oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. add half the onion and jalapeno; cook, stirring often, until the onion starts to turn golden, about 5 minutes. add carrot, lentils and water. bring to a boil. add turmeric, cover and simmer until the carrot and lentils are tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
2. meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a small skillet over medium heat. add the remaining onion and cook, stirring often, until it turns medium brown, about 10 minutes.
3. transfer the lentil mixture to a food processor or blender and puree until smooth. add a little water if necessary. return the puree to the pot. stir in lime juice and season with salt and pepper.
4. ladle the soup into a bowl. top it with sauteed onion, egg slices and sprinkle with cilantro.

recipes.name: Easy butternut squash soup
instructions: 1. microwave butternut squash in a microwave-safe baking dish on 100 percent power (high) for 3 minutes. stir. microwave on 100 percent power (high) for 3 minutes more. stir again. microwave on 100 percent power (high) about 2 minutes more or until squash is very tender. using a pastry blender or potato masher, mash squash.
2. meanwhile, in a heavy medium saucepan cook onion in hot butter until tender, stirring frequently.

3. in a food processor or blender combine cooked onion, mashed squash, broth, evaporated milk, brown sugar, salt, ground nutmeg, and the white pepper. cover and process or blend until smooth. return soup to the saucepan. cook and stir over medium-high heat until heated through. if desired, garnish with thyme and freshly grated nutmeg.

recipes.name: Creamy mushroom soup
instructions: 1. heat half the oil in a large pot over medium heat. add shallot and celery; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 3 minutes. add shiitakes and baby bellas (leave a bit for the top), sherry and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms are soft and the liquid has evaporated, about 5 minutes. stir in potato and thyme; cook for 1 minute. add broth and water. bring to a boil. reduce heat to maintain a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are very soft, about 20 minutes.

2. meanwhile, coarsely chop the remaining mushroom. heat the remaining oil in a medium skillet over medium heat. add the mushroom and cook, stirring often, until soft, about 2 minutes. add walnuts and salt. cook, stirring occasionally, until hot, about 1 minute more.
3. puree the soup with an immersion blender or in a regular blender until very smooth. stir in vinegar and pepper.
4. serve the soup topped with the mushroom-walnut mixture and chives.
